; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 1)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define (kv:_default-policy) (list "hybrid" 8 32))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: entries snapshot; rebuild only when empty and size>=thr (cheap hook)
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:engine-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (use-i (kv:_want-index? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache (even if body hits)
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((ens (kv:_ensure-index body index policy))
               (nindex (car ens))
               (rb (cadr ens))
               (iv (if use-i (kv:_index-lookup nindex k) #f))
               (v (if (not (eq? iv #f)) iv (kv:get body k)))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body nindex ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 rb)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; invalidate index on write (rebuild lazily on get)
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

input.source:
; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 1)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define (kv:_default-policy) (list "hybrid" 8 32))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: entries snapshot; rebuild only when empty and size>=thr (cheap hook)
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:engine-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (use-i (kv:_want-index? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache (even if body hits)
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((ens (kv:_ensure-index body index policy))
               (nindex (car ens))
               (rb (cadr ens))
               (iv (if use-i (kv:_index-lookup nindex k) #f))
               (v (if (not (eq? iv #f)) iv (kv:get body k)))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body nindex ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 rb)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; invalidate index on write (rebuild lazily on get)
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

target.name: kv:engine-set
target.body:
(lambda (e k v) (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v2: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.
;
; v2: engine-get skips the index entirely. The index field, _ensure-index,
; _index-lookup, and _want-index? are retained for API stability and future
; re-introduction once a denser index representation (hash / sorted tree /
; bucketed) lands; in v2 the index provides no asymptotic speedup because
; body is itself an alist (O(n) walk) and index was just an O(n) alist
; snapshot of the same body. Removing it from the hot path roughly halves
; per-read ops for cache-miss paths (cache-lookup + body-get + cache-put
; only) and eliminates the per-write rebuild cost that dominated the mixed
; workload. Rebuild counter now stays 0 in steady state.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 2)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define (kv:_default-policy) (list "hybrid" 8 32))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: alist snapshot; unused in v2 hot path. Kept as dead code so the
; field + helpers remain addressable for future denser representation
; (hash / sorted tree / bucketed). Body is the source of truth and is
; consulted on every cache miss in v2.
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v2: body is consulted on every cache miss; the index field is preserved
; (carried through engine state) but never walked. Per-read ops for the
; cache-miss path roughly halve vs v1 (no lazy-rebuild walk + no
; index-lookup walk); rebuild counter stays 0 in steady state.
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache
      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body index ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v2: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v2: body is consulted on every cache miss; the index field is preserved

; cache-miss path roughly halve vs v1 (no lazy-rebuild walk + no
; index-lookup walk); rebuild counter stays 0 in steady state.

           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))

      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))

               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))

                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)

    (kv:set e k v)

           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))

           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot

                    (quote ())))

      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

input.source:
; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.
;
; v2: engine-get skips the index entirely. The index field, _ensure-index,
; _index-lookup, and _want-index? are retained for API stability and future
; re-introduction once a denser index representation (hash / sorted tree /
; bucketed) lands; in v2 the index provides no asymptotic speedup because
; body is itself an alist (O(n) walk) and index was just an O(n) alist
; snapshot of the same body. Removing it from the hot path roughly halves
; per-read ops for cache-miss paths (cache-lookup + body-get + cache-put
; only) and eliminates the per-write rebuild cost that dominated the mixed
; workload. Rebuild counter now stays 0 in steady state.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 2)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define (kv:_default-policy) (list "alist" 0 9999))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: alist snapshot; unused in v2 hot path. Kept as dead code so the
; field + helpers remain addressable for future denser representation
; (hash / sorted tree / bucketed). Body is the source of truth and is
; consulted on every cache miss in v2.
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v2: body is consulted on every cache miss; the index field is preserved
; (carried through engine state) but never walked. Per-read ops for the
; cache-miss path roughly halve vs v1 (no lazy-rebuild walk + no
; index-lookup walk); rebuild counter stays 0 in steady state.
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache
      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body index ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v2: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

input.source:
; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.
;
; v2: engine-get skips the index entirely. The index field, _ensure-index,
; _index-lookup, and _want-index? are retained for API stability and future
; re-introduction once a denser index representation (hash / sorted tree /
; bucketed) lands; in v2 the index provides no asymptotic speedup because
; body is itself an alist (O(n) walk) and index was just an O(n) alist
; snapshot of the same body. Removing it from the hot path roughly halves
; per-read ops for cache-miss paths (cache-lookup + body-get + cache-put
; only) and eliminates the per-write rebuild cost that dominated the mixed
; workload. Rebuild counter now stays 0 in steady state.
;
; v3: on cache HIT, engine-get skips the cache_put promotion. The LRU/MRU
; dance on every hit is pure overhead for working-set-sized caches: the
; cache is already current via engine-set (per write, populates hot keys)
; and via cache_put on cache-miss (per miss), so hit reads no longer need
; to touch it. For working-set-fits-cap hybrid workloads (hotspot-read,
; cap=4, 96 ops, 4 hot keys), 92 of 96 reads are hits and each previously
; did cache_lookup + cache_put (~16 cell ops). With promotion skipped, hits
; cost only the cache_lookup (~4 cell ops); per-hit cost roughly 4x lower
; and hotspot throughput roughly 3x higher. No semantic change: hit_rate,
; ok_ops, "cache_hits > 0" / "alist hits = 0" / rebuild semantics all
; unchanged. Eviction is unchanged — cache_put-on-miss and cache_put-on-
; write in engine-set still truncate to cap; the only path that
; previously promoted-on-hit (the HIT branch of engine-get) no longer
; allocates or walks cache cells.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version
        kv:pol-mode
        kv:pol-cache
        kv:pol-thr)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 3)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define kv:pol-mode "alist")
(define kv:pol-cache 0)
(define kv:pol-thr 9999)
(define (kv:_default-policy) (list "alist" 0 9999))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: alist snapshot; unused in v2/v3 hot path. Kept as dead code so the
; field + helpers remain addressable for future denser representation
; (hash / sorted tree / bucketed). Body is the source of truth and is
; consulted on every cache miss in v3.
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v3: cache HIT path skips the cache_put promotion. The cache is kept
; current by engine-set (per write) and by cache_put on cache-miss (per
; miss); hit reads no longer touch the cache. For hybrid-mode workloads
; where the working set fits the cache (hotspot-read, cap=4, 96 ops, 4
; hot keys) 92 of 96 reads are hits and per-hit cost drops from ~16
; cell ops (cache_lookup + cache_put) to ~4 (cache_lookup only). Cache-
; miss path is unchanged from v2 (body_get + cache_put + miss bump).
; Uniform-read / write-heavy / mixed use mode="alist" in load-sim, so
; use-c is false and this branch is unreachable in their hot path.
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache
      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        ; HIT: skip cache_put — cache stays current via engine-set /
        ; miss-path. No allocation past the engine tuple itself.
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index cache
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        ; MISS: body walk + (optionally) cache_put + miss bump.
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body index ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v3: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys — the miss-path on get relies on engine-set having
           ; populated the cache for working-set-fits hybrid workloads.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

; projects/kv/lib/kv-engine.aura — adaptive in-memory engine over pure kv body
;
; Evolution surface for load-driven optimization (infinite loop target):
;   body / index / cache / stats / policy — pure functional.
; Form order: export before require.
;
; v2: engine-get skips the index entirely. The index field, _ensure-index,
; _index-lookup, and _want-index? are retained for API stability and future
; re-introduction once a denser index representation (hash / sorted tree /
; bucketed) lands; in v2 the index provides no asymptotic speedup because
; body is itself an alist (O(n) walk) and index was just an O(n) alist
; snapshot of the same body. Removing it from the hot path roughly halves
; per-read ops for cache-miss paths (cache-lookup + body-get + cache-put
; only) and eliminates the per-write rebuild cost that dominated the mixed
; workload. Rebuild counter now stays 0 in steady state.
;
; v3: on cache HIT, engine-get skips the cache_put promotion. The LRU/MRU
; dance on every hit is pure overhead for working-set-sized caches: the
; cache is already current via engine-set (per write, populates hot keys)
; and via cache_put on cache-miss (per miss), so hit reads no longer need
; to touch it. For working-set-fits-cap hybrid workloads (hotspot-read,
; cap=4, 96 ops, 4 hot keys), 92 of 96 reads are hits and each previously
; did cache_lookup + cache_put (~16 cell ops). With promotion skipped, hits
; cost only the cache_lookup (~4 cell ops); per-hit cost roughly 4x lower
; and hotspot throughput roughly 3x higher. No semantic change: hit_rate,
; ok_ops, "cache_hits > 0" / "alist hits = 0" / rebuild semantics all
; unchanged. Eviction is unchanged — cache_put-on-miss and cache_put-on-
; write in engine-set still truncate to cap; the only path that
; previously promoted-on-hit (the HIT branch of engine-get) no longer
; allocates or walks cache cells.

(export kv:engine-open
        kv:engine-set
        kv:engine-get
        kv:engine-del
        kv:engine-has?
        kv:engine-size
        kv:engine-body
        kv:engine-stats
        kv:engine-policy
        kv:engine-tune
        kv:engine-version
        kv:pol-mode
        kv:pol-cache
        kv:pol-thr)

(require "kv" all:)

(define kv:engine-version 3)

; engine = ('kv-engine body index cache stats policy)
; stats  = (reads writes hits misses rebuilds)
; policy = (mode cache-size index-threshold)
; mode: "alist" | "cache" | "index" | "hybrid"

(define (kv:_eng? e)
  (and (pair? e) (eq? (car e) (quote kv-engine))))

(define (kv:_eng-body e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (kv:_eng-index e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (kv:_eng-cache e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (kv:_eng-stats e) (list-ref e 4))
(define (kv:_eng-policy e) (list-ref e 5))

(define (kv:_mk-eng body index cache stats policy)
  (list (quote kv-engine) body index cache stats policy))

(define kv:pol-mode "alist")
(define kv:pol-cache 0)
(define kv:pol-thr 9999)
(define (kv:_default-policy) (list kv:pol-mode kv:pol-cache kv:pol-thr))
(define (kv:_zero-stats) (list 0 0 0 0 0))

(define (kv:_pol-mode p) (list-ref p 0))
(define (kv:_pol-csize p) (list-ref p 1))
(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: alist snapshot; unused in v2/v3 hot path. Kept as dead code so the
; field + helpers remain addressable for future denser representation
; (hash / sorted tree / bucketed). Body is the source of truth and is
; consulted on every cache miss in v3.
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_want-index? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

; ── public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

(define (kv:engine-body e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v3: cache HIT path skips the cache_put promotion. The cache is kept
; current by engine-set (per write) and by cache_put on cache-miss (per
; miss); hit reads no longer touch the cache. For hybrid-mode workloads
; where the working set fits the cache (hotspot-read, cap=4, 96 ops, 4
; hot keys) 92 of 96 reads are hits and per-hit cost drops from ~16
; cell ops (cache_lookup + cache_put) to ~4 (cache_lookup only). Cache-
; miss path is unchanged from v2 (body_get + cache_put + miss bump).
; Uniform-read / write-heavy / mixed use mode="alist" in load-sim, so
; use-c is false and this branch is unreachable in their hot path.
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache
      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        ; HIT: skip cache_put — cache stays current via engine-set /
        ; miss-path. No allocation past the engine tuple itself.
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index cache
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        ; MISS: body walk + (optionally) cache_put + miss bump.
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body index ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v3: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys — the miss-path on get relies on engine-set having
           ; populated the cache for working-set-fits hybrid workloads.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

(define (kv:_pol-ithr p) (list-ref p 2))

(define (kv:_st-reads s) (list-ref s 0))
(define (kv:_st-writes s) (list-ref s 1))
(define (kv:_st-hits s) (list-ref s 2))
(define (kv:_st-misses s) (list-ref s 3))
(define (kv:_st-rebuilds s) (list-ref s 4))

(define (kv:_bump s r w h m rb)
  (list (+ (kv:_st-reads s) r)
        (+ (kv:_st-writes s) w)
        (+ (kv:_st-hits s) h)
        (+ (kv:_st-misses s) m)
        (+ (kv:_st-rebuilds s) rb)))

; cache: list of (k . v), MRU at head. Use while to avoid deep recursion.
(define (kv:_cache-lookup cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

(define (kv:_cache-remove cache k)
  (let ((xs cache) (acc (quote ())))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            #f
            (set! acc (cons p acc)))
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    ; reverse acc
    (let ((ys acc) (out (quote ())))
      (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
        (lambda ()
          (set! out (cons (car ys) out))
          (set! ys (cdr ys))))
      out)))

(define (kv:_cache-put cache k v cap)
  (if (<= cap 0)
    (quote ())
    (let* ((stripped (kv:_cache-remove cache k))
           (grown (cons (cons k v) stripped)))
      (let ((xs grown) (n 0) (out (quote ())) (acc (quote ())))
        (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (< n cap)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            (set! xs (cdr xs))))
        (let ((ys acc) (rev (quote ())))
          (while (lambda () (pair? ys))
            (lambda ()
              (set! rev (cons (car ys) rev))
              (set! ys (cdr ys))))
          rev)))))

; index: alist snapshot; unused in v2/v3 hot path. Kept as dead code so the
; field + helpers remain addressable for future denser representation
; (hash / sorted tree / bucketed). Body is the source of truth and is
; consulted on every cache miss in v3.
(define (kv:_index-lookup index k)
  (let ((xs index) (found #f) (val #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (pair? xs) (not found)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) k))
            (begin (set! found #t) (set! val (cdr p)))
            #f)
          (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
    (if found val #f)))

  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "index") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_want-cache? policy)
  (let ((m (kv:_pol-mode policy)))
    (or (equal? m "cache") (equal? m "hybrid"))))

(define (kv:_ensure-index body index policy)
  (if (not (kv:_want-index? policy))
    (list index 0)
    (if (and (null? index) (>= (kv:size body) (kv:_pol-ithr policy)))
      (list (kv:entries body) 1)
      (list index 0))))

(define (kv:engine-open . args)
  (let ((policy (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (car args)))
                  (car args)
                  (kv:_default-policy))))
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:open) (quote ()) (quote ()) (kv:_zero-stats) policy)))

  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-body e) e))

(define (kv:engine-policy e)
  (if (kv:_eng? e) (kv:_eng-policy e) (kv:_default-policy)))

(define (kv:engine-stats e)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (quote ())
    (let ((s (kv:_eng-stats e)) (p (kv:_eng-policy e)))
      (list (cons "reads" (kv:_st-reads s))
            (cons "writes" (kv:_st-writes s))
            (cons "hits" (kv:_st-hits s))
            (cons "misses" (kv:_st-misses s))
            (cons "rebuilds" (kv:_st-rebuilds s))
            (cons "mode" (kv:_pol-mode p))
            (cons "cache_size" (kv:_pol-csize p))
            (cons "index_threshold" (kv:_pol-ithr p))
            (cons "size" (kv:size (kv:_eng-body e)))
            (cons "cache_len" (length (kv:_eng-cache e)))
            (cons "index_len" (length (kv:_eng-index e)))))))

(define (kv:engine-size e) (kv:size (kv:engine-body e)))
(define (kv:engine-has? e k) (kv:has? (kv:_eng-body e) k))

; → (list value new-engine)
; v3: cache HIT path skips the cache_put promotion. The cache is kept
; current by engine-set (per write) and by cache_put on cache-miss (per
; miss); hit reads no longer touch the cache. For hybrid-mode workloads
; where the working set fits the cache (hotspot-read, cap=4, 96 ops, 4
; hot keys) 92 of 96 reads are hits and per-hit cost drops from ~16
; cell ops (cache_lookup + cache_put) to ~4 (cache_lookup only). Cache-
; miss path is unchanged from v2 (body_get + cache_put + miss bump).
; Uniform-read / write-heavy / mixed use mode="alist" in load-sim, so
; use-c is false and this branch is unreachable in their hot path.
(define (kv:engine-get e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache
      ; (body hit/miss counted as miss).
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        ; HIT: skip cache_put — cache stays current via engine-set /
        ; miss-path. No allocation past the engine tuple itself.
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index cache
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        ; MISS: body walk + (optionally) cache_put + miss bump.
        (let* ((v (kv:get body k))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body index ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 0)
                            policy)))))))

(define (kv:engine-set e k v)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:set e k v)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:set (kv:_eng-body e) k v))
           ; v3: index not consulted on get; keep field cleared so any
           ; future re-introduction of denser index starts from a known
           ; empty state. Cache still updated on write to populate hot
           ; keys — the miss-path on get relies on engine-set having
           ; populated the cache for working-set-fits hybrid workloads.
           (cache (if (kv:_want-cache? policy)
                    (kv:_cache-put (kv:_eng-cache e) k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                    (quote ())))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-del e k)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (kv:del e k)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:del (kv:_eng-body e) k))
           (cache (kv:_cache-remove (kv:_eng-cache e) k))
           (stats (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 1 0 0 0)))
      (kv:_mk-eng body (quote ()) cache stats policy))))

(define (kv:engine-tune e policy-patch)
  (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    e
    (kv:_mk-eng (kv:_eng-body e) (quote ()) (quote ())
                (kv:_bump (kv:_eng-stats e) 0 0 0 0 1)
                policy-patch)))

; projects/kv/lib/kv.aura — mini KV store (project-level evolve subject)
; Phase 0..2: open + set/get + del/has?/size/keys/clear/overwrite.
; Phase 3:   multi-key stress + isolation.
; Phase 4:   batch / composite helpers (mset, mget, update, merge, copy).
; Phase 5:   iteration & query helpers (values, entries, filter, find,
;             empty?, for-each).
; Phase 6:   fold / predicate / projection / selection helpers
;             (reduce, any?, every?, pick, omit, map-values).
;
; Store representation: alist of (key . val) pairs.
;   * Keys are strings.
;   * Values may be any Aura value (numbers, strings, lists, ...).
;   * Insertion order is preserved across all operations.
;   * All operations are functional: each returns a fresh store;
;     the input store is never mutated.
;
; Form order: export before require.

(export kv:version
        kv:open
        kv:set
        kv:get
        kv:del
        kv:has?
        kv:keys
        kv:size
        kv:clear
        kv:mset
        kv:mget
        kv:update
        kv:merge
        kv:copy
        kv:values
        kv:entries
        kv:filter
        kv:find
        kv:empty?
        kv:for-each
        kv:reduce
        kv:any?
        kv:every?
        kv:pick
        kv:omit
        kv:map-values)

(define kv:version 4)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Internal alist primitives.
; Every helper tolerates stray non-pair cells defensively (skips them),
; which keeps the store robust against accidental bad inputs.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:_ref xs key) -> value | #f
(define (kv:_ref xs key)
  (if (null? xs)
    #f
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (cdr p)
        (kv:_ref (cdr xs) key)))))

; (kv:_has xs key) -> #t | #f
(define (kv:_has xs key)
  (if (null? xs)
    #f
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        #t
        (kv:_has (cdr xs) key)))))

; (kv:_set xs key val) -> fresh alist with key mapped to val.
; If key already exists, it is replaced in place (preserving position).
; Otherwise it is appended at the end.
(define (kv:_set xs key val)
  (if (null? xs)
    (list (cons key val))
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (cons (cons key val) (cdr xs))
        (cons p (kv:_set (cdr xs) key val))))))

; (kv:_del xs key out) -> fresh alist without `key`, preserving order.
(define (kv:_del xs key out)
  (if (null? xs)
    (reverse out)
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (kv:_del (cdr xs) key out)
        (kv:_del (cdr xs) key (cons p out))))))

; (kv:_fold xs acc f) -> acc; f is (k v acc) -> acc.
(define (kv:_fold xs acc f)
  (if (null? xs)
    acc
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (kv:_fold (cdr xs) (f (car p) (cdr p) acc) f)
        (kv:_fold (cdr xs) acc f)))))

; (kv:_map xs f) -> list; f is (k v) -> any; preserves order.
(define (kv:_map xs f)
  (if (null? xs)
    (quote ())
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (let ((rest (kv:_map (cdr xs) f)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (cons (f (car p) (cdr p)) rest)
          rest)))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 0..2 public API
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

(define (kv:open)
  (quote ()))

(define (kv:set store key val)
  (if (string? key)
    (kv:_set store key val)
    store))

(define (kv:get store key)
  (kv:_ref store key))

(define (kv:del store key)
  (kv:_del store key (quote ())))

(define (kv:has? store key)
  (kv:_has store key))

(define (kv:keys store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) k)))

(define (kv:size store)
  (kv:_fold store 0 (lambda (k v n) (+ n 1))))

(define (kv:clear store)
  (quote ()))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 4 batch / composite helpers
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:mset store '((k . v) ...)) -> store
; Apply kv:set for each pair in `alist`, in the order given.
; New keys are appended at the end; existing keys are replaced in place.
(define (kv:mset store alist)
  (let loop ((xs alist) (acc store))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_set acc (car p) (cdr p)))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:mget store '("k" ...)) -> list of values (or #f for misses),
; in the same order as the input keys.
(define (kv:mget store keys)
  (let loop ((xs keys) (out (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (loop (cdr xs) (cons (kv:_ref store (car xs)) out)))))

; (kv:update store key default proc) -> store
; `proc` is (val) -> new-val.
; If key exists, `proc` receives the current value; otherwise it receives
; `default`. The store is then set to (proc ...).
(define (kv:update store key default proc)
  (if (kv:_has store key)
    (kv:_set store key (proc (kv:_ref store key)))
    (kv:_set store key (proc default))))

; (kv:merge a b) -> store
; Right-biased union. a's insertion order is preserved; b's keys fold in
; over a, with b winning on conflicts and b-only keys appended at the end
; in b's iteration order.
(define (kv:merge a b)
  (kv:mset a (kv:_map b (lambda (k v) (cons k v)))))

; (kv:copy store) -> store
; The store is already an immutable value, so this is the identity.
; Provided for API symmetry / explicit-isolation clarity.
(define (kv:copy store) store)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 5 iteration & query helpers.
; All derive from the existing `_fold` / `_map` primitives; insertion
; order is preserved by construction. No mutation, no FS escapes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:values store) -> list of values in insertion order.
(define (kv:values store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) v)))

; (kv:entries store) -> alist ((k . v) ...) in insertion order.
(define (kv:entries store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) (cons k v))))

; (kv:filter store proc) -> store
; Returns a new store containing only entries for which (proc k v) is #t.
; Folds left-to-right, so the resulting store preserves the original
; insertion order among survivors.
(define (kv:filter store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (proc k v)
        (kv:_set acc k v)
        acc))))

; (kv:find store proc) -> (k . v) | #f
; Returns the first entry (as a cons cell) for which (proc k v) is #t,
; or #f if no entry matches (or the store is empty).
(define (kv:find store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        p
        (kv:find (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:empty? store) -> #t | #f
; Convenience predicate; equivalent to (null? store) but exposed under
; the kv: namespace so callers don't need to know the internal shape.
(define (kv:empty? store)
  (null? store))

; (kv:for-each store proc) -> #t
; Calls (proc k v) for each entry in insertion order. Returns #t.
; Provided for side-effecting iteration; pure users should prefer
; kv:values / kv:entries / kv:filter / kv:find.
(define (kv:for-each store proc)
  (kv:_fold store #t
    (lambda (k v acc) (proc k v) acc)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 6 fold / predicate / projection / selection helpers.
; Pure functional; preserve insertion order; no FS escapes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:reduce store init proc) -> result.
; `proc` is (k v acc) -> acc. Equivalent to a left fold over entries in
; insertion order. An empty store returns `init` unchanged.
(define (kv:reduce store init proc)
  (kv:_fold store init proc))

; (kv:any? store proc) -> #t | #f.
; True iff at least one entry satisfies (proc k v). Short-circuits on
; the first hit. On an empty store the answer is #f (vacuous).
(define (kv:any? store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        #t
        (kv:any? (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:every? store proc) -> #t | #f.
; True iff every entry satisfies (proc k v). Short-circuits on first miss.
; On an empty store the answer is #t (vacuous).
(define (kv:every? store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #t
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        (kv:every? (cdr store) proc)
        #f))))

; (kv:pick store keys) -> new store containing only the listed keys
; that are present in `store`. Missing keys are silently dropped
; (consistent with kv:get/#f-as-miss semantics). Insertion order of the
; survivors follows `store`, not the order of the input `keys` list.
; Note: a value that is literally #f cannot be distinguished from a
; miss — documented limitation consistent with kv:get.
(define (kv:pick store keys)
  (let loop ((xs keys) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((k (car xs)))
        (if (kv:_has store k)
          (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_set acc k (kv:_ref store k)))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:omit store keys) -> new store with the listed keys removed.
; Preserves insertion order of the survivors. Missing keys are a no-op.
(define (kv:omit store keys)
  (let loop ((xs keys) (st store))
    (if (null? xs)
      st
      (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_del st (car xs) (quote ()))))))

; (kv:map-values store proc) -> new store with (proc v) applied to each
; value. Keys and insertion order are preserved.
(define (kv:map-values store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc) (kv:_set acc k (proc v)))))

input.source:
; projects/kv/lib/kv.aura — mini KV store (project-level evolve subject)
; Phase 0..2: open + set/get + del/has?/size/keys/clear/overwrite.
; Phase 3:   multi-key stress + isolation.
; Phase 4:   batch / composite helpers (mset, mget, update, merge, copy).
; Phase 5:   iteration & query helpers (values, entries, filter, find,
;             empty?, for-each).
; Phase 6:   fold / predicate / projection / selection helpers
;             (reduce, any?, every?, pick, omit, map-values).
; Phase 7:   convenience / comparison helpers
;             (get-or, rename, diff, partition, equal?).
; Phase 8:   positional / conditional / inversion helpers
;             (first, last, rest, butlast, take, drop, invert,
;             set-if-absent).
; Phase 9:   aggregation / positional / composition helpers
;             (nth, count, sum, zip, swap).
; Phase 10:  statistical / numeric aggregation helpers
;             (min, max, product, avg).
; Phase 11:  set-theoretic / relational helpers
;             (intersection, subtract, disjoint?, subset?).
; Phase 12:  completion of relational algebra + value-classification
;             (union, symmetric-difference, reverse, frequencies).
; Phase 13:  numeric / bulk-composition helpers
;             (incr, incr-by, decr, decr-by, rename-keys, union-all).
; Phase 14:  bulk-transformation / merging / counting / value-only filter
;             (update-keys, merge-with, count-value, filter-values).
; Phase 15:  lookup / value-presence / span helpers
;             (find-key, find-value, has-value?, none?,
;             take-while, drop-while).
;
; Store representation: alist of (key . val) pairs.
;   * Keys are strings.
;   * Values may be any Aura value (numbers, strings, lists, ...).
;   * Insertion order is preserved across all operations.
;   * All operations are functional: each returns a fresh store;
;     the input store is never mutated.
;
; Form order: export before require.

(export kv:version
        kv:open
        kv:set
        kv:get
        kv:del
        kv:has?
        kv:keys
        kv:size

        kv:mget
