(define kv:version 16)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Internal alist primitives.
; Every helper tolerates stray non-pair cells defensively (skips them),
; which keeps the store robust against accidental bad inputs.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:_ref xs key) -> value | #f
(define (kv:_ref xs key)
  (if (null? xs)
    #f
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (cdr p)
        (kv:_ref (cdr xs) key)))))

; (kv:_has xs key) -> #t | #f
(define (kv:_has xs key)
  (if (null? xs)
    #f
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        #t
        (kv:_has (cdr xs) key)))))

; (kv:_set xs key val) -> fresh alist with key mapped to val.
; If key already exists, it is replaced in place (preserving position).
; Otherwise it is appended at the end.
(define (kv:_set xs key val)
  (if (null? xs)
    (list (cons key val))
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (cons (cons key val) (cdr xs))
        (cons p (kv:_set (cdr xs) key val))))))

; (kv:_del xs key out) -> fresh alist without `key`, preserving order.
(define (kv:_del xs key out)
  (if (null? xs)
    (reverse out)
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (equal? (car p) key))
        (kv:_del (cdr xs) key out)
        (kv:_del (cdr xs) key (cons p out))))))

; (kv:_fold xs acc f) -> acc; f is (k v acc) -> acc.
(define (kv:_fold xs acc f)
  (if (null? xs)
    acc
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (kv:_fold (cdr xs) (f (car p) (cdr p) acc) f)
        (kv:_fold (cdr xs) acc f)))))

; (kv:_map xs f) -> list; f is (k v) -> any; preserves order.
(define (kv:_map xs f)
  (if (null? xs)
    (quote ())
    (let ((p (car xs)))
      (let ((rest (kv:_map (cdr xs) f)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (cons (f (car p) (cdr p)) rest)
          rest)))))

; (kv:_mem key xs) -> #t | #f.
; True iff `key` appears in list `xs` (compared with equal?).
; Internal helper; not exported. Used by kv:pick to test whether a
; store key is among the requested keys without leaking membership-test
; semantics into the public namespace.
(define (kv:_mem key xs)
  (if (null? xs)
    #f
    (if (equal? (car xs) key)
      #t
      (kv:_mem key (cdr xs)))))

; (kv:_append a b) -> concatenation of lists a and b.
; Classic cons-list concat: walks a, consing each cell onto the
; recursive concat of (cdr a) and b. Internal helper, not exported —
; introduced for Phase 16's kv:sort-by, which needs to splice a new
; entry into the middle of a sorted accumulator while preserving
; stability. Defined here (rather than depending on a host `append`)
; to keep the lib self-contained and portable across Aura hosts.
; Non-pair cells in `a` are preserved as elements (cons propagates
; whatever the car is); `b` is returned as-is when `a` is null.
(define (kv:_append a b)
  (if (null? a)
    b
    (cons (car a) (kv:_append (cdr a) b))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 0..2 public API
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

(define (kv:open)
  (quote ()))

(define (kv:set store key val)
  (if (string? key)
    (kv:_set store key val)
    store))

(define (kv:get store key)
  (kv:_ref store key))

(define (kv:del store key)
  (kv:_del store key (quote ())))

(define (kv:has? store key)
  (kv:_has store key))

(define (kv:keys store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) k)))

(define (kv:size store)
  (kv:_fold store 0 (lambda (k v n) (+ n 1))))

(define (kv:clear store)
  (quote ()))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 4 batch / composite helpers
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:mset store '((k . v) ...)) -> store
; Apply kv:set for each pair in `alist`, in the order given.
; New keys are appended at the end; existing keys are replaced in place.
(define (kv:mset store alist)
  (let loop ((xs alist) (acc store))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_set acc (car p) (cdr p)))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:mget store '("k" ...)) -> list of values (or #f for misses),
; in the same order as the input keys.
(define (kv:mget store keys)
  (let loop ((xs keys) (out (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (loop (cdr xs) (cons (kv:_ref store (car xs)) out)))))

; (kv:update store key default proc) -> store
; `proc` is (val) -> new-val.
; If key exists, `proc` receives the current value; otherwise it receives
; `default`. The store is then set to (proc ...).
(define (kv:update store key default proc)
  (if (kv:_has store key)
    (kv:_set store key (proc (kv:_ref store key)))
    (kv:_set store key (proc default))))

; (kv:merge a b) -> store
; Right-biased union. a's insertion order is preserved; b's keys fold in
; over a, with b winning on conflicts and b-only keys appended at the end
; in b's iteration order.
(define (kv:merge a b)
  (kv:mset a (kv:_map b (lambda (k v) (cons k v)))))

; (kv:copy store) -> store
; The store is already an immutable value, so this is the identity.
; Provided for API symmetry / explicit-isolation clarity.
(define (kv:copy store) store)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 5 iteration & query helpers.
; All derive from the existing `_fold` / `_map` primitives; insertion
; order is preserved by construction. No mutation, no FS escapes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:values store) -> list of values in insertion order.
(define (kv:values store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) v)))

; (kv:entries store) -> alist ((k . v) ...) in insertion order.
(define (kv:entries store)
  (kv:_map store (lambda (k v) (cons k v))))

; (kv:filter store proc) -> store
; Returns a new store containing only entries for which (proc k v) is #t.
; Folds left-to-right, so the resulting store preserves the original
; insertion order among survivors.
(define (kv:filter store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (proc k v)
        (kv:_set acc k v)
        acc))))

; (kv:find store proc) -> (k . v) | #f
; Returns the first entry (as a cons cell) for which (proc k v) is #t,
; or #f if no entry matches (or the store is empty).
(define (kv:find store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        p
        (kv:find (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:empty? store) -> #t | #f
; Convenience predicate; equivalent to (null? store) but exposed under
; the kv: namespace so callers don't need to know the internal shape.
(define (kv:empty? store)
  (null? store))

; (kv:for-each store proc) -> #t
; Calls (proc k v) for each entry in insertion order. Returns #t.
; Provided for side-effecting iteration; pure users should prefer
; kv:values / kv:entries / kv:filter / kv:find.
(define (kv:for-each store proc)
  (kv:_fold store #t
    (lambda (k v acc) (proc k v) acc)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 6 fold / predicate / projection / selection helpers.
; Pure functional; preserve insertion order; no FS escapes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:reduce store init proc) -> result.
; `proc` is (k v acc) -> acc. Equivalent to a left fold over entries in
; insertion order. An empty store returns `init` unchanged.
(define (kv:reduce store init proc)
  (kv:_fold store init proc))

; (kv:any? store proc) -> #t | #f.
; True iff at least one entry satisfies (proc k v). Short-circuits on
; the first hit. On an empty store the answer is #f (vacuous).
(define (kv:any? store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        #t
        (kv:any? (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:every? store proc) -> #t | #f.
; True iff every entry satisfies (proc k v). Short-circuits on first miss.
; On an empty store the answer is #t (vacuous).
(define (kv:every? store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #t
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        (kv:every? (cdr store) proc)
        #f))))

; (kv:pick store keys) -> new store containing only the listed keys
; that are present in `store`. Missing keys are silently dropped
; (consistent with kv:get/#f-as-miss semantics). Insertion order of the
; survivors follows `store`, not the order of the input `keys` list.
; Note: a value that is literally #f cannot be distinguished from a
; miss — documented limitation consistent with kv:get.
(define (kv:pick store keys)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_mem k keys)
        (kv:_set acc k v)
        acc))))

; (kv:omit store keys) -> new store with the listed keys removed.
; Preserves insertion order of the survivors. Missing keys are a no-op.
(define (kv:omit store keys)
  (let loop ((xs keys) (st store))
    (if (null? xs)
      st
      (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_del st (car xs) (quote ()))))))

; (kv:map-values store proc) -> new store with (proc v) applied to each
; value. Keys and insertion order are preserved.
(define (kv:map-values store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (kv:_set acc k (proc v)))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 7 convenience / comparison helpers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:get-or store key default) -> value-or-default.
; Uses kv:_has so a stored #f is distinguishable from a miss (consistent
; with kv:equal?'s documented behaviour).
(define (kv:get-or store key default)
  (if (kv:_has store key)
    (kv:_ref store key)
    default))

; (kv:rename store old new) -> store.
; Replaces key `old` with `new`, preserving position. Refuses (returns
; store unchanged) if `old` is missing OR if `new` is already present
; (ambiguity refusal, consistent with kv:swap).
(define (kv:rename store old new)
  (if (kv:_has store old)
    (if (kv:_has store new)
      store
      (kv:_set (kv:_del store old (quote ())) new (kv:_ref store old)))
    store))

; (kv:diff a b) -> (added removed changed).
; Three-way diff between stores `a` (reference) and `b` (current).
;   added   : keys present in b but not in a       (with b's values)
;   removed : keys present in a but not in b       (with a's values)
;   changed : keys present in both whose values differ
;             (with cons a-val . b-val as the new value)
; Insertion order of each sub-store follows the source operand's order.
(define (kv:diff a b)
  (let ((added
          (kv:_fold b (quote ())
            (lambda (k v acc)
              (if (kv:_has a k)
                acc
                (kv:_set acc k v)))))
        (removed
          (kv:_fold a (quote ())
            (lambda (k v acc)
              (if (kv:_has b k)
                acc
                (kv:_set acc k v)))))
        (changed
          (kv:_fold a (quote ())
            (lambda (k va acc)
              (if (kv:_has b k)
                (let ((vb (kv:_ref b k)))
                  (if (equal? va vb)
                    acc
                    (kv:_set acc k (cons va vb))))
                acc)))))
    (list added removed changed)))

; (kv:partition store proc) -> (match . nomatch).
; Splits `store` into two sub-stores: `match` holds entries for which
; (proc k v) is #t, `nomatch` holds the rest. Insertion order is
; preserved within each sub-store (single fold over source, in source
; order). Returns a cons cell (not a list) — (match . nomatch).
(define (kv:partition store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (cons (quote ()) (quote ()))
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (let ((m (car acc)) (n (cdr acc)))
        (if (proc k v)
          (cons (kv:_set m k v) n)
          (cons m (kv:_set n k v)))))))

; (kv:equal? a b) -> #t | #f.
; Structural equality ignoring insertion order: same size, same key
; multiset, same per-key values (compared with equal?). A stored #f
; value is distinguished from a miss (uses kv:_has, not kv:_ref).
(define (kv:equal? a b)
  (let ((ak (kv:keys a)))
    (and (= (kv:size a) (kv:size b))
         (let loop ((xs ak))
           (if (null? xs)
             #t
             (let ((k (car xs)))
               (if (and (kv:_has b k) (equal? (kv:_ref a k) (kv:_ref b k)))
                 (loop (cdr xs))
                 #f)))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 8 positional / conditional / inversion helpers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:first store) -> (k . v) | #f.
; First entry (as a cons cell) in insertion order, or #f on empty.
; Skips non-pair cells defensively (they are not real entries).
(define (kv:first store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (pair? p) p (kv:first (cdr store))))))

; (kv:last store) -> (k . v) | #f.
; Last entry in insertion order, or #f on empty. Skips non-pair cells.
(define (kv:last store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let loop ((xs store))
      (let ((p (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (if (null? rest)
          (if (pair? p) p #f)
          (loop rest))))))

; (kv:rest store) -> store minus first entry.
; Returns the empty store on an empty input. Skips non-pair cells in
; the dropped prefix.
(define (kv:rest store)
  (if (null? store)
    (quote ())
    (let loop ((xs store))
      (if (null? xs)
        (quote ())
        (let ((p (car xs)))
          (if (pair? p)
            (kv:_del xs (car p) (quote ()))
            (loop (cdr xs))))))))

; (kv:butlast store) -> store minus last entry.
; Returns the empty store on a 0- or 1-element input.
(define (kv:butlast store)
  (reverse (cdr (reverse store))))

; (kv:take store n) -> first n entries (positional).
; Skips non-pair cells in the prefix-walk; pads with nothing if n
; exceeds the count of pair-cells in the source. On n=0 returns ().
(define (kv:take store n)
  (if (= n 0)
    (quote ())
    (if (null? store)
      (quote ())
      (let ((p (car store)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (cons p (kv:take (cdr store) (- n 1)))
          (kv:take (cdr store) n))))))

; (kv:drop store n) -> store minus first n entries (positional).
; Skips non-pair cells in the dropped prefix. On n=0 returns store.
(define (kv:drop store n)
  (if (= n 0)
    store
    (if (null? store)
      (quote ())
      (let ((p (car store)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (kv:drop (cdr store) (- n 1))
          (kv:drop (cdr store) n))))))

; (kv:invert store) -> store with keys and values swapped.
; First-occurrence wins on collisions (multiple keys mapping to the
; same value: the first such key in insertion order wins). Uses
; kv:_set directly (no string?-key guard) because the new keys are
; caller-supplied projections, not fresh kv:set writes — same posture
; as kv:update-keys.
(define (kv:invert store)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_has acc v)
        acc
        (kv:_set acc v k)))))

; (kv:set-if-absent store key val) -> store.
; Sets key -> val only if `key` is currently absent. No-op when key
; is already present. Insertion order unchanged on the no-op path.
(define (kv:set-if-absent store key val)
  (if (kv:_has store key)
    store
    (kv:_set store key val)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 9 aggregation / positional / composition helpers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:nth store n) -> (k . v) | #f.
; 0-indexed positional access. Returns the nth pair in insertion
; order, or #f if n is out of range or the store is empty. Skips
; non-pair cells defensively.
(define (kv:nth store n)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (= n 0)
        (if (pair? p) p #f)
        (kv:nth (cdr store) (- n 1))))))

; (kv:count store proc) -> integer.
; Number of entries for which (proc k v) is #t. Returns 0 on empty.
; Single fold over source; no intermediate filter allocation.
(define (kv:count store proc)
  (kv:_fold store 0
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (proc k v) (+ acc 1) acc))))

; (kv:sum store) -> integer.
; Sum of all values in insertion order. Empty store -> 0. Non-numeric
; values would error at the host's `+`; this is intentional (callers
; are responsible for numeric value classes — same posture as
; kv:incr-by / kv:product / kv:avg).
(define (kv:sum store)
  (kv:_fold store 0
    (lambda (k v acc) (+ acc v))))

; (kv:zip a b) -> store.
; Cross-product merge: for each key present in BOTH `a` and `b`,
; writes (cons a-v b-v) as the new value. Keys present in only one
; side are dropped (this is the relational-algebra "join" semantics,
; not a union — consistent with kv:intersection / kv:merge-with).
; Insertion order follows `a` for the shared keys.
(define (kv:zip a b)
  (kv:_fold a (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_has b k)
        (kv:_set acc k (cons v (kv:_ref b k)))
        acc))))

; (kv:swap store k1 k2) -> store.
; Swaps the values of k1 and k2. Returns store unchanged (no-op) if
; either key is absent — refusing ambiguous writes (consistent with
; kv:rename). When k1 == k2 the operation is also a no-op (identity).
(define (kv:swap store k1 k2)
  (if (and (kv:_has store k1) (kv:_has store k2))
    (let ((v1 (kv:_ref store k1)) (v2 (kv:_ref store k2)))
      (kv:_set (kv:_set store k1 v2) k2 v1))
    store))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 10 statistical / numeric aggregation helpers.
; All compare values with `<` (matches kv:min / kv:max semantics).
; Returns #f on an empty store so callers can distinguish "no data"
; from "value is literally 0" — consistent with kv:find's #f sentinel.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:min store) -> smallest value | #f.
; First-occurrence wins on ties (matches kv:invert / kv:update-keys
; "earlier position wins" rule).
(define (kv:min store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (let loop ((xs (cdr store)) (best (cdr p)))
          (if (null? xs)
            best
            (let ((q (car xs)))
              (if (and (pair? q) (< (cdr q) best))
                (loop (cdr xs) (cdr q))
                (loop (cdr xs) best)))))
        #f))))

; (kv:max store) -> largest value | #f.
; First-occurrence wins on ties.
(define (kv:max store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (let loop ((xs (cdr store)) (best (cdr p)))
          (if (null? xs)
            best
            (let ((q (car xs)))
              (if (and (pair? q) (< best (cdr q)))
                (loop (cdr xs) (cdr q))
                (loop (cdr xs) best)))))
        #f))))

; (kv:product store) -> product of values (1 on empty store).
(define (kv:product store)
  (kv:_fold store 1
    (lambda (k v acc) (* acc v))))

; (kv:avg store) -> mean of values | #f.
; Returns the arithmetic mean (sum / size). Returns #f on empty so
; callers can distinguish "no data" from "value is literally 0".
(define (kv:avg store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (/ (kv:sum store) (kv:size store))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 11 set-theoretic / relational helpers.
; Insertion order of the LEFT operand is preserved for shared /
; retained keys; right-only elements are appended at the end in
; right's order (where applicable).
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:intersection a b) -> store of keys present in BOTH operands.
; For shared keys, the value is taken from `b` (right-biased on the
; value axis). Insertion order follows `a`.
(define (kv:intersection a b)
  (kv:_fold a (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_has b k)
        (kv:_set acc k (kv:_ref b k))
        acc))))

; (kv:subtract a b) -> store of keys in `a` but not in `b`.
; a's insertion order preserved.
(define (kv:subtract a b)
  (kv:_fold a (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_has b k)
        acc
        (kv:_set acc k v)))))

; (kv:disjoint? a b) -> #t iff a and b share no keys.
(define (kv:disjoint? a b)
  (not (kv:any? a (lambda (k v) (kv:_has b k)))))

; (kv:subset? a b) -> #t iff every key in `a` is in `b` with equal
; value (compared with equal?). An empty `a` is a subset of any `b`
; (vacuous truth, via kv:every?).
(define (kv:subset? a b)
  (kv:every? a (lambda (k v)
    (and (kv:_has b k) (equal? v (kv:_ref b k))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 12 completion of relational algebra + value-classification.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:union a b) -> store.
; Set union. For keys present in both operands, `a`'s value wins (left-
; biased on the value axis); for keys present only in `b`, the value
; is taken from `b`. Insertion order: `a`'s order is preserved, then
; `b`-only keys are appended at the end in `b`'s iteration order.
(define (kv:union a b)
  (kv:_fold b a
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (kv:_has a k)
        acc
        (kv:_set acc k v)))))

; (kv:symmetric-difference a b) -> store.
; Keys present in exactly one of `a` or `b`. Insertion order: keys
; from `a` first (in `a`'s order), then keys from `b` (in `b`'s order).
; Built as the union of (a minus b) and (b minus a) — both sub-stores
; are constructed in their source's order, then unioned.
(define (kv:symmetric-difference a b)
  (let ((only-a
          (kv:_fold a (quote ())
            (lambda (k v acc)
              (if (kv:_has b k)
                acc
                (kv:_set acc k v)))))
        (only-b
          (kv:_fold b (quote ())
            (lambda (k v acc)
              (if (kv:_has a k)
                acc
                (kv:_set acc k v))))))
    (kv:union only-a only-b)))

; (kv:reverse store) -> store with entries in reverse insertion order.
; Note: this shadows the host's `reverse` for any subsequent internal
; use in this file (e.g., kv:butlast); the implementation is the
; standard cons-list reversal, so the shadowing is behaviour-
; preserving for the rest of the lib.
(define (kv:reverse store)
  (let loop ((xs store) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (loop (cdr xs) (cons p acc))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:frequencies store) -> store of value -> count.
; Counts the number of times each value appears in `store`. Insertion
; order of the result is "first-occurrence order of distinct values
; in the source" (matches kv:invert / kv:update-keys first-occurrence
; semantics). An empty source yields an empty result.
(define (kv:frequencies store)
  (let ((vs (kv:values store)))
    (let loop ((xs vs) (acc (quote ())))
      (if (null? xs)
        acc
        (let ((v (car xs)))
          (if (kv:_has acc v)
            (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_set acc v (+ (kv:_ref acc v) 1)))
            (loop (cdr xs) (kv:_set acc v 1))))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 13 numeric / bulk-composition helpers.
; Counter ops have init semantics: incr-by on a missing key sets the
; key to `amount` (rather than erroring). This matches the canonical
; use-case ("counter" pattern) and the API consumer's expectation.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:incr store key) -> store with key incremented by 1.
; On miss: creates slot with value 1.
(define (kv:incr store key)
  (kv:incr-by store key 1))

; (kv:incr-by store key amount) -> store with key incremented by amount.
; On miss: creates slot with value = amount. Refuses (returns store
; unchanged) if `key` is not a string OR `amount` is not a number —
; consistent with the documented "guarded counter" semantics tested by
; T65 / T66.
(define (kv:incr-by store key amount)
  (if (and (string? key) (number? amount))
    (if (kv:_has store key)
      (let ((v (kv:_ref store key)))
        (if (number? v)
          (kv:_set store key (+ v amount))
          store))
      (kv:_set store key amount))
    store))

; (kv:decr store key) -> store with key decremented by 1.
(define (kv:decr store key)
  (kv:decr-by store key 1))

; (kv:decr-by store key amount) -> store with key decremented by amount.
; On miss: creates slot with value = (- 0 amount).
(define (kv:decr-by store key amount)
  (if (and (string? key) (number? amount))
    (if (kv:_has store key)
      (let ((v (kv:_ref store key)))
        (if (number? v)
          (kv:_set store key (- v amount))
          store))
      (kv:_set store key (- 0 amount)))
    store))

; (kv:rename-keys store alist) -> store.
; Apply a list of (old . new) renames in order. Each rename has the
; same semantics as kv:rename (refuses when old is missing OR new is
; already present). Because each rename uses kv:rename internally,
; chained renames ARE supported: a rename introduced by an earlier
; pair is visible to later pairs (because the intermediate result
; replaces the source for the next rename).
(define (kv:rename-keys store alist)
  (let loop ((xs alist) (acc store))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (let ((old (car p)) (new (cdr p)))
            (loop (cdr xs) (kv:rename acc old new)))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:union-all stores) -> store.
; Fold kv:union over a list of stores left-to-right. Each successive
; store's values win on shared keys (right-biased). Non-pair cells in
; `stores` are skipped defensively.
(define (kv:union-all stores)
  (let loop ((xs stores) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((s (car xs)))
        (if (pair? s)
          (loop (cdr xs) (kv:union acc s))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 14 bulk-transformation / merging / counting / value-only filter.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:update-keys store proc) -> store.
; Apply (proc k) to each key. Folds `store` left-to-right in
; insertion order; for each (k, v), computes (new-k = (proc k)) and
; (if new-k is not already in the accumulator) writes (new-k -> v)
; into acc. First occurrence wins on collisions (matches kv:invert).
; Insertion order of the result tracks the source's order.
(define (kv:update-keys store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (let ((new-k (proc k)))
        (if (kv:_has acc new-k)
          acc
          (kv:_set acc new-k v))))))

; (kv:merge-with a b proc) -> store.
; Right-biased merge with caller-supplied combiner. For each key
; shared between `a` and `b`, writes (proc a-v b-v) as the new value.
; For each `a`-only key, writes `a`'s value as-is. For each `b`-only
; key, writes `b`'s value at the end in `b`'s iteration order.
; `proc` is called only for keys present in BOTH operands; for
; disjoint operands the result is identical to kv:union.
(define (kv:merge-with a b proc)
  (let ((base
          (kv:_fold a (quote ())
            (lambda (k va acc)
              (if (kv:_has b k)
                (kv:_set acc k (proc va (kv:_ref b k)))
                (kv:_set acc k va))))))
    (kv:_fold b base
      (lambda (k vb acc)
        (if (kv:_has a k)
          acc
          (kv:_set acc k vb))))))

; (kv:count-value store val) -> integer.
; Number of entries whose value is structurally equal to `val`. Thin
; wrapper over kv:count — provided for symmetry with kv:has?
; (key-presence).
(define (kv:count-value store val)
  (kv:count store (lambda (k v) (equal? v val))))

; (kv:filter-values store proc) -> store.
; Sub-store of entries for which `(proc v)` is `#t`. Folds `store`
; left-to-right in insertion order; keeps an entry (writing k -> v
; into the accumulator) iff `(proc v)` is `#t`. Complements
; kv:filter (proc k v).
(define (kv:filter-values store proc)
  (kv:_fold store (quote ())
    (lambda (k v acc)
      (if (proc v)
        (kv:_set acc k v)
        acc))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 15 lookup / value-presence / span helpers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:find-key store proc) -> key | #f.
; First key for which (proc k v) is #t. Short-circuits left-to-right;
; #f on miss / empty.
(define (kv:find-key store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        (car p)
        (kv:find-key (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:find-value store proc) -> value | #f.
; First value for which (proc k v) is #t. Short-circuits left-to-right;
; #f on miss / empty.
(define (kv:find-value store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        (cdr p)
        (kv:find-value (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:has-value? store val) -> #t | #f.
; True iff at least one entry's value is structurally equal to val.
(define (kv:has-value? store val)
  (kv:any? store (lambda (k v) (equal? v val))))

; (kv:none? store proc) -> #t | #f.
; True iff no entry satisfies (proc k v). Short-circuits on the first
; hit. Vacuous #t on an empty store.
(define (kv:none? store proc)
  (if (null? store)
    #t
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (and (pair? p) (proc (car p) (cdr p)))
        #f
        (kv:none? (cdr store) proc)))))

; (kv:take-while store proc) -> store.
; Keep entries (in insertion order) until the first entry for which
; (proc k v) is #f. The boundary belongs to drop-while's side, not
; take-while's. Empty input -> empty output; all-true proc yields the
; whole store.
(define (kv:take-while store proc)
  (let loop ((xs store) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse acc)
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (if (proc (car p) (cdr p))
            (loop (cdr xs) (cons p acc))
            (reverse acc))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:drop-while store proc) -> store.
; Drop entries (in insertion order) while (proc k v) is #t. Returns
; the rest, preserving its original order. Complements kv:take-while.
(define (kv:drop-while store proc)
  (let loop ((xs store))
    (if (null? xs)
      (quote ())
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (if (proc (car p) (cdr p))
            (loop (cdr xs))
            xs)
          (loop (cdr xs)))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Phase 16 ordering / sorting / key-extraction helpers.
; Pure functional; insertion order used as the stable tiebreaker for
; sorting (matches kv:invert / kv:update-keys first-occurrence
; semantics and the "earlier source position wins" rule used by every
; op in the store). No FS escapes; no API renames; no exports
; removed; no internals deleted.
;
; Conventions:
;   * `kv:sort-by` is the primitive; `kv:sort` is
;     `(kv:sort-by s (lambda (k v) v))`. Stability is achieved by
;     scanning the accumulator and inserting the new entry just BEFORE
;     the first existing entry whose sort-key is STRICTLY GREATER than
;     the new entry's sort-key — i.e., the boundary is "first q with
;     (proc q-k q-v) > nk", not ">=". That way, all existing entries
;     with the same sort-key as the new one remain ahead of the new
;     entry, so earlier source position wins on ties (matches
;     kv:invert / kv:update-keys). `kv:_append` is used to splice the
;     new entry into the middle of the sorted prefix without losing
;     cells. Non-pair cells in the source are skipped defensively
;     (they never enter the accumulator in the first place).
;   * `kv:max-key` / `kv:min-key` return the (k . v) entry — not just
;     the key — with the largest / smallest value (compared with `<`,
;     same convention as kv:max / kv:min). First-occurrence wins on
;     ties (the loop only updates `best-p` / `best-v` on a STRICT
;     inequality, matching kv:max / kv:min's first-wins semantics).
;     #f on empty store. Skips non-pair cells defensively.
;   * `kv:compare` is the three-way scalar comparator: -1 / 0 / 1.
;     Uses `equal?` for equality and `<` for the ordering axis. Useful
;     as a comparator passed into a future sort-by-with-compare, and
;     for general three-way branching on comparable scalar values.
;     Behaviour on mixed / non-comparable inputs is host-defined
;     (whatever `<` decides).
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; (kv:sort-by store proc) -> store.
; Sort entries by (proc k v) ascending. Stable: insertion order is the
; tiebreaker — on equal (proc k v), the earlier source entry comes
; first. Implementation: walk source left-to-right; for each entry p,
; compute nk = (proc (car p) (cdr p)) and insert p into the
; accumulator at the correct sorted position. The boundary in the
; accumulator is the first q whose sort-key is STRICTLY GREATER than
; nk; p is inserted just before that q, after all entries with key
; <= nk. This yields source-order stability on ties.
(define (kv:sort-by store proc)
  (let loop ((xs store) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (let ((p (car xs)))
        (if (pair? p)
          (let ((nk (proc (car p) (cdr p))))
            (let lp ((ys acc) (pre (quote ())))
              (if (null? ys)
                (loop (cdr xs)
                      (kv:_append (reverse pre) (cons p (quote ()))))
                (if (< nk (proc (car ys) (cdr ys)))
                  (loop (cdr xs)
                        (kv:_append
                          (kv:_append (reverse pre) (cons p (quote ())))
                          ys))
                  (lp (cdr ys) (cons (car ys) pre))))))
          (loop (cdr xs) acc))))))

; (kv:sort store) -> store.
; Sort by value ascending. Convenience for (kv:sort-by s (lambda (k v) v)).
; Inherits kv:sort-by's stability on ties.
(define (kv:sort store)
  (kv:sort-by store (lambda (k v) v)))

; (kv:max-key store) -> (k . v) | #f.
; Returns the entry with the largest value (compared with `<`).
; First-occurrence wins on ties (matches kv:max). #f on empty store.
(define (kv:max-key store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (let loop ((xs (cdr store)) (best-p p) (best-v (cdr p)))
          (if (null? xs)
            best-p
            (let ((q (car xs)))
              (if (and (pair? q) (< best-v (cdr q)))
                (loop (cdr xs) q (cdr q))
                (loop (cdr xs) best-p best-v)))))
        #f))))

; (kv:min-key store) -> (k . v) | #f.
; Returns the entry with the smallest value (compared with `<`).
; First-occurrence wins on ties (matches kv:min). #f on empty store.
(define (kv:min-key store)
  (if (null? store)
    #f
    (let ((p (car store)))
      (if (pair? p)
        (let loop ((xs (cdr store)) (best-p p) (best-v (cdr p)))
          (if (null? xs)
            best-p
            (let ((q (car xs)))
              (if (and (pair? q) (< (cdr q) best-v))
                (loop (cdr xs) q (cdr q))
                (loop (cdr xs) best-p best-v)))))
        #f))))

; (kv:compare a b) -> -1 | 0 | 1.
; Three-way scalar comparator. -1 if a<b, 0 if (equal? a b), 1 if a>b.
; Uses `equal?` for equality and `<` for the ordering axis (consistent
; with kv:max / kv:min / kv:sort-by). Behaviour on mixed / non-
; comparable inputs is host-defined (whatever `<` decides).
(define (kv:compare a b)
  (if (equal? a b)
    0
    (if (< a b) -1 1)))

; lib/aether-orch.aura — Axis C: multi-proposer arbitration + yield fanout
;
; (require "aether-orch" all:)
;
; Topology: many propose edges → (optional yield fanout) → one arbiter
; → one executor. Public entry points are self-contained (no private free
; helpers): host free-vars break across workspace rebind.
;
; Fanout mode: sequential-with-yield (cooperative parallel topology).
; Host fiber:spawn / orch:parallel can mis-capture closures and leave
; std/orchestrator free-vars unbound after rebind — not used on PASS path.

(export aether:proposal-deny?
        aether:proposal-widen?
        aether:filter-proposals
        aether:arbitrate
        aether:arbiter-skip
        aether:fanout-with-yield
        aether:fanout-mode)

(require "std/list" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)
(require "std/mutate" all:)
(require "aether-propose" all:)

; Cooperative multi-propose: safe-yield before/after each proposer.
; proposers = list of (lambda (input) proposal); no mutation allowed inside.
; → (list mode proposals yield-count)  mode is always "sequential-yield"
(define (aether:fanout-mode) "sequential-yield")

(define (aether:fanout-with-yield proposers input)
  (let ((fs (if (list? proposers) proposers (list proposers))))
    (let loop ((xs fs) (acc (quote ())) (yc 0))
      (if (null? xs)
        (list "sequential-yield" (reverse acc) yc)
        (begin
          (try (mutate:safe-yield) (catch (e) #f))
          (let ((yc1 (+ yc 1)))
            (let ((p (try ((car xs) input) (catch (e) #f))))
              (try (mutate:safe-yield) (catch (e) #f))
              (let ((yc2 (+ yc1 1)))
                (loop (cdr xs) (cons p acc) yc2)))))))))

(define (aether:arbiter-skip reason)
  (list "skip" "gate" "" (if (string? reason) reason "arbiter-skip") "arbiter"))

(define (aether:proposal-deny? p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    #f
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr p)))
      #f
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p)))))
        (and (equal? kind "mutate")
             (string? body)
             (or (string-contains? body "#f")
                 (string-contains? body "deny")))))))

(define (aether:proposal-widen? p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    #f
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr p)))
      #f
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p)))))
        (and (equal? kind "mutate")
             (string? body)
             (string-contains? body "< x 7"))))))

; Schema-valid and non-deny only (inlined deny + valid checks).
(define (aether:filter-proposals proposals)
  (let ((xs (if (list? proposals) proposals (list proposals))))
    (let loop ((ys xs) (acc (quote ())))
      (if (null? ys)
        (reverse acc)
        (let ((p (car ys)))
          (if (not (pair? p))
            (loop (cdr ys) acc)
            (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? p))
              (loop (cdr ys) acc)
              (let ((kind (car p))
                    (body (if (null? (cdr (cdr p))) "" (car (cdr (cdr p))))))
                (if (and (equal? kind "mutate")
                         (string? body)
                         (or (string-contains? body "#f")
                             (string-contains? body "deny")))
                  (loop (cdr ys) acc)
                  (loop (cdr ys) (cons p acc)))))))))))

; Fully inlined score / prefer / source — no private free helpers.
(define (aether:arbitrate proposals budget-ok?)
  (let ((xs0 (if (list? proposals) proposals (list proposals))))
    (let loop-filter ((ys xs0) (acc (quote ())))
      (if (null? ys)
        (let ((cands (reverse acc)))
          (if (null? cands)
            (list "skip" "gate" "" "no-safe-candidate" "arbiter")
            (let loop-pick ((zs (cdr cands)) (best (car cands)))
              (if (null? zs)
                best
                (let ((cand (car zs)))
                  (let ((kind-b (car best))
                        (kind-c (car cand))
                        (body-b (if (null? (cdr (cdr best))) "" (car (cdr (cdr best)))))
                        (body-c (if (null? (cdr (cdr cand))) "" (car (cdr (cdr cand)))))
                        (src-b (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr best)))))
                                 ""
                                 (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr best)))))))
                        (src-c (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr cand)))))
                                 ""
                                 (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr cand))))))))
                    (let ((score-b
                            (if (equal? kind-b "skip")
                              (if budget-ok? 50 10)
                              (if (and (string? body-b) (string-contains? body-b "< x 7"))
                                (if budget-ok? 30 50)
                                (if budget-ok? 20 25))))
                          (score-c
                            (if (equal? kind-c "skip")
                              (if budget-ok? 50 10)
                              (if (and (string? body-c) (string-contains? body-c "< x 7"))
                                (if budget-ok? 30 50)
                                (if budget-ok? 20 25)))))
                      (if (> score-c score-b)
                        (loop-pick (cdr zs) cand)
                        (if (< score-c score-b)
                          (loop-pick (cdr zs) best)
                          (if (equal? src-c "conservative")
                            (loop-pick (cdr zs) cand)
                            (loop-pick (cdr zs) best)))))))))))
        (let ((p (car ys)))
          (if (not (pair? p))
            (loop-filter (cdr ys) acc)
            (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? p))
              (loop-filter (cdr ys) acc)
              (let ((kind (car p))
                    (body (if (null? (cdr (cdr p))) "" (car (cdr (cdr p))))))
                (if (and (equal? kind "mutate")
                         (string? body)
                         (or (string-contains? body "#f")
                             (string-contains? body "deny")))
                  (loop-filter (cdr ys) acc)
                  (loop-filter (cdr ys) (cons p acc)))))))))))

; lib/aether-loop-once.aura — Axis A: aether:loop-once (sole export)
;
; Host H3: large trailing define in multi-export modules can fail to export.
; Keep this module single-export so loop-once always surfaces.
;
; (require "aether-loop-once" all:)
; Prefer (require "aether-min" all:) for the full closed-loop facade.

(export aether:loop-once)

(require "std/list" all:)
(require "aether-measure" all:)
(require "aether-mutate-policy" all:)

; Inlined O→D path (does not free-call aether-loop observe/decide after rebind).
(define (aether:loop-once observe-probe need-mutate? name body summary verify-check)
  (aether:stats-bump! "rounds")
  (aether:stats-bump! "observe-calls")
  (let ((obs (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) (list 'error e)))))
    (if (not (need-mutate?))
      (begin
        (aether:stats-bump! "decide-skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":observation" obs)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate-needed")
              (cons ":snap" -1)))
      (begin
        (aether:stats-bump! "decide-mutate")
        (let ((mut (aether:rebind-safe name body summary)))
          (let ((mut-ok (aether:alist-ref ":ok" mut #f)))
            (let ((snap (aether:alist-ref ":snap" mut -1)))
              (let ((mreason (aether:alist-ref ":reason" mut "refuse")))
                (if (not mut-ok)
                  (begin
                    (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
                    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
                          (cons ":observation" obs)
                          (cons ":reason" mreason)
                          (cons ":snap" snap)))
                  (let ((raw (try (verify-check) (catch (e) #f))))
                    (if (eq? raw #t)
                      (begin
                        (aether:stats-bump! "commits")
                        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                              (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                              (cons ":observation" obs)
                              (cons ":reason" "verified")
                              (cons ":snap" snap)))
                      (begin
                        (aether:stats-bump! "verify-fail")
                        (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
                        (aether:restore snap)
                        (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                              (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                              (cons ":observation" obs)
                              (cons ":reason" "verify-failed")
                              (cons ":snap" snap))))))))))))))

; lib/aether-min.aura — staged reusable surface (experimental on aura-grok CLI)
;
; Prefer examples/01-single-loop/main.aura for denseness evidence today.
; This module packages Axis A+B+F helpers; host issues may still apply:
;   - free-var / export ordering in non-std modules
;   - hash tables across rebind (use list-boxes)
;   - set-code before defining closures that close over boxes
;   - catch bodies must not reference the error variable
;
; (require "aether-min" all:)  ; AURA_PATH must include aether/lib

(export aether:install-source

        aether:snapshot aether:restore aether:rebind-safe
        aether:loop-once)

(require "std/list" all:)
(require "std/mutate" all:)

(define (aether:install-source source)
  (set-code source)

(define *aether-box*
  (list (list 0) (list 0) (list 0) (list 0)
        (list 0) (list 0) (list 0) (list 0)))

(define (aether-box-index key)
  (cond ((equal? key "rounds") 0)
        ((equal? key "commits") 1)
        ((equal? key "rollbacks") 2)
        ((equal? key "verify-fail") 3)
        ((equal? key "observe-calls") 4)
        ((equal? key "decide-mutate") 5)
        ((equal? key "decide-skip") 6)
        ((equal? key "escapes") 7)
        (else -1)))

(define (aether-box-at i)
  (cond ((= i 0) (car *aether-box*))
        ((= i 1) (car (cdr *aether-box*)))
        ((= i 2) (car (cdr (cdr *aether-box*))))
        ((= i 3) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr *aether-box*)))))
        ((= i 4) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr *aether-box*))))))
        ((= i 5) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr *aether-box*)))))))
        ((= i 6) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr *aether-box*))))))))
        ((= i 7) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr *aether-box*)))))))))
        (else (list 0))))

(define (aether:stats-ref key)
  (let ((i (aether-box-index key)))
    (if (< i 0) 0
      (let ((v (car (aether-box-at i))))
        (if (number? v) v 0)))))

(define (aether:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((i (aether-box-index key)))
    (if (< i 0) 0
      (let ((b (aether-box-at i)))
        (set-car! b (+ 1 (car b)))
        (car b)))))

(define (aether:stats-reset!)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 0) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 1) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 2) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 3) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 4) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 5) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 6) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 7) 0)
  #t)

(define (aether:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "rounds" (aether:stats-ref "rounds"))
        (cons "commits" (aether:stats-ref "commits"))
        (cons "rollbacks" (aether:stats-ref "rollbacks"))
        (cons "verify-fail" (aether:stats-ref "verify-fail"))
        (cons "observe-calls" (aether:stats-ref "observe-calls"))
        (cons "decide-mutate" (aether:stats-ref "decide-mutate"))
        (cons "decide-skip" (aether:stats-ref "decide-skip"))
        (cons "escapes" (aether:stats-ref "escapes"))))

(define (aether:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let ((xs lst))
    (let loop ((ys xs))
      (cond ((null? ys) default)
            ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
            (else (loop (cdr ys)))))))

(define (aether:snapshot tag)
  (try
    (let ((id (ast:snapshot tag)))
      (if (number? id) id -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define (aether:restore snap-id)
  (if (and (number? snap-id) (>= snap-id 0))
    (try
      (begin
        (ast:restore snap-id)
        (try (eval-current) (catch (e) #f))
        #t)
      (catch (e) #f))
    #f))

(define (aether:rebind-safe name body summary)
  (let ((snap (aether:snapshot summary)))
    (try (mutate:safe-yield) (catch (e) #f))
    (let ((mut-res
            (try (mutate:rebind name body summary) (catch (e) #f))))
      (if (eq? mut-res #t)
        (let ((ev-ok (try (begin (eval-current) #t) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if ev-ok
            (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                  (cons ":snap" snap)
                  (cons ":reason" "applied"))
            (begin
              (aether:restore snap)
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":snap" snap)
                    (cons ":reason" "eval-failed")))))
        (list (cons ":ok" #f)
              (cons ":snap" snap)
              (cons ":reason" "rebind-failed"))))))

; Decisions as strings (host eq? on symbols is unreliable).
(define (aether:loop-once need-mutate? name body summary verify-check)
  (aether:stats-bump! "rounds")
  (if (not (need-mutate?))
    (begin
      (aether:stats-bump! "decide-skip")
      (list (cons ":ok" #t) (cons ":decision" "skip")))
    (begin
      (aether:stats-bump! "decide-mutate")
      (let ((mut (aether:rebind-safe name body summary)))
        (if (not (aether:alist-ref ":ok" mut #f))
          (begin
            (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
            (list (cons ":ok" #f) (cons ":decision" "refuse")))
          (let ((snap (aether:alist-ref ":snap" mut -1))
                (ok-v (try (if (verify-check) #t #f) (catch (e) #f))))
            (if ok-v
              (begin
                (aether:stats-bump! "commits")
                (list (cons ":ok" #t) (cons ":decision" "commit")))
              (begin
                (aether:stats-bump! "verify-fail")
                (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
                (aether:restore snap)
                (list (cons ":ok" #f) (cons ":decision" "rollback"))))))))))

        ((equal? key "observe-calls") 4)
        ((equal? key "decide-mutate") 5)
        ((equal? key "decide-skip") 6)
        ((equal? key "escapes") 7)
        (else -1)))

(define (aether-box-at i)
  (cond ((= i 0) (car *aether-box*))
        ((= i 1) (car (cdr *aether-box*)))
        ((= i 2) (car (cdr (cdr *aether-box*))))

    (if (< i 0) 0

(define (aether:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((i (aether-box-index key)))

        (car b)))))

  (set-car! (aether-box-at 1) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 2) 0)

  (set-car! (aether-box-at 5) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 6) 0)
  (set-car! (aether-box-at 7) 0)
  #t)

        (cons "commits" (aether:stats-ref "commits"))
        (cons "rollbacks" (aether:stats-ref "rollbacks"))
        (cons "verify-fail" (aether:stats-ref "verify-fail"))

        (cons "decide-mutate" (aether:stats-ref "decide-mutate"))

        (cons "escapes" (aether:stats-ref "escapes"))))

        (try (eval-current) (catch (e) #f))

    (try (mutate:safe-yield) (catch (e) #f))
    (let ((mut-res

                (aether:restore snap)
                (list (cons ":ok" #f) (cons ":decision" "rollback"))))))))))

; lib/aether-min.aura — Phase-1 Aether surface (Axes A + B + F)
;
; (require "aether-min" all:)
; AURA_PATH must include aura lib/ and this aether lib/.
;
; Canonical loop:
;   Observe → Decide → Safe Mutation → Verify → Rollback (if needed)
;
; Host fixes used: #2566 #2567 #2568 #2569 #2570

(export aether:install-source
        aether:stats aether:stats-reset! aether:stats-ref aether:stats-bump!
        aether:stats-alist aether:alist-ref
        aether:safety-ok? aether:snapshot aether:restore aether:rebind-safe
        aether:observe aether:decide aether:verify
        aether:loop-once aether:min-version)

(require "std/list" all:)
(require "std/mutate" all:)

(define aether:min-version 1)

(define (aether:install-source source)
  (set-code source)
  (try (begin (eval-current) #t) (catch (e) #f)))

; ── Axis F: metrology (hash, ≤8 keys) ────────────────────────

(define *aether-stats*
  (hash "rounds" 0
        "commits" 0
        "rollbacks" 0
        "verify-fail" 0
        "observe-calls" 0
        "decide-mutate" 0
        "decide-skip" 0
        "escapes" 0))

(define (aether:stats)
  *aether-stats*)

(define (aether:stats-reset!)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "rounds" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "commits" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "rollbacks" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "verify-fail" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "observe-calls" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "decide-mutate" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "decide-skip" 0)
  (hash-set! *aether-stats* "escapes" 0)
  *aether-stats*)

(define (aether:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (hash-ref *aether-stats* key 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (aether:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (aether:stats-ref key))))
    (hash-set! *aether-stats* key n)
    n))

(define (aether:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "rounds" (aether:stats-ref "rounds"))
        (cons "commits" (aether:stats-ref "commits"))
        (cons "rollbacks" (aether:stats-ref "rollbacks"))
        (cons "verify-fail" (aether:stats-ref "verify-fail"))
        (cons "observe-calls" (aether:stats-ref "observe-calls"))
        (cons "decide-mutate" (aether:stats-ref "decide-mutate"))
        (cons "decide-skip" (aether:stats-ref "decide-skip"))
        (cons "escapes" (aether:stats-ref "escapes"))))

; ── Axis B: mutation policy ──────────────────────────────────

(define (aether:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let ((xs lst))
    (let loop ((ys xs))
      (cond ((null? ys) default)
            ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
            (else (loop (cdr ys)))))))

(define (aether:safety-ok?)
  (try
    (and (mutate:boundary-safe?) (mutate:quota-ok?))
    (catch (e) #f)))

(define (aether:snapshot tag)
  (try
    (let ((id (ast:snapshot tag)))
      (if (number? id) id -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define (aether:restore snap-id)
  (if (and (number? snap-id) (>= snap-id 0))
    (try
      (begin
        (ast:restore snap-id)
        (try (eval-current) (catch (e) #f))
        #t)
      (catch (e) #f))
    #f))

(define (aether:rebind-safe name body summary)
  (if (not (aether:safety-ok?))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":mut-ok" #f)
          (cons ":reason" "boundary-or-quota"))
    (let ((snap (aether:snapshot summary)))
      (try (mutate:safe-yield) (catch (e) #f))
      (let ((mut-res (try (mutate:rebind name body summary) (catch (e) #f))))
        (if (eq? mut-res #t)
          (let ((ev-ok (try (begin (eval-current) #t) (catch (e) #f))))
            (if ev-ok
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":snap" snap)
                    (cons ":mut-ok" #t)
                    (cons ":reason" "applied"))
              (begin
                (aether:restore snap)
                (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                      (cons ":snap" snap)
                      (cons ":mut-ok" #t)
                      (cons ":reason" "eval-failed")))))
          (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                (cons ":snap" snap)
                (cons ":mut-ok" #f)
                (cons ":reason" "rebind-failed")))))))

; ── Axis A: closed loop ──────────────────────────────────────

(define (aether:observe probe)
  (aether:stats-bump! "observe-calls")
  (try (probe) (catch (e) (list 'error e))))

(define (aether:decide need-mutate?)
  (if (need-mutate?)
    (begin (aether:stats-bump! "decide-mutate") 'mutate)
    (begin (aether:stats-bump! "decide-skip") 'skip)))

(define (aether:verify check)
  (try (eq? (check) #t) (catch (e) #f)))

; Split helpers so loop-once body stays small (host module size sensitivity).
(define (aether-result ok decision obs reason snap)
  (list (cons ":ok" ok)
        (cons ":decision" decision)
        (cons ":observation" obs)
        (cons ":reason" reason)
        (cons ":snap" snap)))

(define (aether-after-mut obs mut verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:alist-ref ":ok" mut #f))
    (begin
      (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
      (aether-result #f 'refuse obs
                     (aether:alist-ref ":reason" mut "refuse")
                     (aether:alist-ref ":snap" mut -1)))
    (let ((snap (aether:alist-ref ":snap" mut -1)))
      (let ((raw (try (verify-check) (catch (e) #f))))
        (if (eq? raw #t)
          (begin
            (aether:stats-bump! "commits")
            (aether-result #t 'commit obs "verified" snap))
          (begin
            (aether:stats-bump! "verify-fail")
            (aether:stats-bump! "rollbacks")
            (aether:restore snap)
            (aether-result #f 'rollback obs "verify-failed" snap)))))))

(define (aether:loop-once observe-probe need-mutate? name body summary verify-check)
  (aether:stats-bump! "rounds")
  (let ((obs (aether:observe observe-probe)))
    (let ((dec (aether:decide need-mutate?)))
      (if (eq? dec 'skip)
        (aether-result #t 'skip obs "no-mutate-needed" -1)
        (aether-after-mut obs
                          (aether:rebind-safe name body summary)
                          verify-check)))))

; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose-edge helpers (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposals are untrusted data for the executor:
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind: "mutate" | "skip"
;   source: "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live"
;
; Modes via (aether:propose-mode) reading env AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE:
;   unset / "0" / "rule"  → pure Aura rules (default denseness PASS)
;   "stub"                → pretend LLM path; bumps escapes; no network
;   "1" / "live"          → try std/llm if LLM_API_KEY set; else stub
;
; Executor must remain pure aether-min. Escapes only on this edge.

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source)

(require "aether-min" all:)

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

; Read propose mode from env (void/empty → rule).
(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; Pure rule table — zero escapes.
; fails: number, mode: "auto" | "deny-all" | "noop" | "widen"
; max-fails: business budget threshold
(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (if (equal? mode "deny-all")
    (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) #f)" "rule-deny-all" "rule")
    (if (equal? mode "noop")
      (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule")
      (if (equal? mode "widen")
        (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-widen" "rule")
        (if (> fails max-fails)
          (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-auto-widen" "rule")
          (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))))

; Stub LLM path: same structured proposal as rules, but marks an escape
; on the propose edge (no network). Used for denseness E metering demos.
(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Live LLM: attempt chat; on any failure fall back to stub-shaped rule
; with source llm-live or llm-fallback. Always bumps escapes when entered.
(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
        (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key ""))
          ; no key → structured fallback still on propose edge
          (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
            (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
                  (string-append "llm-nokey:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
                  "llm-live"))
          ; Live call is intentionally minimal: we do not parse free-form
          ; code into production mutations without a schema. For denseness
          ; we record the escape and still return a rule proposal so the
          ; executor path stays deterministic in CI.
          (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
            (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
                  (string-append "llm-live-unparsed:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
                  "llm-live")))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

; Public entry: dispatch by mode.
(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"

;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...

; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body

        aether:proposal-errors

(require "aether-min" all:)

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))

  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))

      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body ")")))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (if (equal? mode "deny-all")
    (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) #f)" "rule-deny-all" "rule")
    (if (equal? mode "noop")
      (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule")
      (if (equal? mode "widen")
        (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-widen" "rule")
        (if (> fails max-fails)
          (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-auto-widen" "rule")
          (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
        (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
          (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key ""))
            (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
                  (string-append "llm-nokey:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
                  "llm-live")
            ; Live path: escape recorded; still emit schema-valid rule
            ; proposal until free-form LLM parse is schema-gated.
            (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
                  (string-append "llm-live-schema:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
                  "llm-live")))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

(lambda (fails max-fails mode) (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY"))
            (fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key ""))
          (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                (string-append "llm-nokey:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr fallback)))))
                "llm-live")
          ; Live chat → parse wire format → schema gate.
          ; If parse/schema fails, fall back to rule proposal (still escaped).
          (let ((raw (try
                       (llm:chat (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                       (catch (e) ""))))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text
                            (if (string? raw) raw "")
                            "llm-live")))
              (if (and parsed (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer first line that contains '|' (wire format); else first non-empty.
(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (let ((parts (string-split s "\n")))
    (let loop ((xs parts) (first-nonempty ""))
      (cond
        ((null? xs) first-nonempty)
        ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs) first-nonempty))
        ((string-contains? (car xs) "|") (car xs))
        (else
         (loop (cdr xs)
               (if (equal? first-nonempty "") (car xs) first-nonempty)))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f

                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (if (equal? mode "deny-all")
    (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) #f)" "rule-deny-all" "rule")
    (if (equal? mode "noop")
      (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule")
      (if (equal? mode "widen")
        (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-widen" "rule")
        (if (> fails max-fails)
          (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-auto-widen" "rule")
          (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY"))
            (fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))

                       (llm:chat (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                       (catch (e) ""))))

                            (if (string? raw) raw "")
                            "llm-live")))

                parsed

                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))

                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)

                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;

; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary

        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt

(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))

(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")

          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)

          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))

        errs))))
