; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;
; Schema validation runs before any mutation. Invalid proposals are
; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source
        aether:proposal-valid?
        aether:proposal-errors
        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt
        aether:execute-proposal)

(require "std/string" all:)
(require "aether-min" all:)

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body ")")))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer first line that contains '|' (wire format); else first non-empty.
(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (let ((parts (string-split s "\n")))
    (let loop ((xs parts) (first-nonempty ""))
      (cond
        ((null? xs) first-nonempty)
        ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs) first-nonempty))
        ((string-contains? (car xs) "|") (car xs))
        (else
         (loop (cdr xs)
               (if (equal? first-nonempty "") (car xs) first-nonempty)))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (if (equal? mode "deny-all")
    (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) #f)" "rule-deny-all" "rule")
    (if (equal? mode "noop")
      (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule")
      (if (equal? mode "widen")
        (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-widen" "rule")
        (if (> fails max-fails)
          (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-auto-widen" "rule")
          (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY"))
            (fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key ""))
          (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                (string-append "llm-nokey:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr fallback)))))
                "llm-live")
          ; Live chat → parse wire format → schema gate.
          ; If parse/schema fails, fall back to rule proposal (still escaped).
          (let ((raw (try
                       (llm:chat (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                       (catch (e) ""))))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text
                            (if (string? raw) raw "")
                            "llm-live")))
              (if (and parsed (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))

     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body ")")))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer first line that contains '|' (wire format); else first non-empty.
(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (let ((parts (string-split s "\n")))
    (let loop ((xs parts) (first-nonempty ""))
      (cond
        ((null? xs) first-nonempty)
        ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs) first-nonempty))
        ((string-contains? (car xs) "|") (car xs))
        (else
         (loop (cdr xs)
               (if (equal? first-nonempty "") (car xs) first-nonempty)))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (if (equal? mode "deny-all")
    (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) #f)" "rule-deny-all" "rule")
    (if (equal? mode "noop")
      (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule")
      (if (equal? mode "widen")
        (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-widen" "rule")
        (if (> fails max-fails)
          (list "mutate" "gate" "(lambda (x) (< x 7))" "rule-auto-widen" "rule")
          (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/llm" all:)
      (let ((key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY"))
            (fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key ""))
          (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                (string-append "llm-nokey:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr fallback)))))
                "llm-live")
          ; Live chat → parse wire format → schema gate.
          ; If parse/schema fails, fall back to rule proposal (still escaped).
          (let ((raw (try
                       (llm:chat (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                       (catch (e) ""))))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text
                            (if (string? raw) raw "")
                            "llm-live")))
              (if (and parsed (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))
    (catch (e)
      (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
        (list (car p) (car (cdr p)) (car (cdr (cdr p)))
              "llm-error-fallback"
              "llm-live")))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;
; Schema validation runs before any mutation. Invalid proposals are
; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source
        aether:proposal-valid?
        aether:proposal-errors
        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt
        aether:execute-proposal)

(require "std/string" all:)
(require "aether-min" all:)
; std/llm is loaded only inside aether-propose-live (keeps offline examples light).

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Strict body: pure lambda on x only — no free calls into workspace.
(define (aether-body-banned? body)
  (or (string-contains? body "gate")
      (string-contains? body "fail-count")
      (string-contains? body "max-fails")
      (string-contains? body "widen")
      (string-contains? body "define")
      (string-contains? body "set!")
      (string-contains? body "require")
      (string-contains? body "eval")
      (string-contains? body "load")))

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (< (string-length body) 120)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (aether-body-banned? body))))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer answer-at-end: only the last ~240 chars (keeps <think> noise out).
(define (aether-tail s n)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (<= len n)
        s
        (substring s (- len n) len)))))

(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((parts (string-split (aether-tail s 240) "\n")))
      (let loop ((xs parts))
        (cond
          ((null? xs) "")
          ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
           (car xs))
          (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define *body-deny* "(lambda (x) #f)")
(define *body-widen* "(lambda (x) (< x 7))")

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "deny-all")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-deny* "rule-deny-all" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "widen")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-widen" "rule"))
    ((and (number? fails) (number? max-fails) (> fails max-fails))
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))
    (else
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Extract text content from llm:chat result (hash or string).
(define (aether-llm-content resp)
  (cond
    ((string? resp) resp)
    ((hash? resp)
     (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
       (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
         (if (string? c) c ""))
       ""))
    (else "")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey"
            "llm-live")
      (begin
        ; Load LLM surface on demand (not at module import).
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((resp
                (try
                  (llm:chat

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)

      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────

(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)

                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)

                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

input.source:
; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;
; Schema validation runs before any mutation. Invalid proposals are
; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source
        aether:proposal-valid?
        aether:proposal-errors
        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt
        aether:execute-proposal)

(require "std/string" all:)
(require "aether-min" all:)
; std/llm is loaded only inside aether-propose-live (keeps offline examples light).

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Strict body: pure lambda on x only — no free calls into workspace.
(define (aether-body-banned? body)
  (or (string-contains? body "gate")
      (string-contains? body "fail-count")
      (string-contains? body "max-fails")
      (string-contains? body "widen")
      (string-contains? body "define")
      (string-contains? body "set!")
      (string-contains? body "require")
      (string-contains? body "eval")
      (string-contains? body "load")))

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (< (string-length body) 120)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (aether-body-banned? body))))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer answer-at-end: only the last ~240 chars (keeps <think> noise out).
(define (aether-tail s n)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (<= len n)
        s
        (substring s (- len n) len)))))

(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((parts (string-split (aether-tail s 240) "\n")))
      (let loop ((xs parts))
        (cond
          ((null? xs) "")
          ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
           (car xs))
          (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define *body-deny* "(lambda (x) #f)")
(define *body-widen* "(lambda (x) (< x 7))")

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "deny-all")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-deny* "rule-deny-all" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "widen")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-widen" "rule"))
    ((and (number? fails) (number? max-fails) (> fails max-fails))
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))
    (else
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Extract text content from llm:chat result (hash or string).
(define (aether-llm-content resp)
  (cond
    ((string? resp) resp)
    ((hash? resp)
     (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
       (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
         (if (string? c) c ""))
       ""))
    (else "")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey"
            "llm-live")
      (begin
        ; Load LLM surface on demand (not at module import).
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((resp
                (try
                  (llm:chat
                    "Reply with EXACTLY one line only: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) EXPRESSION)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. No markdown. No analysis."
                    (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                  (catch (e) #f))))
          (let ((text (aether-llm-content resp)))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
              (if (and (pair? parsed) (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

target.name: aether:parse-proposal-text
target.body:
(lambda (text source) (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

input.source:
; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;
; Schema validation runs before any mutation. Invalid proposals are
; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source
        aether:proposal-valid?
        aether:proposal-errors
        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt
        aether:execute-proposal)

(require "std/string" all:)
(require "aether-min" all:)
; std/llm is loaded only inside aether-propose-live (keeps offline examples light).

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Strict body: pure lambda on x only — no free calls into workspace.
(define (aether-body-banned? body)
  (or (string-contains? body "gate")
      (string-contains? body "fail-count")
      (string-contains? body "max-fails")
      (string-contains? body "widen")
      (string-contains? body "define")
      (string-contains? body "set!")
      (string-contains? body "require")
      (string-contains? body "eval")
      (string-contains? body "load")))

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (< (string-length body) 120)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (aether-body-banned? body))))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer answer-at-end: only the last ~240 chars (keeps <think> noise out).
(define (aether-tail s n)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (<= len n)
        s
        (substring s (- len n) len)))))

(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((parts (string-split (aether-tail s 240) "\n")))
      (let loop ((xs parts))
        (cond
          ((null? xs) "")
          ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
           (car xs))
          (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define *body-deny* "(lambda (x) #f)")
(define *body-widen* "(lambda (x) (< x 7))")

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "deny-all")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-deny* "rule-deny-all" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "widen")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-widen" "rule"))
    ((and (number? fails) (number? max-fails) (> fails max-fails))
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))
    (else
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Extract text content from llm:chat result (hash or string).
(define (aether-llm-content resp)
  (cond
    ((string? resp) resp)
    ((hash? resp)
     (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
       (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
         (if (string? c) c ""))
       ""))
    (else "")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey"
            "llm-live")
      (begin
        ; Load LLM surface on demand (not at module import).
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((resp
                (try
                  (llm:chat
                    "Reply with EXACTLY one line only: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) EXPRESSION)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. No markdown. No analysis."
                    (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                  (catch (e) #f))))
          (let ((text (aether-llm-content resp)))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
              (if (and (pair? parsed) (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

              (if (and (pair? parsed) (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))))

; lib/aether-propose.aura — Propose edge + proposal schema (Axis E)
;
; (require "aether-propose" all:)
;
; Proposal list (untrusted):
;   (list kind name body summary [source])
;   kind   : "mutate" | "skip"
;   name   : non-empty string (binding to rebind)
;   body   : "" if skip; else must look like (lambda ...)
;   summary: string
;   source : "rule" | "llm-stub" | "llm-live" | ...
;
; Schema validation runs before any mutation. Invalid proposals are
; refused without touching the workspace (core denseness: E cannot
; inject unstructured code into the hot path).

(export aether:propose-mode
        aether:propose-rule
        aether:propose
        aether:proposal-kind
        aether:proposal-name
        aether:proposal-body
        aether:proposal-summary
        aether:proposal-source
        aether:proposal-valid?
        aether:proposal-errors
        aether:parse-proposal-text
        aether:proposal-prompt
        aether:execute-proposal)

(require "std/string" all:)
(require "aether-min" all:)
; std/llm is loaded only inside aether-propose-live (keeps offline examples light).

(define (aether:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (aether:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (aether:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (aether:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (aether:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

(define (aether:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "AETHER_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Strict body: pure lambda on x only — no free calls into workspace.
(define (aether-body-banned? body)
  (or (string-contains? body "gate")
      (string-contains? body "fail-count")
      (string-contains? body "max-fails")
      (string-contains? body "widen")
      (string-contains? body "define")
      (string-contains? body "set!")
      (string-contains? body "require")
      (string-contains? body "eval")
      (string-contains? body "load")))

(define (aether-body-ok? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 8)
       (< (string-length body) 120)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (aether-body-banned? body))))

(define (aether:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind p))
            (name (aether:proposal-name p))
            (body (aether:proposal-body p))
            (summary (aether:proposal-summary p))
            (errs (quote ())))
        ; kind
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        ; name
        (if (or (not (string? name)) (equal? name ""))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        ; summary
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        ; body by kind
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (aether-body-ok? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (aether:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (aether:proposal-errors p)))

; ── Wire format for LLM / external propose edge ──────────────
; Single line (no '|' inside body):
;   MUTATE|<name>|<body>|<summary>
;   SKIP|<name>||<summary>
; Parser takes first non-empty line; ignores surrounding prose.

(define (aether-num-str n)
  (if (number? n) (number->string n) "0"))

(define (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails)
  ; Nested append — some hosts truncate multi-arg string-append.
  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) ...)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (aether-num-str fails))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (aether-num-str max-fails)
                     ". Widen when over budget; skip when healthy."))))

; Prefer answer-at-end: only the last ~240 chars (keeps <think> noise out).
(define (aether-tail s n)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (<= len n)
        s
        (substring s (- len n) len)))))

(define (aether-wire-line s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    ""
    (let ((parts (string-split (aether-tail s 240) "\n")))
      (let loop ((xs parts))
        (cond
          ((null? xs) "")
          ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
          ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
               (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
           (car xs))
          (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (aether-norm-kind k)
  (if (or (equal? k "MUTATE") (equal? k "mutate") (equal? k "Mutate"))
    "mutate"
    (if (or (equal? k "SKIP") (equal? k "skip") (equal? k "Skip"))
      "skip"
      k)))

; Parse external text → proposal list or #f
(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((line (aether-wire-line text)))
      (if (or (equal? line "") (not (string-contains? line "|")))
        #f
        (let ((parts (string-split line "|")))
          (if (< (length parts) 4)
            #f
            (list (aether-norm-kind (list-ref parts 0))
                  (list-ref parts 1)
                  (list-ref parts 2)
                  (list-ref parts 3)
                  (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))))

; ── Propose (rule / stub / live) ─────────────────────────────

(define *body-deny* "(lambda (x) #f)")
(define *body-widen* "(lambda (x) (< x 7))")

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "deny-all")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-deny* "rule-deny-all" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "widen")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-widen" "rule"))
    ((and (number? fails) (number? max-fails) (> fails max-fails))
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))
    (else
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Extract text content from llm:chat result (hash or string).
(define (aether-llm-content resp)
  (cond
    ((string? resp) resp)
    ((hash? resp)
     (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
       (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
         (if (string? c) c ""))
       ""))
    (else "")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey"
            "llm-live")
      (begin
        ; Load LLM surface on demand (not at module import).
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((resp
                (try
                  (llm:chat
                    "Reply with EXACTLY one line only: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) EXPRESSION)|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. No markdown. No analysis."
                    (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                  (catch (e) #f))))
          (let ((text (aether-llm-content resp)))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
              (if (and (pair? parsed) (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

; ── Execute only if schema-valid ─────────────────────────────
; verify-check: 0-arg → bool (#t to accept post-mutation state)
(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (aether:proposal-kind proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (aether:proposal-name proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-body proposal)
                          (aether:proposal-summary proposal)
                          verify-check)))))

  (string-append
    (string-append
      "Return ONLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) (< x N))|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. fail-count="
      (if (number? fails) (number->string fails) "0"))
    (string-append
      " max-fails="
      (string-append (if (number? max-fails) (number->string max-fails) "0")
                     ". Body must only use x and numbers. Widen when over budget."))))

(define (aether:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "parsed"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

; ── Propose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define *body-deny* "(lambda (x) #f)")
(define *body-widen* "(lambda (x) (< x 7))")

(define (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "deny-all")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-deny* "rule-deny-all" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "widen")
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-widen" "rule"))
    ((and (number? fails) (number? max-fails) (> fails max-fails))
     (list "mutate" "gate" *body-widen* "rule-auto-widen" "rule"))
    (else
     (list "skip" "gate" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule"))))

(define (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((p (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

(define (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
  (aether:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (let ((fallback (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey"
            "llm-live")
      (begin
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((resp
                (try
                  (llm:chat
                    "Reply with EXACTLY one line: MUTATE|gate|(lambda (x) (< x N))|summary OR SKIP|gate||summary. N integer 1-10. No other calls. No markdown."
                    (aether:proposal-prompt fails max-fails))
                  (catch (e) #f))))
          (let ((text
                  (if (string? resp)
                    resp
                    (if (hash? resp)
                      (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
                        (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
                          (if (string? c) c ""))
                        "")
                      ""))))
            (let ((parsed (aether:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
              (if (and (pair? parsed) (aether:proposal-valid? parsed))
                parsed
                (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                      (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                      "llm-parse-fallback"
                      "llm-live")))))))))

(define (aether:propose fails max-fails mode)
  (let ((pm (aether:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (aether-propose-stub fails max-fails mode)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (aether-propose-live fails max-fails mode)
        (aether:propose-rule fails max-fails mode)))))

(define (aether:execute-proposal proposal observe-probe need-mutate? verify-check)
  (if (not (aether:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":observation" (try (observe-probe) (catch (e) #f)))
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (aether:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1))
    (let ((kind (car proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          (lambda () #f)
                          (car (cdr proposal))
                          "(lambda (x) x)"
                          (car (cdr (cdr (cdr proposal))))
                          verify-check)
        (aether:loop-once observe-probe
                          need-mutate?
                          (car (cdr proposal))
                          (car (cdr (cdr proposal)))
                          (car (cdr (cdr (cdr proposal))))
                          verify-check)))))

; lib/ffi.aura — Aura FFI binding layer (issue #30 / M5)
;
; (require "ffi" all:)
;
; Load a Daedalus .so/.dylib and bind solver symbols via c-load / c-func.
; Failure returns a hash (ok / reason / error) — never throws into an
; agent loop. Host c-func steals cid < n_ffi, so only one live c-func
; is allowed: daed_dispatch. bind-solve-dense wraps that trampoline.
; c-load uses RTLD_LOCAL, so lib-id=-1 (RTLD_DEFAULT) does not see a
; just-loaded kernel; we fall back to the last successful c-load handle.

(export daed:ffi-version
        daed:load-kernels
        daed:bind-c-func
        daed:bind-solve-dense
        daed:ffi-ok?
        daed:ffi-reason
        daed:ffi-error
        daed:ffi-lib
        daed:ffi-fn
        daed:ffi-dispatch
        daed:ffi-path
        daed:ffi-solve-dense!
        daed:ffi-on-call!)

(define daed:ffi-version 1)

(define *daed-ffi-max-lib* -1)
(define *daed-ffi-last-lib* -2)
(define *daed-ffi-dispatch* #f)
(define *daed-ffi-solve-fn* #f)
(define *daed-ffi-on-call* #f)

(define (daed:ffi-on-call! fn)
  (set! *daed-ffi-on-call* fn)
  #t)

(define (daed:ffi-dispatch)
  *daed-ffi-dispatch*)

(define (daed:ffi-ok? r)
  (if (not r)
    #f
    (hash-ref r "ok" #f)))

(define (daed:ffi-reason r)
  (if (not r)
    "no-result"
    (hash-ref r "reason" "")))

(define (daed:ffi-error r)
  (if (not r)
    ""
    (hash-ref r "error" "")))

(define (daed:ffi-lib r)
  (if (not r)
    -2
    (hash-ref r "lib" -2)))

(define (daed:ffi-path r)
  (if (not r)
    ""
    (hash-ref r "path" "")))

(define (daed:ffi-fn r)
  (let ((f #f))
    (if r
      (set! f (hash-ref r "fn" #f))
      #f)
    (if f
      f
      *daed-ffi-solve-fn*)))

(define (daed:ffi-blank reason)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (hash-set! res "lib" -2)
    (hash-set! res "fn" #f)
    (hash-set! res "dispatch" #f)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "error" "")
    (hash-set! res "path" "")
    (hash-set! res "rc" -1)
    res))

(define (daed:ffi-fail reason err lib path)
  (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank reason)))
    (hash-set! res "error" err)
    (hash-set! res "lib" lib)
    (hash-set! res "path" path)
    res))

(define (daed:ffi-proc? x)
  (if (not x)
    #f
    (if (number? x)
      #f
      #t)))

(define (daed:f64-off i)
  (inexact->exact (* i 8)))

(define (daed:pack-f64! buf vec n)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (c-struct-set! buf (daed:f64-off i) (vector-ref vec i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    buf))

(define (daed:unpack-f64! buf vec n)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! vec i (c-struct-ref buf (daed:f64-off i) 1))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    vec))

; Copy-in / dispatch op 2 / copy-out. Does not meter escapes.
(define (daed:ffi-solve-dense! A b n)
  (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "init"))
        (nn 0)
        (Ab #f)
        (bb #f)
        (rc -1)
        (disp *daed-ffi-dispatch*))
    (if (not (daed:ffi-proc? disp))
      (daed:ffi-fail "no-bind" "daed_dispatch is not bound" -2 "")
      (if (or (not (number? n)) (<= n 0))
        (daed:ffi-fail "bad-arg" "n must be a positive integer" -2 "")
        (begin
          (set! nn (inexact->exact n))
          (set! Ab (c-alloc (inexact->exact (* nn nn 8))))
          (set! bb (c-alloc (inexact->exact (* nn 8))))
          (if (or (not Ab) (not bb) (number? Ab) (number? bb))
            (daed:ffi-fail "alloc" "c-alloc failed" -2 "")
            (begin
              (daed:pack-f64! Ab A (* nn nn))
              (daed:pack-f64! bb b nn)
              (set! rc
                (try (disp 2
                           (c-opaque->int Ab)
                           (c-opaque->int bb)
                           nn)
                     (catch (e) -1)))
              (hash-set! res "rc" rc)
              (if (= rc 0)
                (begin
                  (daed:unpack-f64! bb b nn)
                  (c-free Ab)
                  (c-free bb)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "ok")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (c-free Ab)
                  (c-free bb)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "solve-fail")
                  (hash-set! res "error" "daed_dispatch op=2 returned non-zero")
                  res)))))))))

(define (daed:ffi-make-solve-fn)
  (lambda (A b n)
    (begin
      (if *daed-ffi-on-call*
        (*daed-ffi-on-call* "native-dense-solve")
        #t)
      (daed:ffi-solve-dense! A b n))))

(define (daed:ffi-try-dispatch lib-id)
  (try (c-func lib-id "daed_dispatch" "(Int Int Int Int) -> Int")
       (catch (e) 0)))

(define (daed:ffi-install-dispatch! disp lib-id)
  (let ((v -1)
        (res (daed:ffi-blank "init")))
    (set! v (try (disp 0 0 0 0) (catch (e) -1)))
    (if (not (= v 1))
      (daed:ffi-fail "bad-abi" "daed_abi_version is not 1" lib-id "")
      (begin
        (set! *daed-ffi-dispatch* disp)
        (set! *daed-ffi-solve-fn* (daed:ffi-make-solve-fn))
        (if (>= lib-id 0)
          (begin
            (if (> lib-id *daed-ffi-max-lib*)
              (set! *daed-ffi-max-lib* lib-id)
              #t)
            (set! *daed-ffi-last-lib* lib-id))
          #t)
        (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
        (hash-set! res "lib" lib-id)
        (hash-set! res "fn" *daed-ffi-solve-fn*)
        (hash-set! res "dispatch" disp)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "bound")
        res))))

(define (daed:ffi-reuse lib-id)
  (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "reused")))
    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
    (hash-set! res "lib" lib-id)
    (hash-set! res "fn" *daed-ffi-solve-fn*)
    (hash-set! res "dispatch" *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
    (hash-set! res "reason" "reused")
    res))

; Classify a failed c-func: empty loader vs bad handle vs missing symbol.
; First-ever c-load failure also returns handle 0 (host residual).
(define (daed:ffi-cfunc-fail lib-id name)
  (if (and (number? lib-id) (>= lib-id 0) (< *daed-ffi-max-lib* lib-id))
    (if (and (< *daed-ffi-max-lib* 0) (= lib-id 0))
      (daed:ffi-fail "no-lib"
                     "c-load failed (handle 0 and no library is loaded)"
                     lib-id
                     name)
      (daed:ffi-fail "bad-lib"
                     "c-func rejected library handle"
                     lib-id
                     name))
    (daed:ffi-fail "no-symbol"
                   "c-func did not return a procedure"
                   lib-id
                   name)))

(define (daed:bind-c-func lib-id name sig)
  (let ((disp #f)
        (nm (if (string? name) name "")))
    (if (and (daed:ffi-proc? *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
             (equal? nm "daed_dispatch"))
      (daed:ffi-reuse lib-id)
      (if (and (daed:ffi-proc? *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
               (not (equal? nm "daed_dispatch")))
        (begin
          (set! disp (try (c-func lib-id nm sig) (catch (e) 0)))
          (if (daed:ffi-proc? disp)
            (daed:ffi-fail "cid-limit"
                           "host c-func steals cid < n_ffi; only daed_dispatch is bound"
                           lib-id
                           nm)
            (daed:ffi-fail "no-symbol"
                           "symbol not found"
                           lib-id
                           nm)))
        (begin
          (set! disp (try (c-func lib-id nm sig) (catch (e) 0)))
          (if (not (daed:ffi-proc? disp))
            (daed:ffi-cfunc-fail lib-id nm)
            (if (equal? nm "daed_dispatch")
              (daed:ffi-install-dispatch! disp lib-id)
              (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "bound")))
                (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                (hash-set! res "lib" lib-id)
                (hash-set! res "fn" disp)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bound")
                res))))))))

(define (daed:bind-solve-dense lib-id)
  (let ((id lib-id)
        (disp #f)
        (fallback -2))
    (if (not (number? id))
      (daed:ffi-fail "bad-lib" "lib-id must be an integer" -2 "")
      (if (daed:ffi-proc? *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
        (daed:ffi-reuse id)
        (if (= id -1)
          (begin
            (set! disp (daed:ffi-try-dispatch -1))
            (if (daed:ffi-proc? disp)
              (daed:ffi-install-dispatch! disp -1)
              (begin
                (set! fallback *daed-ffi-last-lib*)
                (if (>= fallback 0)
                  (daed:bind-solve-dense fallback)
                  (daed:ffi-fail "no-symbol"
                                 "RTLD_DEFAULT has no daed_dispatch (c-load is RTLD_LOCAL)"
                                 -1
                                 "")))))
          (begin
            (set! disp (daed:ffi-try-dispatch id))
            (if (daed:ffi-proc? disp)
              (daed:ffi-install-dispatch! disp id)
              (daed:ffi-cfunc-fail id "daed_dispatch"))))))))

(define (daed:load-kernels-path path)
  (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "init"))
        (hid -2)
        (bd #f))
    (hash-set! res "path" path)
    (set! hid (try (c-load path) (catch (e) -2)))
    (if (not (number? hid))
      (daed:ffi-fail "load-error" "c-load threw" -2 path)
      (if (< hid 0)
        (daed:ffi-fail "load-error" "c-load returned negative" hid path)
        (if (and (>= *daed-ffi-max-lib* 0) (<= hid *daed-ffi-max-lib*))
          (daed:ffi-fail "no-lib"
                         "c-load failed (handle not new; missing file or dlopen error)"
                         hid
                         path)
          (if (daed:ffi-proc? *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
            (begin
              (set! *daed-ffi-max-lib* hid)
              (set! *daed-ffi-last-lib* hid)
              (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
              (hash-set! res "lib" hid)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "loaded")
              (hash-set! res "fn" *daed-ffi-solve-fn*)
              (hash-set! res "dispatch" *daed-ffi-dispatch*)
              res)
            (begin
              (set! bd (daed:bind-solve-dense hid))
              (if (daed:ffi-ok? bd)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! bd "path" path)
                  (hash-set! bd "reason" "loaded")
                  bd)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! bd "path" path)
                  bd)))))))))

(define (daed:load-kernels-default)
  (let ((a (daed:load-kernels-path "native/libdaed_solve.so")))
    (if (daed:ffi-ok? a)
      a
      (daed:load-kernels-path "native/libdaed_solve.dylib"))))

(define (daed:load-kernels path)
  (if (and (number? path) (= path -1))
    (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "rtld-default")))
      (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
      (hash-set! res "lib" -1)
      (hash-set! res "reason" "rtld-default")
      res)
    (if (not path)
      (daed:load-kernels-default)
      (if (string? path)
        (if (equal? path "")
          (daed:load-kernels-default)
          (daed:load-kernels-path path))
        (daed:ffi-fail "bad-path"
                       "load-kernels expects a path string, #f, or -1"
                       -2
                       "")))))

(lambda (A b n) (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "init"))
        (nn 0)
        (asz 0)
        (bsz 0)
        (Ab #f)
        (bb #f)
        (rc -1)
        (disp *daed-ffi-dispatch*))
    (if (not (daed:ffi-proc? disp))
      (daed:ffi-fail "no-bind" "daed_dispatch is not bound" -2 "")
      (if (or (not (number? n)) (<= n 0))
        (daed:ffi-fail "bad-arg" "n must be a positive integer" -2 "")
        (begin
          (set! nn (inexact->exact n))
          (set! asz (inexact->exact (* nn nn 8)))
          (set! bsz (inexact->exact (* nn 8)))
          (set! Ab (daed:buf-alloc asz))
          (set! bb (daed:buf-alloc bsz))
          (if (or (not Ab) (not bb))
            (begin
              (if Ab (daed:buf-free! Ab asz) #f)
              (if bb (daed:buf-free! bb bsz) #f)
              (daed:ffi-fail "alloc" "c-alloc failed" -2 ""))
            (begin
              (daed:buf-copy-in! Ab A (* nn nn))
              (daed:buf-copy-in! bb b nn)
              (set! rc
                (try (disp 2
                           (c-opaque->int Ab)
                           (c-opaque->int bb)
                           nn)
                     (catch (e) -1)))
              (hash-set! res "rc" rc)
              (if (= rc 0)
                (begin
                  (daed:buf-copy-out! bb b nn)
                  (daed:buf-free! Ab asz)
                  (daed:buf-free! bb bsz)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "ok")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:buf-free! Ab asz)
                  (daed:buf-free! bb bsz)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "solve-fail")
                  (hash-set! res "error" "daed_dispatch op=2 returned non-zero")
                  res)))))))))
