input.source:
; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 4 = issue #13 branch-current extraction
(define daed:solve-version 4)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                      (i 0))
                  (while (lambda () (< i N))
                    (lambda ()
                      (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                      (set! i (+ i 1))))
                  (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                    (begin
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "singular"))
                    (begin
                      (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                      (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                        (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                        (if (< (vector-length x) N)
                          (let ((nx (make-vector N 0.0))
                                (k 0)
                                (m (vector-length x)))
                            (while (lambda () (< k m))
                              (lambda ()
                                (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
                                (set! k (+ k 1))))
                            (set! x nx))
                          0)
                        (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                        (if (or (< resid daed:nr-atol) (< dxn daed:nr-vtol))
                          (begin
                            (set! ok #t)
                            (set! going #f)
                            (set! reason "converged"))
                          0)))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
                (make-vector N 0.0))))
      (hash-set! nr "volts"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                             (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
          (hash)))
      (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                               comps #t)
          (hash)))
      nr)))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(lambda (comps) (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

input.source:
; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:op-hist
        daed:op-fail-node
        daed:op-lambda
        daed:simulate-op-from
        daed:simulate-op-gmin
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 5 = issue #16 NR line-search, hist, gmin / previous guess
(define daed:solve-version 5)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Pad x with zeros to length n.
(define (daed:grow-vec x n)
  (if (>= (vector-length x) n)
    x
    (let ((nx (make-vector n 0.0))
          (k 0)
          (m (vector-length x)))
      (while (lambda () (< k m))
        (lambda ()
          (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1))))
      nx)))

; Finite number: NaN fails (= x x); huge values treated as non-finite.
(define (daed:finite-num? x)
  (and (number? x) (= x x) (< x 1e300) (> x -1e300)))

; 1-based node id of max |F| among voltage unknowns. 0 if none.
(define (daed:fail-node-of F n-v)
  (let ((best 0)
        (bestv -1.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n-v))
    (if (> lim (vector-length F))
      (set! lim (vector-length F))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((av (abs (daed:vec-ref F i))))
          (if (> av bestv)
            (begin
              (set! bestv av)
              (set! best (+ i 1)))
            0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    best))

(define (daed:copy-hist src n)
  (let ((h (make-vector n 0.0))
        (k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! h k (daed:vec-ref src k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    h))

; Residual at a trial state. #f if empty / not finite.
(define (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt xo)
  (let ((sys (stamp-fn xt xo)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (F (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        #f
        (let ((r (daed:vec-norm-inf F N)))
          (if (daed:finite-num? r)
            r
            #f))))))

; λ ∈ {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8}: first residual decrease; else take λ=1/8.
; Returns (list xt lam new-or-old-resid).
(define (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x dx N resid)
  (let ((lam 1.0)
        (k 0)
        (found #f)
        (xt-best #f)
        (lam-best 0.125)
        (r-best resid))
    (while (lambda () (and (not found) (< k 4)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
          (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N lam)
          (let ((r (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt x)))
            (if (and r (< r resid))
              (begin
                (set! found #t)
                (set! xt-best xt)
                (set! lam-best lam)
                (set! r-best r))
              (begin
                (set! k (+ k 1))
                (set! lam (* lam 0.5))))))))
    (if found
      (list xt-best lam-best r-best)
      (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
        (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N 0.125)
        (list xt 0.125 resid)))))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason, hist, fail_node, lambda
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t)
        (last-lam 1.0)
        (fail-node 0)
        (hist (make-vector daed:nr-maxiter 0.0))
        (hist-n 0))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (set! fail-node (daed:fail-node-of F n-v))
                (if (< hist-n daed:nr-maxiter)
                  (begin
                    (daed:vec-set! hist hist-n resid)
                    (set! hist-n (+ hist-n 1)))
                  0)
                (if (not (daed:finite-num? resid))
                  (begin
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! reason "nan"))
                  (if (< resid daed:nr-atol)
                    (begin
                      (set! ok #t)
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "converged"))
                    (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                          (i 0))
                      (while (lambda () (< i N))
                        (lambda ()
                          (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                          (set! i (+ i 1))))
                      (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                        (begin
                          (set! going #f)
                          (set! reason "singular"))
                        (begin
                          (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                          (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                            (if (< dxn daed:nr-vtol)
                              (begin
                                (set! x (daed:grow-vec x N))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                                (set! last-lam 1.0)
                                (set! ok #t)
                                (set! going #f)
                                (set! reason "converged"))
                              (let ((ls (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x rhs N resid)))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (set! x (car ls))
                                (set! last-lam (car (cdr ls)))
                                (set! resid (car (cdr (cdr ls))))))))))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (daed:finite-num? resid) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    (hash-set! res "hist" (daed:copy-hist hist hist-n))
    (hash-set! res "fail_node" fail-node)
    (hash-set! res "lambda" last-lam)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (hash-set! res "hist" (make-vector 1 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "fail_node" 0)
        (hash-set! res "lambda" 1.0)
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:pack-op-nr nr comps)
  (hash-set! nr "volts"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                         (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
      (hash)))
  (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                           comps #t)
      (hash)))
  nr)

(define (daed:x0-from-prev prev N)
  (let ((x0 (make-vector N 0.0)))
    (if (not prev)
      x0
      (let ((px (daed:op-x prev))
            (k 0)
            (m 0))
        (set! m (vector-length px))
        (if (> m N)
          (set! m N)
          0)
        (while (lambda () (< k m))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! x0 k (daed:vec-ref px k))
            (set! k (+ k 1))))
        x0))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (daed:x0-from-prev prev N))
      comps)))

; Restart NR from a previous .op unknown vector (same topology).
(define (daed:simulate-op-from ckt prev)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "gmin0" (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin" 1e-12))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (let ((g0 (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin0" #f)))
            (if (number? g0)
              (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g0)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Cold-start first; if that fails, Gmin ramp 1e-6 → 1e-12 then restore.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
      (let ((cold (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)))
        (if (hash-ref cold "ok" #f)
          cold
          (begin
            (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
            (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps 1e-6)
            (let ((cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
                  (g 1e-8)
                  (going #t))
              (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
                (lambda ()
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
                      (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                      (set! g (* g 0.01))))))
              (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (hash-set! final "gmin_ramp" #t)
                (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! final "reason" "gmin")
                  0)
                final))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(define (daed:op-hist res)
  (hash-ref res "hist" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-fail-node res)
  (hash-ref res "fail_node" 0))

(define (daed:op-lambda res)
  (hash-ref res "lambda" 1.0))

; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:op-hist
        daed:op-fail-node
        daed:op-lambda
        daed:simulate-op-from
        daed:simulate-op-gmin
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 5 = issue #16 NR line-search, hist, gmin / previous guess
(define daed:solve-version 5)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Pad x with zeros to length n.
(define (daed:grow-vec x n)
  (if (>= (vector-length x) n)
    x
    (let ((nx (make-vector n 0.0))
          (k 0)
          (m (vector-length x)))
      (while (lambda () (< k m))
        (lambda ()
          (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1))))
      nx)))

; Finite number: NaN fails (= x x); huge values treated as non-finite.
(define (daed:finite-num? x)
  (and (number? x) (= x x) (< x 1e300) (> x -1e300)))

; 1-based node id of max |F| among voltage unknowns. 0 if none.
(define (daed:fail-node-of F n-v)
  (let ((best 0)
        (bestv -1.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n-v))
    (if (> lim (vector-length F))
      (set! lim (vector-length F))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((av (abs (daed:vec-ref F i))))
          (if (> av bestv)
            (begin
              (set! bestv av)
              (set! best (+ i 1)))
            0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    best))

(define (daed:copy-hist src n)
  (let ((h (make-vector n 0.0))
        (k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! h k (daed:vec-ref src k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    h))

; Residual at a trial state. #f if empty / not finite.
(define (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt xo)
  (let ((sys (stamp-fn xt xo)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (F (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        #f
        (let ((r (daed:vec-norm-inf F N)))
          (if (daed:finite-num? r)
            r
            #f))))))

; λ ∈ {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8}: first residual decrease; else take λ=1/8.
; Returns (list xt lam new-or-old-resid).
(define (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x dx N resid)
  (let ((lam 1.0)
        (k 0)
        (found #f)
        (xt-best #f)
        (lam-best 0.125)
        (r-best resid))
    (while (lambda () (and (not found) (< k 4)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
          (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N lam)
          (let ((r (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt x)))
            (if (and r (< r resid))
              (begin
                (set! found #t)
                (set! xt-best xt)
                (set! lam-best lam)
                (set! r-best r))
              (begin
                (set! k (+ k 1))
                (set! lam (* lam 0.5))))))))
    (if found
      (list xt-best lam-best r-best)
      (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
        (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N 0.125)
        (list xt 0.125 resid)))))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason, hist, fail_node, lambda
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t)
        (last-lam 1.0)
        (fail-node 0)
        (hist (make-vector daed:nr-maxiter 0.0))
        (hist-n 0))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (set! fail-node (daed:fail-node-of F n-v))
                (if (< hist-n daed:nr-maxiter)
                  (begin
                    (daed:vec-set! hist hist-n resid)
                    (set! hist-n (+ hist-n 1)))
                  0)
                (if (not (daed:finite-num? resid))
                  (begin
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! reason "nan"))
                  (if (< resid daed:nr-atol)
                    (begin
                      (set! ok #t)
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "converged"))
                    (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                          (i 0))
                      (while (lambda () (< i N))
                        (lambda ()
                          (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                          (set! i (+ i 1))))
                      (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                        (begin
                          (set! going #f)
                          (set! reason "singular"))
                        (begin
                          (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                          (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                            (if (< dxn daed:nr-vtol)
                              (begin
                                (set! x (daed:grow-vec x N))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                                (set! last-lam 1.0)
                                (set! ok #t)
                                (set! going #f)
                                (set! reason "converged"))
                              (let ((ls (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x rhs N resid)))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (set! x (car ls))
                                (set! last-lam (car (cdr ls)))
                                (set! resid (car (cdr (cdr ls))))))))))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (daed:finite-num? resid) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    (hash-set! res "hist" (daed:copy-hist hist hist-n))
    (hash-set! res "fail_node" fail-node)
    (hash-set! res "lambda" last-lam)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (hash-set! res "hist" (make-vector 1 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "fail_node" 0)
        (hash-set! res "lambda" 1.0)
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:pack-op-nr nr comps)
  (hash-set! nr "volts"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                         (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
      (hash)))
  (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                           comps #t)
      (hash)))
  nr)

(define (daed:x0-from-prev prev N)
  (let ((x0 (make-vector N 0.0)))
    (if (not prev)
      x0
      (let ((px (daed:op-x prev))
            (k 0)
            (m 0))
        (set! m (vector-length px))
        (if (> m N)
          (set! m N)
          0)
        (while (lambda () (< k m))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! x0 k (daed:vec-ref px k))
            (set! k (+ k 1))))
        x0))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (daed:x0-from-prev prev N))
      comps)))

; Restart NR from a previous .op unknown vector (same topology).
(define (daed:simulate-op-from ckt prev)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "gmin0" (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin" 1e-12))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (let ((g0 (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin0" #f)))
            (if (number? g0)
              (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g0)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Cold-start first; if that fails, Gmin ramp 1e-6 → 1e-12 then restore.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
      (let ((cold (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)))
        (if (hash-ref cold "ok" #f)
          cold
          (begin
            (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
            (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps 1e-6)
            (let ((cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
                  (g 1e-8)
                  (going #t))
              (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
                (lambda ()
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
                      (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                      (set! g (* g 0.01))))))
              (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (hash-set! final "gmin_ramp" #t)
                (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! final "reason" "gmin")
                  0)
                final))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(define (daed:op-hist res)
  (hash-ref res "hist" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-fail-node res)
  (hash-ref res "fail_node" 0))

(define (daed:op-lambda res)
  (hash-ref res "lambda" 1.0))

target.name: daed:set-all-nl-gmin!
target.body:
(lambda (comps g) (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:op-hist
        daed:op-fail-node
        daed:op-lambda
        daed:simulate-op-from
        daed:simulate-op-gmin
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 5 = issue #16 NR line-search, hist, gmin / previous guess
(define daed:solve-version 5)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Pad x with zeros to length n.
(define (daed:grow-vec x n)
  (if (>= (vector-length x) n)
    x
    (let ((nx (make-vector n 0.0))
          (k 0)
          (m (vector-length x)))
      (while (lambda () (< k m))
        (lambda ()
          (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1))))
      nx)))

; Finite number: NaN fails (= x x); huge values treated as non-finite.
(define (daed:finite-num? x)
  (and (number? x) (= x x) (< x 1e300) (> x -1e300)))

; 1-based node id of max |F| among voltage unknowns. 0 if none.
(define (daed:fail-node-of F n-v)
  (let ((best 0)
        (bestv -1.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n-v))
    (if (> lim (vector-length F))
      (set! lim (vector-length F))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((av (abs (daed:vec-ref F i))))
          (if (> av bestv)
            (begin
              (set! bestv av)
              (set! best (+ i 1)))
            0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    best))

(define (daed:copy-hist src n)
  (let ((h (make-vector n 0.0))
        (k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! h k (daed:vec-ref src k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    h))

; Residual at a trial state. #f if empty / not finite.
(define (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt xo)
  (let ((sys (stamp-fn xt xo)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (F (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        #f
        (let ((r (daed:vec-norm-inf F N)))
          (if (daed:finite-num? r)
            r
            #f))))))

; λ ∈ {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8}: first residual decrease; else take λ=1/8.
; Returns (list xt lam new-or-old-resid).
(define (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x dx N resid)
  (let ((lam 1.0)
        (k 0)
        (found #f)
        (xt-best #f)
        (lam-best 0.125)
        (r-best resid))
    (while (lambda () (and (not found) (< k 4)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
          (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N lam)
          (let ((r (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt x)))
            (if (and r (< r resid))
              (begin
                (set! found #t)
                (set! xt-best xt)
                (set! lam-best lam)
                (set! r-best r))
              (begin
                (set! k (+ k 1))
                (set! lam (* lam 0.5))))))))
    (if found
      (list xt-best lam-best r-best)
      (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
        (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N 0.125)
        (list xt 0.125 resid)))))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason, hist, fail_node, lambda
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t)
        (last-lam 1.0)
        (fail-node 0)
        (hist (make-vector daed:nr-maxiter 0.0))
        (hist-n 0))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (set! fail-node (daed:fail-node-of F n-v))
                (if (< hist-n daed:nr-maxiter)
                  (begin
                    (daed:vec-set! hist hist-n resid)
                    (set! hist-n (+ hist-n 1)))
                  0)
                (if (not (daed:finite-num? resid))
                  (begin
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! reason "nan"))
                  (if (< resid daed:nr-atol)
                    (begin
                      (set! ok #t)
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "converged"))
                    (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                          (i 0))
                      (while (lambda () (< i N))
                        (lambda ()
                          (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                          (set! i (+ i 1))))
                      (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                        (begin
                          (set! going #f)
                          (set! reason "singular"))
                        (begin
                          (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                          (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                            (if (< dxn daed:nr-vtol)
                              (begin
                                (set! x (daed:grow-vec x N))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                                (set! last-lam 1.0)
                                (set! ok #t)
                                (set! going #f)
                                (set! reason "converged"))
                              (let ((ls (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x rhs N resid)))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (set! x (car ls))
                                (set! last-lam (car (cdr ls)))
                                (set! resid (car (cdr (cdr ls))))))))))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (daed:finite-num? resid) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    (hash-set! res "hist" (daed:copy-hist hist hist-n))
    (hash-set! res "fail_node" fail-node)
    (hash-set! res "lambda" last-lam)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (hash-set! res "hist" (make-vector 1 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "fail_node" 0)
        (hash-set! res "lambda" 1.0)
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:pack-op-nr nr comps)
  (hash-set! nr "volts"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                         (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
      (hash)))
  (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                           comps #t)
      (hash)))
  nr)

(define (daed:x0-from-prev prev N)
  (let ((x0 (make-vector N 0.0)))
    (if (not prev)
      x0
      (let ((px (daed:op-x prev))
            (k 0)
            (m 0))
        (set! m (vector-length px))
        (if (> m N)
          (set! m N)
          0)
        (while (lambda () (< k m))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! x0 k (daed:vec-ref px k))
            (set! k (+ k 1))))
        x0))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (daed:x0-from-prev prev N))
      comps)))

; Restart NR from a previous .op unknown vector (same topology).
(define (daed:simulate-op-from ckt prev)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "gmin0" (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin" 1e-12))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q"))
          (let ((g0 (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin0" #f)))
            (if (number? g0)
              (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g0)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Cold-start first; if that fails, Gmin ramp 1e-6 → 1e-12 then restore.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
      (let ((cold (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)))
        (if (hash-ref cold "ok" #f)
          cold
          (begin
            (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
            (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps 1e-6)
            (let ((cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
                  (g 1e-8)
                  (going #t))
              (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
                (lambda ()
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
                      (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                      (set! g (* g 0.01))))))
              (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (hash-set! final "gmin_ramp" #t)
                (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! final "reason" "gmin")
                  0)
                final))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(define (daed:op-hist res)
  (hash-ref res "hist" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-fail-node res)
  (hash-ref res "fail_node" 0))

(define (daed:op-lambda res)
  (hash-ref res "lambda" 1.0))
