; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:op-hist
        daed:op-fail-node
        daed:op-lambda
        daed:simulate-op-from
        daed:simulate-op-gmin
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 5 = issue #16 NR line-search, hist, gmin / previous guess
(define daed:solve-version 5)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Pad x with zeros to length n.
(define (daed:grow-vec x n)
  (if (>= (vector-length x) n)
    x
    (let ((nx (make-vector n 0.0))
          (k 0)
          (m (vector-length x)))
      (while (lambda () (< k m))
        (lambda ()
          (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1))))
      nx)))

; Finite number: NaN fails (= x x); huge values treated as non-finite.
(define (daed:finite-num? x)
  (and (number? x) (= x x) (< x 1e300) (> x -1e300)))

; 1-based node id of max |F| among voltage unknowns. 0 if none.
(define (daed:fail-node-of F n-v)
  (let ((best 0)
        (bestv -1.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n-v))
    (if (> lim (vector-length F))
      (set! lim (vector-length F))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((av (abs (daed:vec-ref F i))))
          (if (> av bestv)
            (begin
              (set! bestv av)
              (set! best (+ i 1)))
            0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    best))

(define (daed:copy-hist src n)
  (let ((h (make-vector n 0.0))
        (k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! h k (daed:vec-ref src k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    h))

; Residual at a trial state. #f if empty / not finite.
(define (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt xo)
  (let ((sys (stamp-fn xt xo)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (F (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        #f
        (let ((r (daed:vec-norm-inf F N)))
          (if (daed:finite-num? r)
            r
            #f))))))

; λ ∈ {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8}: first residual decrease; else take λ=1/8.
; Returns (list xt lam new-or-old-resid).
(define (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x dx N resid)
  (let ((lam 1.0)
        (k 0)
        (found #f)
        (xt-best #f)
        (lam-best 0.125)
        (r-best resid))
    (while (lambda () (and (not found) (< k 4)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
          (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N lam)
          (let ((r (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt x)))
            (if (and r (< r resid))
              (begin
                (set! found #t)
                (set! xt-best xt)
                (set! lam-best lam)
                (set! r-best r))
              (begin
                (set! k (+ k 1))
                (set! lam (* lam 0.5))))))))
    (if found
      (list xt-best lam-best r-best)
      (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
        (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N 0.125)
        (list xt 0.125 resid)))))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason, hist, fail_node, lambda
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t)
        (last-lam 1.0)
        (fail-node 0)
        (hist (make-vector daed:nr-maxiter 0.0))
        (hist-n 0))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (set! fail-node (daed:fail-node-of F n-v))
                (if (< hist-n daed:nr-maxiter)
                  (begin
                    (daed:vec-set! hist hist-n resid)
                    (set! hist-n (+ hist-n 1)))
                  0)
                (if (not (daed:finite-num? resid))
                  (begin
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! reason "nan"))
                  (if (< resid daed:nr-atol)
                    (begin
                      (set! ok #t)
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "converged"))
                    (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                          (i 0))
                      (while (lambda () (< i N))
                        (lambda ()
                          (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                          (set! i (+ i 1))))
                      (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                        (begin
                          (set! going #f)
                          (set! reason "singular"))
                        (begin
                          (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                          (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                            (if (< dxn daed:nr-vtol)
                              (begin
                                (set! x (daed:grow-vec x N))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                                (set! last-lam 1.0)
                                (set! ok #t)
                                (set! going #f)
                                (set! reason "converged"))
                              (let ((ls (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x rhs N resid)))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (set! x (car ls))
                                (set! last-lam (car (cdr ls)))
                                (set! resid (car (cdr (cdr ls))))))))))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (daed:finite-num? resid) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    (hash-set! res "hist" (daed:copy-hist hist hist-n))
    (hash-set! res "fail_node" fail-node)
    (hash-set! res "lambda" last-lam)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (hash-set! res "hist" (make-vector 1 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "fail_node" 0)
        (hash-set! res "lambda" 1.0)
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:pack-op-nr nr comps)
  (hash-set! nr "volts"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                         (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
      (hash)))
  (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                           comps #t)
      (hash)))
  nr)

(define (daed:x0-from-prev prev N)
  (let ((x0 (make-vector N 0.0)))
    (if (not prev)
      x0
      (let ((px (daed:op-x prev))
            (k 0)
            (m 0))
        (set! m (vector-length px))
        (if (> m N)
          (set! m N)
          0)
        (while (lambda () (< k m))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! x0 k (daed:vec-ref px k))
            (set! k (+ k 1))))
        x0))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (daed:x0-from-prev prev N))
      comps)))

; Restart NR from a previous .op unknown vector (same topology).
(define (daed:simulate-op-from ckt prev)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "gmin0" (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin" 1e-12))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (let ((g0 (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin0" #f)))
            (if (number? g0)
              (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g0)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Cold-start first; if that fails, Gmin ramp 1e-6 → 1e-12 then restore.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
      (let ((cold (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)))
        (if (hash-ref cold "ok" #f)
          cold
          (begin
            (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
            (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps 1e-6)
            (let ((cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
                  (g 1e-8)
                  (going #t))
              (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
                (lambda ()
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
                      (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                      (set! g (* g 0.01))))))
              (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (hash-set! final "gmin_ramp" #t)
                (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! final "reason" "gmin")
                  0)
                final))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(define (daed:op-hist res)
  (hash-ref res "hist" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-fail-node res)
  (hash-ref res "fail_node" 0))

(define (daed:op-lambda res)
  (hash-ref res "lambda" 1.0))

target.name: daed:simulate-op
target.body:
(lambda (ckt) (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (daed:tag-aid
      (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
        (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
        (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))
      "none" 0 (list "none"))))

input.source:
; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:op-i
        daed:op-ibranch
        daed:op-hist
        daed:op-fail-node
        daed:op-lambda
        daed:simulate-op-from
        daed:simulate-op-gmin
        daed:simulate-op-gmin-step
        daed:simulate-op-source
        daed:simulate-op-ptran
        daed:simulate-op-aid
        daed:op-aid
        daed:op-aid-steps
        daed:op-aid-tried
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 6 = issue #21 Gmin-step / source-step / ptran / aid chain
(define daed:solve-version 6)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Branch currents from x using the DC (or TRAN) branch map.
(define (daed:ibranch-from-x x comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps dc?)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
            (let ((idx (hash-ref br nm #f)))
              (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0) (< idx (vector-length x)))
                (hash-set! h nm (daed:vec-ref x idx))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Pad x with zeros to length n.
(define (daed:grow-vec x n)
  (if (>= (vector-length x) n)
    x
    (let ((nx (make-vector n 0.0))
          (k 0)
          (m (vector-length x)))
      (while (lambda () (< k m))
        (lambda ()
          (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1))))
      nx)))

; Finite number: NaN fails (= x x); huge values treated as non-finite.
(define (daed:finite-num? x)
  (and (number? x) (= x x) (< x 1e300) (> x -1e300)))

; 1-based node id of max |F| among voltage unknowns. 0 if none.
(define (daed:fail-node-of F n-v)
  (let ((best 0)
        (bestv -1.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n-v))
    (if (> lim (vector-length F))
      (set! lim (vector-length F))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((av (abs (daed:vec-ref F i))))
          (if (> av bestv)
            (begin
              (set! bestv av)
              (set! best (+ i 1)))
            0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    best))

(define (daed:copy-hist src n)
  (let ((h (make-vector n 0.0))
        (k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! h k (daed:vec-ref src k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    h))

; Residual at a trial state. #f if empty / not finite.
(define (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt xo)
  (let ((sys (stamp-fn xt xo)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (F (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        #f
        (let ((r (daed:vec-norm-inf F N)))
          (if (daed:finite-num? r)
            r
            #f))))))

; λ ∈ {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8}: first residual decrease; else take λ=1/8.
; Returns (list xt lam new-or-old-resid).
(define (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x dx N resid)
  (let ((lam 1.0)
        (k 0)
        (found #f)
        (xt-best #f)
        (lam-best 0.125)
        (r-best resid))
    (while (lambda () (and (not found) (< k 4)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
          (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N lam)
          (let ((r (daed:trial-resid stamp-fn xt x)))
            (if (and r (< r resid))
              (begin
                (set! found #t)
                (set! xt-best xt)
                (set! lam-best lam)
                (set! r-best r))
              (begin
                (set! k (+ k 1))
                (set! lam (* lam 0.5))))))))
    (if found
      (list xt-best lam-best r-best)
      (let ((xt (daed:grow-vec (daed:copy-vec x) N)))
        (daed:vec-add-scaled! xt dx N 0.125)
        (list xt 0.125 resid)))))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason, hist, fail_node, lambda
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t)
        (last-lam 1.0)
        (fail-node 0)
        (hist (make-vector daed:nr-maxiter 0.0))
        (hist-n 0))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (set! fail-node (daed:fail-node-of F n-v))
                (if (< hist-n daed:nr-maxiter)
                  (begin
                    (daed:vec-set! hist hist-n resid)
                    (set! hist-n (+ hist-n 1)))
                  0)
                (if (not (daed:finite-num? resid))
                  (begin
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! reason "nan"))
                  (if (< resid daed:nr-atol)
                    (begin
                      (set! ok #t)
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "converged"))
                    (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                          (i 0))
                      (while (lambda () (< i N))
                        (lambda ()
                          (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                          (set! i (+ i 1))))
                      (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                        (begin
                          (set! going #f)
                          (set! reason "singular"))
                        (begin
                          (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                          (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                            (if (< dxn daed:nr-vtol)
                              (begin
                                (set! x (daed:grow-vec x N))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                                (set! last-lam 1.0)
                                (set! ok #t)
                                (set! going #f)
                                (set! reason "converged"))
                              (let ((ls (daed:nr-line-search stamp-fn x rhs N resid)))
                                (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                                (set! x (car ls))
                                (set! last-lam (car (cdr ls)))
                                (set! resid (car (cdr (cdr ls))))))))))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (daed:finite-num? resid) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    (hash-set! res "hist" (daed:copy-hist hist hist-n))
    (hash-set! res "fail_node" fail-node)
    (hash-set! res "lambda" last-lam)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:tag-aid res name steps tried)
  (hash-set! res "aid" name)
  (hash-set! res "aid_steps" steps)
  (hash-set! res "aid_tried" tried)
  res)

(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (daed:tag-aid
      (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
        (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
        (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))
      "none" 0 (list "none"))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (hash-set! res "hist" (make-vector 1 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "fail_node" 0)
        (hash-set! res "lambda" 1.0)
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch"
              (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:pack-op-nr nr comps)
  (hash-set! nr "volts"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                         (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
      (hash)))
  (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
      (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                           comps #t)
      (hash)))
  nr)

(define (daed:x0-from-prev prev N)
  (let ((x0 (make-vector N 0.0)))
    (if (not prev)
      x0
      (let ((px (daed:op-x prev))
            (k 0)
            (m 0))
        (set! m (vector-length px))
        (if (> m N)
          (set! m N)
          0)
        (while (lambda () (< k m))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! x0 k (daed:vec-ref px k))
            (set! k (+ k 1))))
        x0))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (make-vector N 0.0))
      comps)))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (daed:pack-op-nr
      (daed:newton-solve
        (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
        (daed:x0-from-prev prev N))
      comps)))

; Restart NR from a previous .op unknown vector (same topology).
(define (daed:simulate-op-from ckt prev)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps prev)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "gmin0" (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin" 1e-12))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g)
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "D")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "Q")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M"))
          (let ((g0 (hash-ref (car cs) "gmin0" #f)))
            (if (number? g0)
              (daed:comp-set-param! (car cs) "gmin" g0)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Cold-start first; if that fails, Gmin ramp 1e-6 → 1e-12 then restore.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
      (let ((cold (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)))
        (if (hash-ref cold "ok" #f)
          cold
          (begin
            (daed:save-nl-gmin! comps)
            (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps 1e-6)
            (let ((cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
                  (g 1e-8)
                  (going #t))
              (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
                (lambda ()
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:set-all-nl-gmin! comps g)
                      (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                      (set! g (* g 0.01))))))
              (daed:restore-nl-gmin! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (hash-set! final "gmin_ramp" #t)
                (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! final "reason" "gmin")
                  0)
                final))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

(define (daed:op-ibranch res)
  (hash-ref res "ibranch" (hash)))

; Branch current of a named V/E/H (or DC L) unknown.
(define (daed:op-i res name)
  (hash-ref (daed:op-ibranch res) name 0.0))

(define (daed:op-hist res)
  (hash-ref res "hist" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-fail-node res)
  (hash-ref res "fail_node" 0))

(define (daed:op-lambda res)
  (hash-ref res "lambda" 1.0))

(define (daed:op-aid res)
  (hash-ref res "aid" "none"))

(define (daed:op-aid-steps res)
  (hash-ref res "aid_steps" 0))

(define (daed:op-aid-tried res)
  (hash-ref res "aid_tried" '()))

; Gmin from every voltage node to GND (SPICE-style). Mutates J and F.
(define (daed:apply-gmin-gnd! J F x N n-v gmin)
  (let ((k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (if (and (>= k 0) (< k N))
          (begin
            (daed:mat-add! J N k k gmin)
            (let ((xk 0.0))
              (if (< k (vector-length x))
                (set! xk (daed:vec-ref x k))
                0)
              (daed:vec-add! F k (* gmin xk))))
          0)
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    #t))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr-gmin-gnd comps gmin x0)
  (daed:pack-op-nr
    (daed:newton-solve
      (lambda (x xo)
        (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (if (and (> N 0) (number? gmin) (> gmin 0.0))
              (daed:apply-gmin-gnd! J F x N n-v gmin)
              0)
            sys)))
      x0)
    comps))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin-gmin comps gmin)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash))
            (k 0))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear-gmin")
        (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? gmin)) (<= gmin 0.0))
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            (hash-set! res "ibranch" (hash))
            res)
          (begin
            (while (lambda () (< k n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (if (< k N)
                  (daed:mat-add! A N k k gmin)
                  0)
                (set! k (+ k 1))))
            (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
              (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
              (hash-set! res "x" b)
              (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
              (hash-set! res "ibranch"
                (if ok (daed:ibranch-from-x b comps #t) (hash)))
              res)))))))

; Ramp Gmin-to-ground 1e-3 → 1e-12.
(define (daed:simulate-op-gmin-step ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:tag-aid (daed:simulate-op-lin-gmin comps 1e-12)
                    "gmin-step" 1 (list "gmin-step"))
      (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps))
            (g 1e-3)
            (cur #f)
            (steps 0)
            (going #t)
            (x0 #f))
        (set! x0 (make-vector N 0.0))
        (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-gmin-gnd comps g x0))
        (set! steps 1)
        (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
          (daed:tag-aid cur "gmin-step" steps (list "gmin-step"))
          (begin
            (set! g 1e-4)
            (while (lambda () (and going (>= g 5e-13)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-gmin-gnd comps g
                            (daed:x0-from-prev cur N)))
                (set! steps (+ steps 1))
                (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                  (set! going #f)
                  (set! g (* g 0.1)))))
            (daed:tag-aid cur "gmin-step" steps (list "gmin-step"))))))))

(define (daed:save-sources! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "V")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "I"))
          (hash-set! (car cs) "src0" (daed:comp-value (car cs)))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:scale-sources! comps s)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "V")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "I"))
          (let ((full (hash-ref (car cs) "src0" 0.0)))
            (daed:comp-set-value! (car cs) (* full s)))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:restore-sources! comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "V")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "I"))
          (let ((full (hash-ref (car cs) "src0" #f)))
            (if (number? full)
              (daed:comp-set-value! (car cs) full)
              0))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; Ramp independent V/I from 0.2 → 1.0.
(define (daed:simulate-op-source ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:tag-aid (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
                    "source-step" 0 (list "source-step"))
      (begin
        (daed:save-sources! comps)
        (let ((s 0.2)
              (cur #f)
              (steps 0)
              (going #t)
              (N (daed:mna-size comps)))
          (daed:scale-sources! comps s)
          (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
          (set! steps 1)
          (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
            (begin
              (daed:restore-sources! comps)
              (daed:tag-aid cur "source-step" steps (list "source-step")))
            (begin
              (set! s 0.4)
              (while (lambda () (and going (<= s 1.0001)))
                (lambda ()
                  (daed:scale-sources! comps s)
                  (set! cur (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur))
                  (set! steps (+ steps 1))
                  (if (not (hash-ref cur "ok" #f))
                    (set! going #f)
                    (set! s (+ s 0.2)))))
              (daed:restore-sources! comps)
              (let ((final (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
                             (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)
                             cur)))
                (daed:tag-aid final "source-step" steps
                              (list "source-step"))))))))))

; Pseudo-transient: grounded C on every node, then one DC NR.
(define (daed:apply-ptran-c! J F x xp N n-v coh)
  (let ((k 0))
    (while (lambda () (< k n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (if (< k N)
          (begin
            (daed:mat-add! J N k k coh)
            (let ((xk 0.0)
                  (xo 0.0))
              (if (< k (vector-length x))
                (set! xk (daed:vec-ref x k))
                0)
              (if (< k (vector-length xp))
                (set! xo (daed:vec-ref xp k))
                0)
              (daed:vec-add! F k (* coh (- xk xo)))))
          0)
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    #t))

(define (daed:simulate-op-ptran ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (daed:tag-aid (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
                    "ptran" 0 (list "ptran"))
      (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps))
            (h 1e-5)
            (cpt 1e-8)
            (ns 40)
            (xp #f)
            (cur #f)
            (k 0)
            (ok #t)
            (coh 0.0))
        (set! coh (/ cpt h))
        (set! xp (make-vector N 0.0))
        (while (lambda () (and ok (< k ns)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! k (+ k 1))
            (set! cur
              (daed:pack-op-nr
                (daed:newton-solve
                  (lambda (x xo)
                    (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo)))
                      (let ((Nn (car sys))
                            (J (car (cdr sys)))
                            (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                            (nv (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
                        (if (> Nn 0)
                          (daed:apply-ptran-c! J F x xp Nn nv coh)
                          0)
                        sys)))
                  xp)
                comps))
            (if (hash-ref cur "ok" #f)
              (set! xp (daed:copy-vec (daed:op-x cur)))
              (set! ok #f))))
        (if (not ok)
          (daed:tag-aid (if cur cur (hash)) "ptran" k (list "ptran"))
          (let ((final (daed:simulate-op-nr-from comps cur)))
            (if (hash-ref final "ok" #f)
              (daed:tag-aid final "ptran" k (list "ptran"))
              (daed:tag-aid cur "ptran" k (list "ptran")))))))))

; Try none → gmin-step → source-step → device-gmin → ptran.
(define (daed:simulate-op-aid ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (tried '())
        (r #f))
    (if (not (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
      (begin
        (set! r (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))
        (if (hash-ref r "ok" #f)
          (daed:tag-aid r "none" 0 (list "none"))
          (daed:tag-aid (daed:simulate-op-lin-gmin comps 1e-12)
                        "gmin-step" 1 (list "none" "gmin-step"))))
      (begin
        (set! r (daed:simulate-op-nr comps))
        (set! tried (cons "none" tried))
        (if (hash-ref r "ok" #f)
          (daed:tag-aid r "none" 0 (reverse tried))
          (begin
            (set! r (daed:simulate-op-gmin-step ckt))
            (set! tried (cons "gmin-step" tried))
            (if (hash-ref r "ok" #f)
              (begin
                (hash-set! r "aid_tried" (reverse tried))
                r)
              (begin
                (set! r (daed:simulate-op-source ckt))
                (set! tried (cons "source-step" tried))
                (if (hash-ref r "ok" #f)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! r "aid_tried" (reverse tried))
                    r)
                  (begin
                    (set! r (daed:simulate-op-gmin ckt))
                    (set! tried (cons "gmin-dev" tried))
                    (if (hash-ref r "ok" #f)
                      (daed:tag-aid r "gmin-dev"
                                    (hash-ref r "iters" 0)
                                    (reverse tried))
                      (begin
                        (set! r (daed:simulate-op-ptran ckt))
                        (set! tried (cons "ptran" tried))
                        (hash-set! r "aid_tried" (reverse tried))
                        r))))))))))))

target.name: daed:dense-solve!
target.body:
(lambda (A b n) (if (equal? (daed:solve-backend) "native")
    (if (daed:dense-solve-native! A b n)
      #t
      (begin
        (daed:solve-backend-set! "pure")
        (daed:dense-solve-pure! A b n)))
    (daed:dense-solve-pure! A b n)))

        (substring s 0 (- len n))))))

; Engineering value: number, or string "2.2k", "1uF", "5V".
; Numeric run is taken from the start; the rest is SI prefix + unit.
(define (daed:parse-value v)
  (if (number? v)
    v
    (if (not (string? v))
      #f
      (daed:parse-value-str v))))

(define (daed:num-char? ch)
  (or (equal? ch "0") (equal? ch "1") (equal? ch "2") (equal? ch "3")
      (equal? ch "4") (equal? ch "5") (equal? ch "6") (equal? ch "7")
      (equal? ch "8") (equal? ch "9") (equal? ch ".") (equal? ch "-")
      (equal? ch "+") (equal? ch "e") (equal? ch "E")))

(define (daed:str-starts? s pre)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (string? pre)))
    #f
    (let ((n (string-length s))
          (m (string-length pre)))
      (if (< n m)
        #f
        (equal? (substring s 0 m) pre)))))

(define (daed:si-scale suf)
  (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "Meg") (daed:str-starts? suf "meg"))
    1e6
    (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "k") (daed:str-starts? suf "K"))
      1e3
      (if (daed:str-starts? suf "M")
        1e6
        (if (daed:str-starts? suf "m")
          1e-3
          (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "u") (daed:str-starts? suf "µ"))
            1e-6
            (if (daed:str-starts? suf "n")
              1e-9
              (if (daed:str-starts? suf "p")
                1e-12
                1.0))))))))

(define (daed:parse-value-str s)
  (let ((n (string-length s))
        (i 0)
        (head "")
        (tail "")
        (num #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i n) (daed:num-char? (substring s i (+ i 1)))))
      (lambda () (set! i (+ i 1))))
    (if (= i 0)
      #f
      (begin
        (set! head (substring s 0 i))
        (set! tail (if (< i n) (substring s i n) ""))
        (set! num (string->number head))
        (if (number? num)
          (* num (daed:si-scale tail))
          #f)))))

; Map extractor node tokens to integer ids. GND/gnd/0 → 0.
(define (daed:node-id x)
  (if (number? x)
    (inexact->exact (round x))
    (if (not (string? x))
      -1
      (if (or (equal? x "0") (equal? x "GND") (equal? x "gnd")
              (equal? x "Gnd") (equal? x "ground"))
        0
        (let ((n (string->number x)))
          (if (number? n)
            (inexact->exact (round n))
            -1))))))

(define (daed:ir-new title)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "schema" daed:ir-schema-id)
    (hash-set! h "title" (if (string? title) title "ckt"))
    (hash-set! h "gnd" 0)
    (hash-set! h "comps" '())
    (hash-set! h "notes" "")
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "type" type)
    (hash-set! h "name" name)
    (hash-set! h "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! h "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! h "value" value)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp3 type name n1 n2 n3 value)
  (let ((h (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)))
    (hash-set! h "n3" n3)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-add-comp! ir c)
  (hash-set! ir "comps" (cons c (hash-ref ir "comps" '())))
  ir)

(define (daed:ir-title ir)
  (hash-ref ir "title" "ckt"))

(define (daed:ir-gnd ir)
  (daed:node-id (hash-ref ir "gnd" 0)))

(define (daed:ir-comps ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir-known-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")
      (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I") (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q")))

(define (daed:ir-comp->comp c)
  (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
        (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
        (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" 0)))
        (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" 0)))
        (n3 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" 0)))
        (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" 0)))
        (params (hash-ref c "params" #f)))
    (if (not (number? val))
      (set! val 0)
      0)
    (let ((out #f))
      (cond
        ((equal? ty "R") (set! out (daed:R nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "C") (set! out (daed:C nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "L") (set! out (daed:L nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "V") (set! out (daed:V nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "I") (set! out (daed:I nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "D") (set! out (daed:D* nm n1 n2
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-14)
                                           1.0 0.026)))
        ((equal? ty "Q") (set! out (daed:Q* nm n1 n2 n3
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-15)
                                           100.0 1.0 0.026)))
        (else (set! out #f)))
      (if (and out params)
        (begin
          (if (hash-ref params "n" #f)
            (hash-set! out "n" (hash-ref params "n" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "vt" #f)
            (hash-set! out "vt" (hash-ref params "vt" 0.026))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "bf" #f)
            (hash-set! out "bf" (hash-ref params "bf" 100.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "br" #f)
            (hash-set! out "br" (hash-ref params "br" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "gmin" #f)
            (hash-set! out "gmin" (hash-ref params "gmin" 1e-12))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "Is" #f)
            (hash-set! out "value" (hash-ref params "Is" val))
            0))
        0)
      out)))

; Reverse comps so ir-add-comp! cons-order still converts in source order
; when the caller used ir-add-comp!. List literals stay as written.
(define (daed:ir-comp-list ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir->circuit ir)
  (let ((title (daed:ir-title ir))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ir-comp-list ir)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (daed:circuit title (reverse acc))
        (begin
          (let ((c (daed:ir-comp->comp (car cs))))
            (if c
              (set! acc (cons c acc))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:circuit->ir ckt)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! ir "comps" (reverse acc))
          ir)
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((h (daed:ir-comp (daed:comp-type c)
                                   (daed:comp-name c)
                                   (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                   (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                   (daed:comp-value c))))
              (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                (hash-set! h "n3" (daed:comp-n3 c))
                0)
              (set! acc (cons h acc))))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:ir-ex-divider)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new "divider")))
    (hash-set! ir "comps"

  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new "series-r")))
    (hash-set! ir "comps"
      (list (daed:ir-comp "V" "vin" 1 0 5.0)
            (daed:ir-comp "R" "r1" 1 0 1e3)))
    ir))

(define (daed:ir-ex-norton)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new "norton")))
    (hash-set! ir "comps"
      (list (daed:ir-comp "I" "iin" 0 1 0.001)

            (daed:ir-comp "R" "r1" 1 2 "1k")

; lib/ir.aura — Schematic IR + conversion (issue #6 / #7)
;
; (require "ir" all:)
;
; Hash-based daedalus-ir/1. Pure Aura. No JSON parser (host residual).
; VLM / Python emit this shape; conversion to daed:circuit is deterministic.

(export daed:ir-version
        daed:ir-schema-id
        daed:str-ends?
        daed:str-drop-end
        daed:parse-value
        daed:node-id
        daed:ir-new
        daed:ir-comp
        daed:ir-comp3
        daed:ir-add-comp!
        daed:ir-title
        daed:ir-gnd
        daed:ir-comps
        daed:ir->circuit
        daed:circuit->ir
        daed:ir-ex-divider
        daed:ir-ex-rc
        daed:ir-ex-series-r
        daed:ir-ex-norton
        daed:ir-ex-diode)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:ir-version 1)
(define daed:ir-schema-id "daedalus-ir/1")

(define (daed:str-ends? s suf)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (string? suf)))
    #f
    (let ((n (string-length s))
          (m (string-length suf)))
      (if (< n m)
        #f
        (equal? (substring s (- n m) n) suf)))))

(define (daed:str-drop-end s n)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (number? n)) (< n 0))
    s
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (>= n len)
        ""
        (substring s 0 (- len n))))))

; Engineering value: number, or string "2.2k", "1uF", "5V".
; Numeric run is taken from the start; the rest is SI prefix + unit.
(define (daed:parse-value v)
  (if (number? v)
    v
    (if (not (string? v))
      #f
      (daed:parse-value-str v))))

(define (daed:num-char? ch)
  (or (equal? ch "0") (equal? ch "1") (equal? ch "2") (equal? ch "3")
      (equal? ch "4") (equal? ch "5") (equal? ch "6") (equal? ch "7")
      (equal? ch "8") (equal? ch "9") (equal? ch ".") (equal? ch "-")
      (equal? ch "+") (equal? ch "e") (equal? ch "E")))

(define (daed:str-starts? s pre)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (string? pre)))
    #f
    (let ((n (string-length s))
          (m (string-length pre)))
      (if (< n m)
        #f
        (equal? (substring s 0 m) pre)))))

(define (daed:si-scale suf)
  (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "Meg") (daed:str-starts? suf "meg"))
    1e6
    (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "k") (daed:str-starts? suf "K"))
      1e3
      (if (daed:str-starts? suf "M")
        1e6
        (if (daed:str-starts? suf "m")
          1e-3
          (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "u") (daed:str-starts? suf "µ"))
            1e-6
            (if (daed:str-starts? suf "n")
              1e-9
              (if (daed:str-starts? suf "p")
                1e-12
                1.0))))))))

(define (daed:parse-value-str s)
  (let ((n (string-length s))
        (i 0)
        (head "")
        (tail "")
        (num #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i n) (daed:num-char? (substring s i (+ i 1)))))
      (lambda () (set! i (+ i 1))))
    (if (= i 0)
      #f
      (begin
        (set! head (substring s 0 i))
        (set! tail (if (< i n) (substring s i n) ""))
        (set! num (string->number head))
        (if (number? num)
          (* num (daed:si-scale tail))
          #f)))))

; Map extractor node tokens to integer ids. GND/gnd/0 → 0.
(define (daed:node-id x)
  (if (number? x)
    (inexact->exact (round x))
    (if (not (string? x))
      -1
      (if (or (equal? x "0") (equal? x "GND") (equal? x "gnd")
              (equal? x "Gnd") (equal? x "ground"))
        0
        (let ((n (string->number x)))
          (if (number? n)
            (inexact->exact (round n))
            -1))))))

(define (daed:ir-new title)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "schema" daed:ir-schema-id)
    (hash-set! h "title" (if (string? title) title "ckt"))
    (hash-set! h "gnd" 0)
    (hash-set! h "comps" '())
    (hash-set! h "notes" "")
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "type" type)
    (hash-set! h "name" name)
    (hash-set! h "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! h "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! h "value" value)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp3 type name n1 n2 n3 value)
  (let ((h (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)))
    (hash-set! h "n3" n3)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-add-comp! ir c)
  (hash-set! ir "comps" (cons c (hash-ref ir "comps" '())))
  ir)

(define (daed:ir-title ir)
  (hash-ref ir "title" "ckt"))

(define (daed:ir-gnd ir)
  (daed:node-id (hash-ref ir "gnd" 0)))

(define (daed:ir-comps ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir-known-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")
      (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I") (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q")
      (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "G") (equal? ty "F") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ir-comp->comp c)
  (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
        (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
        (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" 0)))
        (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" 0)))
        (n3 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" 0)))
        (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" 0)))
        (params (hash-ref c "params" #f)))
    (if (not (number? val))
      (set! val 0)
      0)
    (let ((out #f))
      (cond
        ((equal? ty "R") (set! out (daed:R nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "C") (set! out (daed:C nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "L") (set! out (daed:L nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "V") (set! out (daed:V nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "I") (set! out (daed:I nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "D") (set! out (daed:D* nm n1 n2
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-14)
                                           1.0 0.026)))
        ((equal? ty "Q") (set! out (daed:Q* nm n1 n2 n3
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-15)
                                           100.0 1.0 0.026)))
        ((equal? ty "E")
         (set! out (daed:E nm n1 n2 n3
                           (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n4" 0)) val)))
        ((equal? ty "G")
         (set! out (daed:G nm n1 n2 n3
                           (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n4" 0)) val)))
        ((equal? ty "F")
         (set! out (daed:F nm n1 n2 (hash-ref c "ctrl" "") val)))
        ((equal? ty "H")
         (set! out (daed:H nm n1 n2 (hash-ref c "ctrl" "") val)))
        (else (set! out #f)))
      (if (and out params)
        (begin
          (if (hash-ref params "n" #f)
            (hash-set! out "n" (hash-ref params "n" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "vt" #f)
            (hash-set! out "vt" (hash-ref params "vt" 0.026))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "bf" #f)
            (hash-set! out "bf" (hash-ref params "bf" 100.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "br" #f)
            (hash-set! out "br" (hash-ref params "br" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "gmin" #f)
            (hash-set! out "gmin" (hash-ref params "gmin" 1e-12))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "Is" #f)
            (hash-set! out "value" (hash-ref params "Is" val))
            0))
        0)
      out)))

; Reverse comps so ir-add-comp! cons-order still converts in source order
; when the caller used ir-add-comp!. List literals stay as written.
(define (daed:ir-comp-list ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir->circuit ir)
  (let ((title (daed:ir-title ir))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ir-comp-list ir)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (daed:circuit title (reverse acc))
        (begin
          (let ((c (daed:ir-comp->comp (car cs))))
            (if c
              (set! acc (cons c acc))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:circuit->ir ckt)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! ir "comps" (reverse acc))
          ir)
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((h (daed:ir-comp (daed:comp-type c)
                                   (daed:comp-name c)
                                   (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                   (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                   (daed:comp-value c))))
              (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                (hash-set! h "n3" (daed:comp-n3 c))
                0)
              (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                      (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! h "n3" (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (hash-set! h "n4" (daed:comp-n4 c)))
                0)
              (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                      (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
                (hash-set! h "ctrl" (daed:comp-ctrl c))
                0)
              (set! acc (cons h acc))))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:ir-ex-divider)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new "divider")))

  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new "norton")))

      (list (daed:ir-comp "I" "iin" 0 1 0.001)

; lib/ir.aura — Schematic IR + conversion (issue #6 / #7)
;
; (require "ir" all:)
;
; Hash-based daedalus-ir/1. Pure Aura. No JSON parser (host residual).
; VLM / Python emit this shape; conversion to daed:circuit is deterministic.

(export daed:ir-version
        daed:ir-schema-id
        daed:str-ends?
        daed:str-drop-end
        daed:parse-value
        daed:node-id
        daed:ir-new
        daed:ir-comp
        daed:ir-comp3
        daed:ir-add-comp!
        daed:ir-title
        daed:ir-gnd
        daed:ir-comps
        daed:ir->circuit
        daed:circuit->ir
        daed:ir-ex-divider
        daed:ir-ex-rc
        daed:ir-ex-series-r
        daed:ir-ex-norton
        daed:ir-ex-diode)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:ir-version 1)
(define daed:ir-schema-id "daedalus-ir/1")

(define (daed:str-ends? s suf)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (string? suf)))
    #f
    (let ((n (string-length s))
          (m (string-length suf)))
      (if (< n m)
        #f
        (equal? (substring s (- n m) n) suf)))))

(define (daed:str-drop-end s n)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (number? n)) (< n 0))
    s
    (let ((len (string-length s)))
      (if (>= n len)
        ""
        (substring s 0 (- len n))))))

; Engineering value: number, or string "2.2k", "1uF", "5V".
; Numeric run is taken from the start; the rest is SI prefix + unit.
(define (daed:parse-value v)
  (if (number? v)
    v
    (if (not (string? v))
      #f
      (daed:parse-value-str v))))

(define (daed:num-char? ch)
  (or (equal? ch "0") (equal? ch "1") (equal? ch "2") (equal? ch "3")
      (equal? ch "4") (equal? ch "5") (equal? ch "6") (equal? ch "7")
      (equal? ch "8") (equal? ch "9") (equal? ch ".") (equal? ch "-")
      (equal? ch "+") (equal? ch "e") (equal? ch "E")))

(define (daed:str-starts? s pre)
  (if (or (not (string? s)) (not (string? pre)))
    #f
    (let ((n (string-length s))
          (m (string-length pre)))
      (if (< n m)
        #f
        (equal? (substring s 0 m) pre)))))

(define (daed:si-scale suf)
  (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "Meg") (daed:str-starts? suf "meg"))
    1e6
    (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "k") (daed:str-starts? suf "K"))
      1e3
      (if (daed:str-starts? suf "M")
        1e6
        (if (daed:str-starts? suf "m")
          1e-3
          (if (or (daed:str-starts? suf "u") (daed:str-starts? suf "µ"))
            1e-6
            (if (daed:str-starts? suf "n")
              1e-9
              (if (daed:str-starts? suf "p")
                1e-12
                1.0))))))))

(define (daed:parse-value-str s)
  (let ((n (string-length s))
        (i 0)
        (head "")
        (tail "")
        (num #f))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i n) (daed:num-char? (substring s i (+ i 1)))))
      (lambda () (set! i (+ i 1))))
    (if (= i 0)
      #f
      (begin
        (set! head (substring s 0 i))
        (set! tail (if (< i n) (substring s i n) ""))
        (set! num (string->number head))
        (if (number? num)
          (* num (daed:si-scale tail))
          #f)))))

; Map extractor node tokens to integer ids. GND/gnd/0 → 0.
(define (daed:node-id x)
  (if (number? x)
    (inexact->exact (round x))
    (if (not (string? x))
      -1
      (if (or (equal? x "0") (equal? x "GND") (equal? x "gnd")
              (equal? x "Gnd") (equal? x "ground"))
        0
        (let ((n (string->number x)))
          (if (number? n)
            (inexact->exact (round n))
            -1))))))

(define (daed:ir-new title)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "schema" daed:ir-schema-id)
    (hash-set! h "title" (if (string? title) title "ckt"))
    (hash-set! h "gnd" 0)
    (hash-set! h "comps" '())
    (hash-set! h "notes" "")
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "type" type)
    (hash-set! h "name" name)
    (hash-set! h "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! h "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! h "value" value)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-comp3 type name n1 n2 n3 value)
  (let ((h (daed:ir-comp type name n1 n2 value)))
    (hash-set! h "n3" n3)
    h))

(define (daed:ir-add-comp! ir c)
  (hash-set! ir "comps" (cons c (hash-ref ir "comps" '())))
  ir)

(define (daed:ir-title ir)
  (hash-ref ir "title" "ckt"))

(define (daed:ir-gnd ir)
  (daed:node-id (hash-ref ir "gnd" 0)))

(define (daed:ir-comps ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir-known-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")
      (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I") (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q")
      (equal? ty "M")
      (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "G") (equal? ty "F") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ir-comp->comp c)
  (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
        (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
        (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" 0)))
        (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" 0)))
        (n3 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" 0)))
        (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" 0)))
        (params (hash-ref c "params" #f)))
    (if (not (number? val))
      (set! val 0)
      0)
    (let ((out #f))
      (cond
        ((equal? ty "R") (set! out (daed:R nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "C") (set! out (daed:C nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "L") (set! out (daed:L nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "V") (set! out (daed:V nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "I") (set! out (daed:I nm n1 n2 val)))
        ((equal? ty "D") (set! out (daed:D* nm n1 n2
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-14)
                                           1.0 0.026)))
        ((equal? ty "Q") (set! out (daed:Q* nm n1 n2 n3
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 1e-15)
                                           100.0 1.0 0.026)))
        ((equal? ty "M") (set! out (daed:M* nm n1 n2 n3
                                           (if (> val 0.0) val 2e-4)
                                           20e-6 2e-6 0.8)))
        ((equal? ty "E")
         (set! out (daed:E nm n1 n2 n3
                           (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n4" 0)) val)))
        ((equal? ty "G")
         (set! out (daed:G nm n1 n2 n3
                           (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n4" 0)) val)))
        ((equal? ty "F")
         (set! out (daed:F nm n1 n2 (hash-ref c "ctrl" "") val)))
        ((equal? ty "H")
         (set! out (daed:H nm n1 n2 (hash-ref c "ctrl" "") val)))
        (else (set! out #f)))
      (if (and out params)
        (begin
          (if (hash-ref params "n" #f)
            (hash-set! out "n" (hash-ref params "n" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "vt" #f)
            (hash-set! out "vt" (hash-ref params "vt" 0.026))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "bf" #f)
            (hash-set! out "bf" (hash-ref params "bf" 100.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "br" #f)
            (hash-set! out "br" (hash-ref params "br" 1.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "gmin" #f)
            (hash-set! out "gmin" (hash-ref params "gmin" 1e-12))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "vto" #f)
            (hash-set! out "vto" (hash-ref params "vto" 0.8))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "w" #f)
            (hash-set! out "w" (hash-ref params "w" 20e-6))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "l" #f)
            (hash-set! out "l" (hash-ref params "l" 2e-6))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "lambda" #f)
            (hash-set! out "lambda" (hash-ref params "lambda" 0.0))
            0)
          (if (hash-ref params "Is" #f)
            (hash-set! out "value" (hash-ref params "Is" val))
            0))
        0)
      out)))

; Reverse comps so ir-add-comp! cons-order still converts in source order
; when the caller used ir-add-comp!. List literals stay as written.
(define (daed:ir-comp-list ir)
  (hash-ref ir "comps" '()))

(define (daed:ir->circuit ir)
  (let ((title (daed:ir-title ir))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ir-comp-list ir)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (daed:circuit title (reverse acc))
        (begin
          (let ((c (daed:ir-comp->comp (car cs))))
            (if c
              (set! acc (cons c acc))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:circuit->ir ckt)
  (let ((ir (daed:ir-new (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
        (acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! ir "comps" (reverse acc))
          ir)
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((h (daed:ir-comp (daed:comp-type c)
                                   (daed:comp-name c)
                                   (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                   (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                   (daed:comp-value c))))
              (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                      (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "M"))
                (hash-set! h "n3" (daed:comp-n3 c))
                0)
              (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                      (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! h "n3" (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (hash-set! h "n4" (daed:comp-n4 c)))
                0)
              (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                      (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
                (hash-set! h "ctrl" (daed:comp-ctrl c))
                0)
              (set! acc (cons h acc))))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; lib/stamp.aura — Modified Nodal Analysis stamping (Phase 1–2)
;
; (require "stamp" all:)
;
; DC (.op): R, V, I; C open; L short (0 V branch).
; TRAN: same + Backward-Euler companion models for C and L.
; Matrix A is row-major flat vector length N*N; b length N.
; Unknowns: [v_1 … v_m | i_branch…]  (node 0 = GND).

(export daed:stamp-version
        daed:mna-size
        daed:mna-size-tran
        daed:stamp-system
        daed:stamp-system-tran
        daed:mat-ref
        daed:mat-set!
        daed:mat-add!
        daed:vec-ref
        daed:vec-set!
        daed:vec-add!
        daed:stamp-G!
        daed:stamp-I!)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:stamp-version 2)

; DC system size: node voltages + V sources + L (treated as 0 V).
(define (daed:mna-size comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")
     (daed:count-type comps "L")))

; TRAN system size: node voltages + V sources only (C/L are companion G).
(define (daed:mna-size-tran comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")))

(define (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
  (vector-ref A (+ (* i n) j)))

(define (daed:mat-set! A n i j val)
  (vector-set! A (+ (* i n) j) val))

(define (daed:mat-add! A n i j delta)
  (daed:mat-set! A n i j (+ (daed:mat-ref A n i j) delta)))

(define (daed:vec-ref b i)
  (vector-ref b i))

(define (daed:vec-set! b i val)
  (vector-set! b i val))

(define (daed:vec-add! b i delta)
  (vector-set! b i (+ (vector-ref b i) delta)))

; Conductance stamp between n1–n2 (G > 0).
(define (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 G)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i1 G)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i2 G)
      0)
    (if (and (>= i1 0) (>= i2 0))
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i2 (* -1.0 G))
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i1 (* -1.0 G)))
      0)
    #t))

; Resistor: G = 1/R
(define (daed:stamp-R! A n n1 n2 r)
  (if (or (not (number? r)) (<= r 0.0))
    #f
    (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 (/ 1.0 r))))

; Independent current source: current leaves n1 into n2 (n1 → n2).
; KCL: -I at n1, +I at n2 on RHS (sum leaving = 0 form with A v = b).
(define (daed:stamp-I! b n n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 I)
      0)
    #t))

; Independent voltage source n1(+)–n2(-) = val; vs-idx is branch unknown.
(define (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 val vs-idx)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 vs-idx 1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i1 1.0))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 vs-idx -1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i2 -1.0))
      0)
    (daed:vec-add! b vs-idx val)
    #t))

; Inject branch current contribution on RHS: +Ieq at n1, -Ieq at n2
; (for capacitor companion Geq*v_old).
(define (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 Ieq)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 Ieq)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 (* -1.0 Ieq))
      0)
    #t))

; ── DC stamp ──
; C open (skip). L short as 0 V voltage branch.
(define (daed:stamp-system comps)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (n-L (daed:count-type comps "L")))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs n-L)))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        (daed:comp-value c)
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       ; DC short: 0 V between terminals
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        0.0
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       ; DC open
                       0)
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

; ── TRAN stamp (Backward Euler companions) ──
; state: hash with "v" (vector by node id) and "iL" (hash name → current)
(define (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs)))
      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
