input.source:
; lib/devices.aura — Nonlinear devices + NR residual/Jacobian stamp (Phase 5)
;
; (require "devices" all:)
;
; Shockley diode, Ebers-Moll NPN, Level-1 NMOS (Shichman-Hodges).
; Voltage limiting (SPICE pnjlim) + gmin keep dense NR inside V_A.
; Linear stamp path is unchanged; this module only runs when D/Q/M are present.

(export daed:devices-version
        daed:clip-exp
        daed:pnjlim
        daed:diode-vcrit
        daed:copy-vec
        daed:ax-minus-b
        daed:vec-norm-inf
        daed:vec-add-scaled!
        daed:limit-dx!
        daed:stamp-I-res!
        daed:jac-add!
        daed:res-add!
        daed:stamp-diode-nr!
        daed:stamp-bjt-nr!
        daed:stamp-mos-nr!
        daed:stamp-nonlinear!
        daed:stamp-system-nr
        daed:stamp-system-nr-tran)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

; 2 = issue #19 Level-1 MOSFET
(define daed:devices-version 2)

(define daed:exp-clip 40.0)
(define daed:sqrt2 1.414213562)

; Saturated exp so Is*exp(vd/Vt) cannot overflow the host float.
(define (daed:clip-exp arg)
  (if (> arg daed:exp-clip)
    (exp daed:exp-clip)
    (if (< arg (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp arg))))

; SPICE pnjlim: limit junction voltage used for exp() between iterates.
(define (daed:pnjlim vnew vold vt vcrit)
  (let ((out vnew)
        (dv (- vnew vold))
        (two-vt (* 2.0 vt)))
    (if (and (> vnew vcrit) (> (abs dv) two-vt))
      (if (> vold 0.0)
        (let ((arg (+ 1.0 (/ dv vt))))
          (if (> arg 0.0)
            (set! out (+ vold (* vt (log arg))))
            (set! out vcrit)))
        (if (> vnew 0.0)
          (set! out (* vt (log (/ vnew vt))))
          (set! out vcrit)))
      0)
    out))

(define (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)
  (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0) (not (number? nvt)) (<= nvt 0.0))
    0.7
    (let ((arg (/ nvt (* daed:sqrt2 Is))))
      (if (<= arg 1.0)
        nvt
        (* nvt (log arg))))))

(define (daed:copy-vec v)
  (let ((n (vector-length v))
        (out (make-vector (vector-length v) 0.0))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! out i (vector-ref v i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    out))

; y = A x - b  (new vector, length n)
(define (daed:ax-minus-b A x b n)
  (let ((y (make-vector n 0.0))
        (xn (vector-length x))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((s 0.0)
              (j 0))
          (while (lambda () (< j n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((xj (if (>= j xn) 0.0 (daed:vec-ref x j))))
                (set! s (+ s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j) xj))))
              (set! j (+ j 1))))
          (daed:vec-set! y i (- s (daed:vec-ref b i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    y))

(define (daed:vec-norm-inf v n)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n))
    (if (> lim (vector-length v))
      (set! lim (vector-length v))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (vector-ref v i))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    m))

(define (daed:vec-add-scaled! dst src n scale)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! dst i
          (+ (daed:vec-ref dst i)
             (* scale (daed:vec-ref src i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    dst))

; Scale voltage-unknown entries of dx so max |dV| ≤ dvmax. Returns scale.
(define (daed:limit-dx! dx n-v dvmax)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (k 0)
        (nv n-v))
    (if (> nv (vector-length dx))
      (set! nv (vector-length dx))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< k nv))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (daed:vec-ref dx k))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    (if (or (<= m dvmax) (<= m 0.0) (not (number? dvmax)) (<= dvmax 0.0))
      1.0
      (let ((s (/ dvmax m))
            (i 0)
            (nn (vector-length dx)))
        (while (lambda () (< i nn))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! dx i (* s (daed:vec-ref dx i)))
            (set! i (+ i 1))))
        s))))

; Residual current I flowing n1 → n2 (KCL: +I at n1, -I at n2).
(define (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i1 I)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i2 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    #t))

(define (daed:jac-add! J n na nb val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index na))
        (j (daed:node-index nb)))
    (if (and (>= i 0) (>= j 0))
      (daed:mat-add! J n i j val)
      0)))

(define (daed:res-add! F node val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index node)))
    (if (>= i 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i val)
      0)))

; ── Shockley diode ──
; Id = Is (e^{vd/(n Vt)} - 1) + gmin vd
; gd = (Is/(n Vt)) e^{vd/(n Vt)} + gmin

(define (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (nn (hash-ref c "n" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12)))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? nn)) (<= nn 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (let ((nvt (* nn vt))
            (vd-new (- (daed:x-v x n1) (daed:x-v x n2)))
            (vd-old (- (daed:x-v x-old n1) (daed:x-v x-old n2))))
        (let ((vcrit (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)))
          (let ((vd (daed:pnjlim vd-new vd-old nvt vcrit)))
            (let ((ev (daed:clip-exp (/ vd nvt))))
              (let ((id (+ (* Is (- ev 1.0)) (* gmin vd)))
                    (gd (+ (/ (* Is ev) nvt) gmin)))
                (daed:stamp-G! J n n1 n2 gd)
                (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 id)
                #t))))))))

; ── Ebers-Moll NPN ──
; IF = Is (e^{vbe/Vt} - 1), IR = Is (e^{vbc/Vt} - 1)
; IC = IF - IR (1 + 1/βR)
; IB = IF/βF + IR/βR
; IE = -(IC + IB)

(define (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nc (daed:comp-nc c))
        (nb (daed:comp-nb c))
        (ne (daed:comp-ne c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (bf (hash-ref c "bf" 100.0))
        (br (hash-ref c "br" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (vbe 0.0)
        (vbc 0.0)
        (IF 0.0)
        (IR 0.0)
        (gf 0.0)
        (gr 0.0)
        (ic 0.0)
        (ib 0.0)
        (ie 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbc 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? bf)) (<= bf 0.0)
            (not (number? br)) (<= br 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vbe (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x ne))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old ne))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! vbc (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x nc))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old nc))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! IF (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! IR (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! gf (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt))) vt))
        (set! gr (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt))) vt))
        (set! ic (- IF (* IR (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! ib (+ (/ IF bf) (/ IR br)))
        (set! ie (* -1.0 (+ ic ib)))
        (daed:res-add! F nc ic)
        (daed:res-add! F nb ib)
        (daed:res-add! F ne ie)
        ; gmin as linear junction conductances (not mixed into gf/gr)
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb ne gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb ne (* gmin vbe))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb nc gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb nc (* gmin vbc))
        (set! dIc-dVbe gf)
        (set! dIc-dVbc (* -1.0 (* gr (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! dIb-dVbe (/ gf bf))
        (set! dIb-dVbc (/ gr br))
        (set! dIe-dVbe (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbe dIb-dVbe)))
        (set! dIe-dVbc (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbc dIb-dVbc)))
        ; vbe = vB - vE, vbc = vB - vC
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nc (* -1.0 dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nb (+ dIc-dVbe dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc ne (* -1.0 dIc-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nc (* -1.0 dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nb (+ dIb-dVbe dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb ne (* -1.0 dIb-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nc (* -1.0 dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nb (+ dIe-dVbe dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne ne (* -1.0 dIe-dVbe))
        #t))))

; ── Level-1 NMOS (Shichman-Hodges), bulk = source ──
; β = Kp W/L
; cutoff  Vgs ≤ Vto:            Ids = 0
; linear  0 < Vds < Vgs−Vto:    Ids = β ((Vgs−Vto) Vds − Vds²/2) (1+λ Vds)
; sat     Vds ≥ Vgs−Vto:        Ids = (β/2) (Vgs−Vto)² (1+λ Vds)
; Reverse Vds < 0 swaps drain/source.
(define (daed:stamp-mos-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nd (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (ng (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (ns (daed:comp-n3 c))
        (kp (daed:comp-value c))
        (w (hash-ref c "w" 20e-6))
        (l (hash-ref c "l" 2e-6))
        (vto (hash-ref c "vto" 0.8))
        (lam (hash-ref c "lambda" 0.0))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (d 0)
        (s 0)
        (vd 0.0)
        (vg 0.0)
        (vs 0.0)
        (vds 0.0)
        (vgs 0.0)
        (vov 0.0)
        (beta 0.0)
        (mlam 1.0)
        (ids0 0.0)
        (ids 0.0)
        (gm 0.0)
        (gds 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? kp)) (<= kp 0.0)
            (not (number? w)) (<= w 0.0)
            (not (number? l)) (<= l 0.0)
            (not (number? vto)))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vg (daed:x-v x ng))
        (set! vd (daed:x-v x nd))
        (set! vs (daed:x-v x ns))
        (set! vds (- vd vs))
        (if (>= vds 0.0)
          (begin (set! d nd) (set! s ns))
          (begin
            (set! d ns)
            (set! s nd)
            (set! vds (* -1.0 vds))
            (set! vd (daed:x-v x d))
            (set! vs (daed:x-v x s))))
        (set! vgs (- vg vs))
        (set! beta (* kp (/ w l)))
        (if (or (not (number? lam)) (< lam 0.0))
          (set! lam 0.0)
          0)
        (if (or (not (number? gmin)) (< gmin 0.0))
          (set! gmin 1e-12)
          0)
        (set! vov (- vgs vto))
        (if (<= vov 0.0)
          (begin
            (set! ids 0.0)
            (set! gm 0.0)
            (set! gds gmin))
          (begin
            (set! mlam (+ 1.0 (* lam vds)))
            (if (< vds vov)
              (begin
                (set! ids0 (* beta (- (* vov vds) (* 0.5 (* vds vds)))))
                (set! ids (* ids0 mlam))
                (set! gm (* (* beta vds) mlam))
                (set! gds (+ (* (* beta (- vov vds)) mlam)
                             (* lam ids0)
                             gmin)))
              (begin
                (set! ids0 (* (* 0.5 beta) (* vov vov)))
                (set! ids (* ids0 mlam))
                (set! gm (* (* beta vov) mlam))
                (set! gds (+ (* lam ids0) gmin))))))
        (daed:jac-add! J n d d gds)
        (daed:jac-add! J n d s (* -1.0 (+ gds gm)))
        (daed:jac-add! J n d ng gm)
        (daed:jac-add! J n s d (* -1.0 gds))
        (daed:jac-add! J n s s (+ gds gm))
        (daed:jac-add! J n s ng (* -1.0 gm))
        (daed:res-add! F d ids)
        (daed:res-add! F s (* -1.0 ids))
        #t))))

; Constant Cgs / Cgd BE companions (only used on the .tran NR path).
(define (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h na nb C)
  (if (or (not (number? C)) (<= C 0.0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
    #f
    (let ((Geq (/ C h))
          (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
      (let ((vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev na)
                     (daed:node-voltage vprev nb)))
            (vnow (- (daed:x-v x na) (daed:x-v x nb))))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n na nb Geq)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F na nb (* Geq (- vnow vold)))
        #t))))

(define (daed:stamp-mos-caps! J F n x state h comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M")
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h
              (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n3 c) (hash-ref c "cgs" 0.0))
            (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h
              (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n1 c) (hash-ref c "cgd" 0.0)))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:stamp-nonlinear! J F n x x-old comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (let ((ty (daed:comp-type (car cs))))
          (cond
            ((equal? ty "D")
             (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "Q")
             (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "M")
             (daed:stamp-mos-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            (else 0)))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; DC NR system: J and F such that J dx = -F. Linear devices via stamp-system.
; Returns (list N J F n-v)
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

; TRAN NR system: linear BE companions + same nonlinear stamps.
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps h state x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (daed:stamp-mos-caps! A F N xx state h comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

          (y2 (daed:node-y n2)))

        (if (and (or (equal? ty "Q") (equal? ty "M")) (number? n3))

                (y3 (daed:node-y n3)))

          "\" x2=\"" (daed:num->str x2) "\" y2=\"" (daed:num->str y2)
          "\" stroke=\"#64748b\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>"
          leg3

          "<text x=\"" (daed:num->str mx) "\" y=\"" (daed:num->str (- my 2))

          "<text x=\"" (daed:num->str mx) "\" y=\"" (daed:num->str (+ my 12))
          "\" text-anchor=\"middle\" class=\"cv\">" vlab "</text>"
          "</g>")))))

input.source:
; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 2)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          #t
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen))))))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 2)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          #t
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen))))))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (n4 (daed:comp-n4 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c))
                  (ctrl (daed:comp-ctrl c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (and (or (equal? type "E") (equal? type "G"))
                           (or (not (daed:node-ok? n3))
                               (not (daed:node-ok? n4))))
                      (and (or (equal? type "F") (equal? type "H"))
                           (or (not (string? ctrl)) (equal? ctrl "")))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen)))))))))))

; F/H must name an existing voltage-defined branch (V, E, or H).
(define (daed:ctrl-branch-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (let ((c (car cs)))
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
          (let ((src (daed:find-comp ckt (daed:comp-ctrl c))))
            (if (and src (daed:ctrl-branch-type? (daed:comp-type src)))
              (loop (cdr cs))
              #f))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Change n1/n2 of a two-terminal device. Rolls back locally if topology breaks.
(define (daed:mutate-nodes! ckt name n1 n2)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! res "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            res)
          (if (or (not (daed:node-ok? n1)) (not (daed:node-ok? n2)))
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-node")
              res)
            (let ((o1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (o2 (daed:comp-n2 c)))
              (hash-set! res "old-n1" o1)
              (hash-set! res "old-n2" o2)
              (daed:comp-set-n1! c n1)
              (daed:comp-set-n2! c n2)
              (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:comp-set-n1! c o1)
                  (daed:comp-set-n2! c o2)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

input.source:
; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:mutate-nodes!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 3)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n4" (hash-ref src "n4" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "ctrl" (hash-ref src "ctrl" ""))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (n4 (daed:comp-n4 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c))
                  (ctrl (daed:comp-ctrl c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (and (or (equal? type "E") (equal? type "G"))
                           (or (not (daed:node-ok? n3))
                               (not (daed:node-ok? n4))))
                      (and (or (equal? type "F") (equal? type "H"))
                           (or (not (string? ctrl)) (equal? ctrl "")))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen)))))))))))

; F/H must name an existing voltage-defined branch (V, E, or H).
(define (daed:ctrl-branch-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (let ((c (car cs)))
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
          (let ((src (daed:find-comp ckt (daed:comp-ctrl c))))
            (if (and src (daed:ctrl-branch-type? (daed:comp-type src)))
              (loop (cdr cs))
              #f))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Change n1/n2 of a two-terminal device. Rolls back locally if topology breaks.
(define (daed:mutate-nodes! ckt name n1 n2)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! res "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            res)
          (if (or (not (daed:node-ok? n1)) (not (daed:node-ok? n2)))
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-node")
              res)
            (let ((o1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (o2 (daed:comp-n2 c)))
              (hash-set! res "old-n1" o1)
              (hash-set! res "old-n2" o2)
              (daed:comp-set-n1! c n1)
              (daed:comp-set-n2! c n2)
              (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:comp-set-n1! c o1)
                  (daed:comp-set-n2! c o2)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

input.source:
; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:mutate-nodes!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 3)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n4" (hash-ref src "n4" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "ctrl" (hash-ref src "ctrl" ""))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (n4 (daed:comp-n4 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c))
                  (ctrl (daed:comp-ctrl c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (and (or (equal? type "E") (equal? type "G"))
                           (or (not (daed:node-ok? n3))
                               (not (daed:node-ok? n4))))
                      (and (or (equal? type "F") (equal? type "H"))
                           (or (not (string? ctrl)) (equal? ctrl "")))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen)))))))))))

; F/H must name an existing voltage-defined branch (V, E, or H).
(define (daed:ctrl-branch-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (let ((c (car cs)))
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
          (let ((src (daed:find-comp ckt (daed:comp-ctrl c))))
            (if (and src (daed:ctrl-branch-type? (daed:comp-type src)))
              (loop (cdr cs))
              #f))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Change n1/n2 of a two-terminal device. Rolls back locally if topology breaks.
(define (daed:mutate-nodes! ckt name n1 n2)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! res "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            res)
          (if (or (not (daed:node-ok? n1)) (not (daed:node-ok? n2)))
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-node")
              res)
            (let ((o1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (o2 (daed:comp-n2 c)))
              (hash-set! res "old-n1" o1)
              (hash-set! res "old-n2" o2)
              (daed:comp-set-n1! c n1)
              (daed:comp-set-n2! c n2)
              (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:comp-set-n1! c o1)
                  (daed:comp-set-n2! c o2)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

input.source:
; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:mutate-nodes!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 3)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n4" (hash-ref src "n4" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "ctrl" (hash-ref src "ctrl" ""))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is"))
      (> val 0.0)
      #t)))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (n4 (daed:comp-n4 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c))
                  (ctrl (daed:comp-ctrl c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (equal? type "Q") (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (and (or (equal? type "E") (equal? type "G"))
                           (or (not (daed:node-ok? n3))
                               (not (daed:node-ok? n4))))
                      (and (or (equal? type "F") (equal? type "H"))
                           (or (not (string? ctrl)) (equal? ctrl "")))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen)))))))))))

; F/H must name an existing voltage-defined branch (V, E, or H).
(define (daed:ctrl-branch-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (let ((c (car cs)))
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
          (let ((src (daed:find-comp ckt (daed:comp-ctrl c))))
            (if (and src (daed:ctrl-branch-type? (daed:comp-type src)))
              (loop (cdr cs))
              #f))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Change n1/n2 of a two-terminal device. Rolls back locally if topology breaks.
(define (daed:mutate-nodes! ckt name n1 n2)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! res "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            res)
          (if (or (not (daed:node-ok? n1)) (not (daed:node-ok? n2)))
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-node")
              res)
            (let ((o1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (o2 (daed:comp-n2 c)))
              (hash-set! res "old-n1" o1)
              (hash-set! res "old-n2" o2)
              (daed:comp-set-n1! c n1)
              (daed:comp-set-n2! c n2)
              (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:comp-set-n1! c o1)
                  (daed:comp-set-n2! c o2)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
