input.source:
; lib/mutate-circuit.aura — Safe parameter mutate + dual snapshot (Phase 3)
;
; (require "mutate-circuit" all:)
;
; Circuit is a live FlatAST-friendly hash. Dual rollback:
;   - semantic: deep-cloned component values / topology fields
;   - denseness metrics: cloned by the facade (daed:snapshot / restore!)
;
; Host ast:snapshot may be unavailable (id -1); circuit-domain snapshot is pure Aura.

(export daed:mutate-version
        daed:find-comp
        daed:clone-comp
        daed:clone-circuit
        daed:topology-ok?
        daed:value-ok?
        daed:param-ok?
        daed:mutate-value!
        daed:mutate-param!
        daed:mutate-nodes!
        daed:restore-circuit!
        daed:circuit-snapshot
        daed:comp-snapshot-value)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:mutate-version 3)

; ── Lookup ──

(define (daed:find-comp ckt name)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Clone (semantic snapshot building blocks) ──

(define (daed:copy-model-fields! dst src)
  (hash-set! dst "n3" (hash-ref src "n3" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "n4" (hash-ref src "n4" 0))
  (hash-set! dst "ctrl" (hash-ref src "ctrl" ""))
  (hash-set! dst "n" (hash-ref src "n" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "vt" (hash-ref src "vt" 0.026))
  (hash-set! dst "bf" (hash-ref src "bf" 100.0))
  (hash-set! dst "br" (hash-ref src "br" 1.0))
  (hash-set! dst "gmin" (hash-ref src "gmin" 1e-12))
  (hash-set! dst "w" (hash-ref src "w" 20e-6))
  (hash-set! dst "l" (hash-ref src "l" 2e-6))
  (hash-set! dst "vto" (hash-ref src "vto" 0.8))
  (hash-set! dst "lambda" (hash-ref src "lambda" 0.0))
  (hash-set! dst "cgs" (hash-ref src "cgs" 0.0))
  (hash-set! dst "cgd" (hash-ref src "cgd" 0.0))
  dst)

(define (daed:clone-comp c)
  (let ((h (daed:comp (daed:comp-type c)
                      (daed:comp-name c)
                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                      (daed:comp-value c))))
    (daed:copy-model-fields! h c)
    h))

(define (daed:clone-comps cs)
  (if (null? cs)
    '()
    (cons (daed:clone-comp (car cs))
          (daed:clone-comps (cdr cs)))))

(define (daed:clone-circuit ckt)
  (daed:circuit (daed:ckt-name ckt)
                (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))))

; Circuit-only snap payload (hash): name + comps clone.
(define (daed:circuit-snapshot ckt)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt))
    (hash-set! h "comps" (daed:clone-comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    h))

(define (daed:comp-snapshot-value snap name)
  (let loop ((cs (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (daed:comp-value (car cs))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; ── Topology / value guards (Hermes-lite) ──

(define (daed:node-ok? n)
  (and (number? n) (>= n 0) (= n (round n))))

(define (daed:value-ok? type value)
  (if (not (number? value))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? type "R") (equal? type "C") (equal? type "L")
            (equal? type "D") (equal? type "Q") (equal? type "M"))
      (> value 0.0)
      #t)))

; Extra model params (n, vt, bf, br, gmin) must be positive numbers.
(define (daed:param-ok? key val)
  (if (not (number? val))
    #f
    (if (or (equal? key "n") (equal? key "vt") (equal? key "bf")
            (equal? key "br") (equal? key "gmin") (equal? key "value")
            (equal? key "Is") (equal? key "is")
            (equal? key "w") (equal? key "l") (equal? key "kp")
            (equal? key "Kp"))
      (> val 0.0)
      (if (or (equal? key "lambda") (equal? key "cgs") (equal? key "cgd"))
        (>= val 0.0)
        #t))))

(define (daed:name-seen? name seen)
  (let loop ((xs seen))
    (if (null? xs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car xs) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
  (let ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (let loop ((rest cs) (seen '()))
        (if (null? rest)
          (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
          (let ((c (car rest)))
            (let ((name (daed:comp-name c))
                  (type (daed:comp-type c))
                  (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c))
                  (n4 (daed:comp-n4 c))
                  (val (daed:comp-value c))
                  (ctrl (daed:comp-ctrl c)))
              (if (or (not (string? name))
                      (equal? name "")
                      (daed:name-seen? name seen)
                      (not (string? type))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n1))
                      (not (daed:node-ok? n2))
                      (and (or (equal? type "Q") (equal? type "M"))
                           (not (daed:node-ok? n3)))
                      (and (or (equal? type "E") (equal? type "G"))
                           (or (not (daed:node-ok? n3))
                               (not (daed:node-ok? n4))))
                      (and (or (equal? type "F") (equal? type "H"))
                           (or (not (string? ctrl)) (equal? ctrl "")))
                      (not (daed:value-ok? type val)))
                #f
                (loop (cdr rest) (cons name seen)))))))))))

; F/H must name an existing voltage-defined branch (V, E, or H).
(define (daed:ctrl-branch-type? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:ctrl-refs-ok? ckt)
  (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (let ((c (car cs)))
        (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "F")
                (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "H"))
          (let ((src (daed:find-comp ckt (daed:comp-ctrl c))))
            (if (and src (daed:ctrl-branch-type? (daed:comp-type src)))
              (loop (cdr cs))
              #f))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; ── Mutate parameter ──
; Returns hash: ok, reason, name, old, new

(define (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        (hash-set! res "old" 0)
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            (hash-set! res "old" 0)
            res)
          (let ((old (daed:comp-value c))
                (type (daed:comp-type c)))
            (hash-set! res "old" old)
            (if (not (daed:value-ok? type new-value))
              (begin
                (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                res)
              (begin
                (daed:comp-set-value! c new-value)
                (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                  (begin
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                    res)
                  (begin
                    ; roll component value back locally
                    (daed:comp-set-value! c old)
                    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                    (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                    res))))))))))

; Mutate a named model parameter (e.g. "bf", "n", "vt"). "value"/"Is" → Is.
(define (daed:mutate-param! ckt name key new-value)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (k key))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "key" key)
    (hash-set! res "new" new-value)
    (if (or (equal? k "Is") (equal? k "is"))
      (set! k "value")
      0)
    (if (equal? k "value")
      (daed:mutate-value! ckt name new-value)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (begin
          (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
          (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
          (hash-set! res "old" 0)
          res)
        (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
          (if (not c)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
              (hash-set! res "old" 0)
              res)
            (let ((old (hash-ref c k 0)))
              (hash-set! res "old" old)
              (if (not (daed:param-ok? k new-value))
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-value")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! c k new-value)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)))))))))

; Change n1/n2 of a two-terminal device. Rolls back locally if topology breaks.
(define (daed:mutate-nodes! ckt name n1 n2)
  (let ((res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "name" name)
    (hash-set! res "n1" n1)
    (hash-set! res "n2" n2)
    (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
    (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "reason" "topology")
        res)
      (let ((c (daed:find-comp ckt name)))
        (if (not c)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "reason" "not-found")
            res)
          (if (or (not (daed:node-ok? n1)) (not (daed:node-ok? n2)))
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "reason" "bad-node")
              res)
            (let ((o1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (o2 (daed:comp-n2 c)))
              (hash-set! res "old-n1" o1)
              (hash-set! res "old-n2" o2)
              (daed:comp-set-n1! c n1)
              (daed:comp-set-n2! c n2)
              (if (daed:topology-ok? ckt)
                (begin
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "applied")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (daed:comp-set-n1! c o1)
                  (daed:comp-set-n2! c o2)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "topology-after")
                  res)))))))))

; Copy snap fields onto live circuit components (same ckt object identity).
(define (daed:restore-circuit! ckt snap)
  (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '())))
        (let loop ((live (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
          (if (null? live)
            #t
            (begin
              (let ((c (car live)))
                (let ((sc (daed:find-comp-in-list snap-comps (daed:comp-name c))))
                  (if sc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! c "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! c "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! c sc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr live)))))))))

(define (daed:find-comp-in-list comps name)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #f
      (if (equal? (daed:comp-name (car cs)) name)
        (car cs)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

target.name: daed:restore-circuit!
target.body:
(lambda (ckt snap) (if (not snap)
    #f
    (begin
      (hash-set! ckt "name" (hash-ref snap "name" (daed:ckt-name ckt)))
      (let ((snap-comps (hash-ref snap "comps" '()))
            (live (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
            (acc '()))
        (let loop ((ss snap-comps))
          (if (null? ss)
            (hash-set! ckt "comps" (reverse acc))
            (begin
              (let ((sc (car ss)))
                (let ((lc (daed:find-comp-in-list live (daed:comp-name sc))))
                  (if lc
                    (begin
                      (hash-set! lc "type" (daed:comp-type sc))
                      (hash-set! lc "n1" (daed:comp-n1 sc))
                      (hash-set! lc "n2" (daed:comp-n2 sc))
                      (hash-set! lc "value" (daed:comp-value sc))
                      (daed:copy-model-fields! lc sc)

; lib/tran.aura — Fixed-step transient analysis (Phase 2)
;
; (require "tran" all:)
;
; Backward Euler, fixed dt, integer nsteps.
; Initial node voltages and L currents default to 0 (zero-state).
;
; Host note: make-vector requires an integer length; floor() returns float,
; so callers pass integer nsteps (not tstop-derived floor).

(export daed:tran-version
        daed:make-tran-state
        daed:simulate-tran
        daed:tran-ok?
        daed:tran-dt
        daed:tran-tstop
        daed:tran-nsteps
        daed:tran-times
        daed:tran-series
        daed:tran-v
        daed:tran-v-at)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "solve" all:)

(define daed:tran-version 1)

; Allocate zero-state: v[node]=0, iL[name]=0 for each L.
(define (daed:make-tran-state comps)
  (let ((m (daed:max-node comps))
        (st (hash))
        (iL (hash)))
    (hash-set! st "v" (make-vector (+ m 1) 0.0))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! st "iL" iL)
          st)
        (begin
          (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
            (hash-set! iL (daed:comp-name (car cs)) 0.0)
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Copy solution x (first n-v entries are node voltages) into state "v".
(define (daed:update-state-voltages! state x n-v)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
    (vector-set! vvec 0 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (if (< k (vector-length vvec))
            (vector-set! vvec k (daed:vec-ref x (- k 1)))
            0)
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    state))

; i_L := (h/L)*v + i_L_old after a successful step.
(define (daed:update-state-iL! comps state h)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        state
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "L")
              (let ((Lval (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (and (number? Lval) (> Lval 0.0))
                  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (name (daed:comp-name c)))
                    (let ((v (- (daed:node-voltage vvec n1)
                                (daed:node-voltage vvec n2)))
                          (iold (hash-ref iL name 0.0)))
                      (hash-set! iL name (+ (* (/ h Lval) v) iold))))
                  0))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:record-step! series-by-node times t n-v state k)
  (vector-set! times k t)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (node 1))
    (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((key (number->string node)))
          (let ((wv (hash-ref series-by-node key #f)))
            (if wv
              (vector-set! wv k (daed:node-voltage vvec node))
              0)))
        (set! node (+ node 1)))))
  #t)

; Fixed-step .tran: nsteps is a non-negative integer.
; Samples: t=0 plus nsteps ends → length nsteps+1.
; Returns hash: ok, dt, tstop, nsteps, times, series, n_v, final
(define (daed:simulate-tran ckt dt nsteps)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "dt" dt)
    (if (or (not (number? dt)) (not (number? nsteps))
            (<= dt 0.0) (< nsteps 0))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "tstop" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nsteps" 0)
        (hash-set! res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "series" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "n_v" 0)
        res)
      (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
            ; nsteps must be integer for make-vector; callers pass integer literals.
            (ns nsteps))
        (let ((nsamp (+ ns 1))
              (tstop (* dt ns))
              (state (daed:make-tran-state comps))
              (times (make-vector (+ ns 1) 0.0))
              (series (hash))
              (ok #t))
          (hash-set! res "tstop" tstop)
          (let ((node 1))
            (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (hash-set! series (number->string node)
                           (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                (set! node (+ node 1)))))
          (daed:record-step! series times 0.0 n-v state 0)
          (let ((k 1)
                (t 0.0))
            (while (lambda () (and ok (<= k ns)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! t (+ t dt))
                (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-tran comps dt state)))
                  (let ((N (car sys))
                        (A (car (cdr sys)))
                        (b (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
                    (if (or (<= N 0) (not (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
                      (set! ok #f)
                      (begin
                        (daed:update-state-voltages! state b n-v)
                        (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt)
                        (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)))))
                (set! k (+ k 1)))))
          (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
          (hash-set! res "nsteps" ns)
          (hash-set! res "times" times)
          (hash-set! res "series" series)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (hash-set! res "final" state)
          res)))))

(define (daed:tran-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:tran-dt res)
  (hash-ref res "dt" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-tstop res)
  (hash-ref res "tstop" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-nsteps res)
  (hash-ref res "nsteps" 0))

(define (daed:tran-times res)
  (hash-ref res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:tran-series res node)
  (let ((series (hash-ref res "series" (hash))))
    (hash-ref series (number->string node) (make-vector 0 0.0))))

(define (daed:tran-v-at res node k)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node)))
    (if (or (< k 0) (>= k (vector-length wv)))
      0.0
      (vector-ref wv k))))

(define (daed:tran-v res node)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node)))
    (let ((n (vector-length wv)))
      (if (<= n 0)
        0.0
        (vector-ref wv (- n 1))))))

; still needs a true integer index → use inexact->exact after round.

(export daed:tran-version
        daed:make-tran-state
        daed:nsteps-for
        daed:as-int
        daed:simulate-tran
        daed:tran-ok?
        daed:tran-dt
        daed:tran-tstop
        daed:tran-nsteps
        daed:tran-times
        daed:tran-series
        daed:tran-v
        daed:tran-v-at)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "solve" all:)

(define daed:tran-version 1)

; Nearest exact integer (vector indices / make-vector lengths).
(define (daed:as-int n)
  (if (not (number? n))
    0
    (inexact->exact (round n))))

; Step count from horizon: round(tstop/dt) as exact int.
; Prefer round over floor — float division often yields 499.999… for exact 500.
(define (daed:nsteps-for tstop dt)
  (if (or (not (number? tstop)) (not (number? dt))
          (<= dt 0.0) (< tstop 0.0))
    0
    (daed:as-int (/ tstop dt))))

; Allocate zero-state: v[node]=0, iL[name]=0 for each L.
(define (daed:make-tran-state comps)
  (let ((m (daed:max-node comps))
        (st (hash))
        (iL (hash)))
    (hash-set! st "v" (make-vector (+ m 1) 0.0))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! st "iL" iL)
          st)
        (begin
          (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
            (hash-set! iL (daed:comp-name (car cs)) 0.0)
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Copy solution x (first n-v entries are node voltages) into state "v".
(define (daed:update-state-voltages! state x n-v)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
    (vector-set! vvec 0 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (if (< k (vector-length vvec))
            (vector-set! vvec k (daed:vec-ref x (- k 1)))
            0)
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    state))

; i_L := (h/L)*v + i_L_old after a successful step.
(define (daed:update-state-iL! comps state h)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        state
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "L")
              (let ((Lval (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (and (number? Lval) (> Lval 0.0))
                  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (name (daed:comp-name c)))
                    (let ((v (- (daed:node-voltage vvec n1)
                                (daed:node-voltage vvec n2)))
                          (iold (hash-ref iL name 0.0)))
                      (hash-set! iL name (+ (* (/ h Lval) v) iold))))
                  0))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:record-step! series-by-node times t n-v state k)
  (vector-set! times k t)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (node 1))
    (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((key (number->string node)))
          (let ((wv (hash-ref series-by-node key #f)))
            (if wv
              (vector-set! wv k (daed:node-voltage vvec node))
              0)))
        (set! node (+ node 1)))))
  #t)

; Fixed-step .tran: nsteps is non-negative (int or float; coerced via round).
; Samples: t=0 plus nsteps ends → length nsteps+1.
; Returns hash: ok, dt, tstop, nsteps, times, series, n_v, final
(define (daed:simulate-tran ckt dt nsteps)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (res (hash)))
    (hash-set! res "dt" dt)
    (if (or (not (number? dt)) (not (number? nsteps))
            (<= dt 0.0) (< nsteps 0))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "tstop" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nsteps" 0)
        (hash-set! res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "series" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "n_v" 0)
        res)
      ; Coerce float step counts to exact int (vector-ref needs integer indices).
      (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
            (ns (daed:as-int nsteps)))
        (let ((nsamp (+ ns 1))
              (tstop (* dt ns))
              (state (daed:make-tran-state comps))
              (times (make-vector (+ ns 1) 0.0))
              (series (hash))
              (ok #t))
          (hash-set! res "tstop" tstop)
          (let ((node 1))
            (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (hash-set! series (number->string node)
                           (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                (set! node (+ node 1)))))
          (daed:record-step! series times 0.0 n-v state 0)
          (let ((k 1)
                (t 0.0))
            (while (lambda () (and ok (<= k ns)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! t (+ t dt))
                (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-tran comps dt state)))
                  (let ((N (car sys))
                        (A (car (cdr sys)))
                        (b (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
                    (if (or (<= N 0) (not (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
                      (set! ok #f)
                      (begin
                        (daed:update-state-voltages! state b n-v)
                        (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt)
                        (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)))))
                (set! k (+ k 1)))))
          (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
          (hash-set! res "nsteps" ns)
          (hash-set! res "times" times)
          (hash-set! res "series" series)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (hash-set! res "final" state)
          res)))))

(define (daed:tran-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:tran-dt res)
  (hash-ref res "dt" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-tstop res)
  (hash-ref res "tstop" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-nsteps res)
  (hash-ref res "nsteps" 0))

(define (daed:tran-times res)
  (hash-ref res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:tran-series res node)
  (let ((series (hash-ref res "series" (hash))))
    (hash-ref series (number->string node) (make-vector 0 0.0))))

(define (daed:tran-v-at res node k)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node))
        (ki (daed:as-int k)))
    (if (or (< ki 0) (>= ki (vector-length wv)))
      0.0
      (vector-ref wv ki))))

(define (daed:tran-v res node)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node)))
    (let ((n (vector-length wv)))
      (if (<= n 0)
        0.0
        (vector-ref wv (- n 1))))))

; lib/tran.aura — Fixed-step transient analysis (Phase 2 / 5)
;
; (require "tran" all:)
;
; Backward Euler, fixed dt.
; Nonlinear circuits: BE companions + Newton-Raphson at each step.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot companion solve.
; nsteps may be integer or float (e.g. from tstop/dt); coerced to exact int.
; Initial node voltages and L currents default to 0 (zero-state).
; Host: make-vector accepts integer-valued floats (aura#2965); vector-ref
; still needs a true integer index → use inexact->exact after round.

(export daed:tran-version
        daed:make-tran-state
        daed:nsteps-for
        daed:as-int
        daed:simulate-tran
        daed:tran-ok?
        daed:tran-dt
        daed:tran-tstop
        daed:tran-nsteps
        daed:tran-times
        daed:tran-series
        daed:tran-v
        daed:tran-v-at
        daed:tran-iters
        daed:tran-nr-fail)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "solve" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

(define daed:tran-version 2)

; Nearest exact integer (vector indices / make-vector lengths).
(define (daed:as-int n)
  (if (not (number? n))
    0
    (inexact->exact (round n))))

; Step count from horizon: round(tstop/dt) as exact int.
; Prefer round over floor — float division often yields 499.999… for exact 500.
(define (daed:nsteps-for tstop dt)
  (if (or (not (number? tstop)) (not (number? dt))
          (<= dt 0.0) (< tstop 0.0))
    0
    (daed:as-int (/ tstop dt))))

; Allocate zero-state: v[node]=0, iL[name]=0 for each L.
(define (daed:make-tran-state comps)
  (let ((m (daed:max-node comps))
        (st (hash))
        (iL (hash)))
    (hash-set! st "v" (make-vector (+ m 1) 0.0))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! st "iL" iL)
          st)
        (begin
          (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
            (hash-set! iL (daed:comp-name (car cs)) 0.0)
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Copy solution x (first n-v entries are node voltages) into state "v".
(define (daed:update-state-voltages! state x n-v)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
    (vector-set! vvec 0 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (if (< k (vector-length vvec))
            (vector-set! vvec k (daed:vec-ref x (- k 1)))
            0)
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    state))

; i_L := (h/L)*v + i_L_old after a successful step.
(define (daed:update-state-iL! comps state h)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        state
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "L")
              (let ((Lval (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (and (number? Lval) (> Lval 0.0))
                  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (name (daed:comp-name c)))
                    (let ((v (- (daed:node-voltage vvec n1)
                                (daed:node-voltage vvec n2)))
                          (iold (hash-ref iL name 0.0)))
                      (hash-set! iL name (+ (* (/ h Lval) v) iold))))
                  0))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:record-step! series-by-node times t n-v state k)
  (vector-set! times k t)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (node 1))
    (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((key (number->string node)))
          (let ((wv (hash-ref series-by-node key #f)))
            (if wv
              (vector-set! wv k (daed:node-voltage vvec node))
              0)))
        (set! node (+ node 1)))))
  #t)

; Seed an MNA vector from the previous-step node voltages.
(define (daed:state->x state n)
  (let ((x (make-vector n 0.0))
        (vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (k 1)
        (vmax (- (vector-length vvec) 1)))
    (while (lambda () (and (<= k vmax) (< (- k 1) n)))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! x (- k 1) (daed:node-voltage vvec k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    x))

; One BE + NR time step. Mutates state. Returns nr result hash.
(define (daed:tran-step-nr! comps dt state)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size-tran comps))
        (n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)))
    (let ((x0 (daed:state->x state N)))
      (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                  (lambda (x xo)
                    (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps dt state x xo))
                  x0)))
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (begin
            (daed:update-state-voltages! state (hash-ref nr "x" x0) n-v)
            (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt))
          0)
        nr))))

; Fixed-step .tran: nsteps is non-negative (int or float; coerced via round).
; Samples: t=0 plus nsteps ends → length nsteps+1.
; Returns hash: ok, dt, tstop, nsteps, times, series, n_v, final
; Nonlinear: also iters (sum of NR iters) and nr_fail count.
(define (daed:simulate-tran ckt dt nsteps)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (res (hash))
        (nl #f))
    (hash-set! res "dt" dt)
    (set! nl (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
    (if (or (not (number? dt)) (not (number? nsteps))
            (<= dt 0.0) (< nsteps 0))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "tstop" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nsteps" 0)
        (hash-set! res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "series" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "n_v" 0)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 0)
        res)
      ; Coerce float step counts to exact int (vector-ref needs integer indices).
      (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
            (ns (daed:as-int nsteps)))
        (let ((nsamp (+ ns 1))
              (tstop (* dt ns))
              (state (daed:make-tran-state comps))
              (times (make-vector (+ ns 1) 0.0))
              (series (hash))
              (ok #t)
              (iters 0)
              (nr-fail 0))
          (hash-set! res "tstop" tstop)
          (let ((node 1))
            (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (hash-set! series (number->string node)
                           (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                (set! node (+ node 1)))))
          (daed:record-step! series times 0.0 n-v state 0)
          (let ((k 1)
                (t 0.0))
            (while (lambda () (and ok (<= k ns)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! t (+ t dt))
                (if nl
                  (let ((nr (daed:tran-step-nr! comps dt state)))
                    (set! iters (+ iters (hash-ref nr "iters" 0)))
                    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
                      (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)
                      (begin
                        (set! ok #f)
                        (set! nr-fail (+ nr-fail 1)))))
                  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-tran comps dt state)))
                    (let ((N (car sys))
                          (A (car (cdr sys)))
                          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
                      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
                        (set! ok #f)
                        (begin
                          (daed:update-state-voltages! state b n-v)
                          (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt)
                          (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k))))))
                (set! k (+ k 1)))))
          (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
          (hash-set! res "nsteps" ns)
          (hash-set! res "times" times)
          (hash-set! res "series" series)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (hash-set! res "final" state)
          (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
          (hash-set! res "nr_fail" nr-fail)
          (hash-set! res "nr" nl)
          res)))))

(define (daed:tran-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:tran-dt res)
  (hash-ref res "dt" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-tstop res)
  (hash-ref res "tstop" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-nsteps res)
  (hash-ref res "nsteps" 0))

(define (daed:tran-times res)
  (hash-ref res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:tran-series res node)
  (let ((series (hash-ref res "series" (hash))))
    (hash-ref series (number->string node) (make-vector 0 0.0))))

(define (daed:tran-v-at res node k)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node))
        (ki (daed:as-int k)))
    (if (or (< ki 0) (>= ki (vector-length wv)))

      (vector-ref wv ki))))

(define (daed:tran-v res node)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node)))

        0.0
        (vector-ref wv (- n 1))))))

(define (daed:tran-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:tran-nr-fail res)
  (hash-ref res "nr_fail" 0))

input.source:
; lib/tran.aura — Fixed-step transient analysis (Phase 2 / 5)
;
; (require "tran" all:)
;
; Backward Euler, fixed dt.
; Nonlinear circuits: BE companions + Newton-Raphson at each step.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot companion solve.
; nsteps may be integer or float (e.g. from tstop/dt); coerced to exact int.
; Initial node voltages and L currents default to 0 (zero-state).
; Host: make-vector accepts integer-valued floats (aura#2965); vector-ref
; still needs a true integer index → use inexact->exact after round.

(export daed:tran-version
        daed:make-tran-state
        daed:nsteps-for
        daed:as-int
        daed:simulate-tran
        daed:tran-ok?
        daed:tran-dt
        daed:tran-tstop
        daed:tran-nsteps
        daed:tran-times
        daed:tran-series
        daed:tran-v
        daed:tran-v-at
        daed:tran-i
        daed:tran-i-at
        daed:tran-i-series
        daed:tran-iters
        daed:tran-nr-fail)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "solve" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

(define daed:tran-version 3)

; Nearest exact integer (vector indices / make-vector lengths).
(define (daed:as-int n)
  (if (not (number? n))
    0
    (inexact->exact (round n))))

; Step count from horizon: round(tstop/dt) as exact int.
; Prefer round over floor — float division often yields 499.999… for exact 500.
(define (daed:nsteps-for tstop dt)
  (if (or (not (number? tstop)) (not (number? dt))
          (<= dt 0.0) (< tstop 0.0))
    0
    (daed:as-int (/ tstop dt))))

; Allocate zero-state: v[node]=0, iL[name]=0 for each L.
(define (daed:make-tran-state comps)
  (let ((m (daed:max-node comps))
        (st (hash))
        (iL (hash)))
    (hash-set! st "v" (make-vector (+ m 1) 0.0))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        (begin
          (hash-set! st "iL" iL)
          st)
        (begin
          (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
            (hash-set! iL (daed:comp-name (car cs)) 0.0)
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Copy solution x (first n-v entries are node voltages) into state "v".
(define (daed:update-state-voltages! state x n-v)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
    (vector-set! vvec 0 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (if (< k (vector-length vvec))
            (vector-set! vvec k (daed:vec-ref x (- k 1)))
            0)
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    state))

; i_L := (h/L)*v + i_L_old after a successful step.
(define (daed:update-state-iL! comps state h)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        state
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "L")
              (let ((Lval (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (and (number? Lval) (> Lval 0.0))
                  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (name (daed:comp-name c)))
                    (let ((v (- (daed:node-voltage vvec n1)
                                (daed:node-voltage vvec n2)))
                          (iold (hash-ref iL name 0.0)))
                      (hash-set! iL name (+ (* (/ h Lval) v) iold))))
                  0))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:record-step! series-by-node times t n-v state k)
  (vector-set! times k t)
  (let ((vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (node 1))
    (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((key (number->string node)))
          (let ((wv (hash-ref series-by-node key #f)))
            (if wv
              (vector-set! wv k (daed:node-voltage vvec node))
              0)))
        (set! node (+ node 1)))))
  #t)

(define (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state k)
  (let ((iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        #t
        (begin
          (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
            (let ((nm (daed:comp-name (car cs))))
              (let ((wv (hash-ref iseries nm #f)))
                (if wv
                  (vector-set! wv k (hash-ref iL nm 0.0))
                  0)))
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Seed an MNA vector from the previous-step node voltages.
(define (daed:state->x state n)
  (let ((x (make-vector n 0.0))
        (vvec (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (k 1)
        (vmax (- (vector-length vvec) 1)))
    (while (lambda () (and (<= k vmax) (< (- k 1) n)))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! x (- k 1) (daed:node-voltage vvec k))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    x))

; One BE + NR time step. Mutates state. Returns nr result hash.
(define (daed:tran-step-nr! comps dt state)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size-tran comps))
        (n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)))
    (let ((x0 (daed:state->x state N)))
      (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                  (lambda (x xo)
                    (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps dt state x xo))
                  x0)))
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (begin
            (daed:update-state-voltages! state (hash-ref nr "x" x0) n-v)
            (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt))
          0)
        nr))))

; Fixed-step .tran: nsteps is non-negative (int or float; coerced via round).
; Samples: t=0 plus nsteps ends → length nsteps+1.
; Returns hash: ok, dt, tstop, nsteps, times, series, n_v, final
; Nonlinear: also iters (sum of NR iters) and nr_fail count.
(define (daed:simulate-tran ckt dt nsteps)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (res (hash))
        (nl #f))
    (hash-set! res "dt" dt)
    (set! nl (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
    (if (or (not (number? dt)) (not (number? nsteps))
            (<= dt 0.0) (< nsteps 0))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "tstop" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nsteps" 0)
        (hash-set! res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "series" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "iseries" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "n_v" 0)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 0)
        res)
      ; Coerce float step counts to exact int (vector-ref needs integer indices).
      (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
            (ns (daed:as-int nsteps)))
        (let ((nsamp (+ ns 1))
              (tstop (* dt ns))
              (state (daed:make-tran-state comps))
              (times (make-vector (+ ns 1) 0.0))
              (series (hash))
              (iseries (hash))
              (ok #t)
              (iters 0)
              (nr-fail 0))
          (hash-set! res "tstop" tstop)
          (let ((node 1))
            (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (hash-set! series (number->string node)
                           (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                (set! node (+ node 1)))))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              0
              (begin
                (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
                  (hash-set! iseries (daed:comp-name (car cs))
                             (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr cs)))))
          (daed:record-step! series times 0.0 n-v state 0)
          (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state 0)
          (let ((k 1)
                (t 0.0))
            (while (lambda () (and ok (<= k ns)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! t (+ t dt))
                (if nl
                  (let ((nr (daed:tran-step-nr! comps dt state)))
                    (set! iters (+ iters (hash-ref nr "iters" 0)))
                    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
                      (begin
                        (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)
                        (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state k))
                      (begin
                        (set! ok #f)
                        (set! nr-fail (+ nr-fail 1)))))
                  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system-tran comps dt state)))
                    (let ((N (car sys))
                          (A (car (cdr sys)))
                          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys)))))
                      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
                        (set! ok #f)
                        (begin
                          (daed:update-state-voltages! state b n-v)
                          (daed:update-state-iL! comps state dt)
                          (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)
                          (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state k))))))
                (set! k (+ k 1)))))
          (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
          (hash-set! res "nsteps" ns)
          (hash-set! res "times" times)
          (hash-set! res "series" series)
          (hash-set! res "iseries" iseries)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (hash-set! res "final" state)
          (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
          (hash-set! res "nr_fail" nr-fail)
          (hash-set! res "nr" nl)
          res)))))

(define (daed:tran-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:tran-dt res)
  (hash-ref res "dt" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-tstop res)
  (hash-ref res "tstop" 0.0))

(define (daed:tran-nsteps res)
  (hash-ref res "nsteps" 0))

(define (daed:tran-times res)
  (hash-ref res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:tran-series res node)
  (let ((series (hash-ref res "series" (hash))))
    (hash-ref series (number->string node) (make-vector 0 0.0))))

(define (daed:tran-v-at res node k)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node))
        (ki (daed:as-int k)))
    (if (or (< ki 0) (>= ki (vector-length wv)))
      0.0
      (vector-ref wv ki))))

(define (daed:tran-v res node)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-series res node)))
    (let ((n (vector-length wv)))
      (if (<= n 0)
        0.0
        (vector-ref wv (- n 1))))))

(define (daed:tran-i-series res name)
  (let ((iseries (hash-ref res "iseries" (hash))))
    (hash-ref iseries name (make-vector 0 0.0))))

(define (daed:tran-i-at res name k)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-i-series res name))
        (ki (daed:as-int k)))
    (if (or (< ki 0) (>= ki (vector-length wv)))
      0.0
      (vector-ref wv ki))))

(define (daed:tran-i res name)
  (let ((wv (daed:tran-i-series res name)))
    (let ((n (vector-length wv)))
      (if (<= n 0)
        0.0
        (vector-ref wv (- n 1))))))

(define (daed:tran-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:tran-nr-fail res)
  (hash-ref res "nr_fail" 0))

target.body:
(lambda (ckt dt nsteps) (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt))
        (res (hash))
        (nl #f))
    (hash-set! res "dt" dt)
    (set! nl (daed:has-nonlinear? comps))
    (if (or (not (number? dt)) (not (number? nsteps))
            (<= dt 0.0) (< nsteps 0))
      (begin
        (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
        (hash-set! res "tstop" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nsteps" 0)
        (hash-set! res "times" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "series" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "iseries" (hash))
        (hash-set! res "n_v" 0)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 0)
        (hash-set! res "accepted" 0)
        (hash-set! res "rejected" 0)
        (hash-set! res "dthist" (make-vector 0 0.0))
        (hash-set! res "lte" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "adapt" #f)
        res)
      ; Coerce float step counts to exact int (vector-ref needs integer indices).
      (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
            (ns (daed:as-int nsteps)))
        (let ((nsamp (+ ns 1))
              (tstop (* dt ns))
              (state (daed:make-tran-state comps))
              (times (make-vector (+ ns 1) 0.0))
              (series (hash))
              (iseries (hash))
              (ok #t)
              (iters 0)
              (nr-fail 0))
          (hash-set! res "tstop" tstop)
          (let ((node 1))
            (while (lambda () (<= node n-v))
              (lambda ()
                (hash-set! series (number->string node)
                           (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                (set! node (+ node 1)))))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              0
              (begin
                (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "L")
                  (hash-set! iseries (daed:comp-name (car cs))
                             (make-vector nsamp 0.0))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr cs)))))
          (daed:record-step! series times 0.0 n-v state 0)
          (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state 0)
          (let ((k 1)
                (t 0.0))
            (while (lambda () (and ok (<= k ns)))
              (lambda ()
                (set! t (+ t dt))
                (if nl
                  (let ((nr (daed:tran-step-nr! comps dt state)))
                    (set! iters (+ iters (hash-ref nr "iters" 0)))
                    (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
                      (begin
                        (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)
                        (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state k))
                      (begin
                        (set! ok #f)
                        (set! nr-fail (+ nr-fail 1)))))
                  (if (not (daed:tran-step-lin! comps dt state))
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (begin
                      (daed:record-step! series times t n-v state k)
                      (daed:record-iL! iseries comps state k))))
                (set! k (+ k 1)))))
          (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
          (hash-set! res "nsteps" ns)
          (hash-set! res "times" times)
          (hash-set! res "series" series)
          (hash-set! res "iseries" iseries)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (hash-set! res "final" state)
          (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
          (hash-set! res "nr_fail" nr-fail)
          (hash-set! res "nr" nl)
          (hash-set! res "accepted" ns)
          (hash-set! res "rejected" 0)
          (hash-set! res "dthist" (make-vector ns dt))
          (hash-set! res "lte" 0.0)
          (hash-set! res "adapt" #f)
          res)))))

; lib/hephaestus-measure.aura — Axis F: metrology for denseness probes
;
; (require "hephaestus-measure" all:)
;
; Wall clock is host (current-time) in whole seconds — coarse but pure-Aura.
; Prefer large enough loads so elapsed_s >= 1 when reporting ops/s.

(export heph:stats
        heph:stats-reset!
        heph:stats-ref
        heph:stats-bump!
        heph:stats-set!
        heph:stats-alist
        heph:alist-ref
        heph:time-call
        heph:ops-per-sec)

(define *heph-stats*
  (hash "kernels_run" 0
        "ops_total" 0
        "correctness_ok" 0
        "correctness_fail" 0
        "escapes" 0
        "last_elapsed_s" 0
        "last_ops" 0
        "last_result" 0))

(define (heph:stats)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-reset!)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "kernels_run" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "ops_total" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "correctness_ok" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "correctness_fail" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "escapes" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_elapsed_s" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_ops" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_result" 0)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (hash-ref *heph-stats* key 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (heph:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (heph:stats-ref key))))
    (hash-set! *heph-stats* key n)
    n))

(define (heph:stats-set! key val)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* key val)
  val)

(define (heph:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "kernels_run" (heph:stats-ref "kernels_run"))
        (cons "ops_total" (heph:stats-ref "ops_total"))
        (cons "correctness_ok" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_ok"))
        (cons "correctness_fail" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_fail"))
        (cons "escapes" (heph:stats-ref "escapes"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" (heph:stats-ref "last_elapsed_s"))
        (cons "last_ops" (heph:stats-ref "last_ops"))
        (cons "last_result" (heph:stats-ref "last_result"))))

(define (heph:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let loop ((ys lst))
    (cond ((null? ys) default)
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
          (else (loop (cdr ys))))))

; Run thunk once; record wall seconds (host resolution: 1s).
; ops: logical operation count for this run (caller-defined).
; Returns alist: :result :elapsed_s :ops :ops_per_s
(define (heph:time-call thunk ops)
  (let* ((t0 (current-time))
         (result (thunk))
         (t1 (current-time))
         (elapsed (if (and (number? t0) (number? t1)) (- t1 t0) 0))
         (elapsed (if (and (number? elapsed) (>= elapsed 0)) elapsed 0))
         (ops-n (if (number? ops) ops 0))
         (ops-s (heph:ops-per-sec ops-n elapsed)))
    (heph:stats-bump! "kernels_run")
    (heph:stats-set! "ops_total" (+ (heph:stats-ref "ops_total") ops-n))
    (heph:stats-set! "last_elapsed_s" elapsed)
    (heph:stats-set! "last_ops" ops-n)
    (heph:stats-set! "last_result" (if (number? result) result 0))
    (list (cons ":result" result)
          (cons ":elapsed_s" elapsed)
          (cons ":ops" ops-n)
          (cons ":ops_per_s" ops-s))))

(define (heph:ops-per-sec ops elapsed)
  (if (and (number? ops) (number? elapsed) (> elapsed 0))
    (/ ops elapsed)
    0))

; lib/hephaestus-measure.aura — Axis F: metrology for denseness probes
;
; (require "hephaestus-measure" all:)
;
; Wall clock is host (current-time) in whole seconds — coarse but pure-Aura.
; Prefer large enough loads so elapsed_s >= 1 when reporting ops/s.

(export heph:stats
        heph:stats-reset!
        heph:stats-ref
        heph:stats-bump!
        heph:stats-set!
        heph:stats-alist
        heph:alist-ref
        heph:time-call
        heph:ops-per-sec)

(define *heph-stats*
  (hash "kernels_run" 0
        "ops_total" 0
        "correctness_ok" 0
        "correctness_fail" 0
        "escapes" 0
        "last_elapsed_s" 0
        "last_ops" 0
        "last_result" 0))

(define (heph:stats)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-reset!)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "kernels_run" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "ops_total" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "correctness_ok" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "correctness_fail" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "escapes" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_elapsed_s" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_ops" 0)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* "last_result" 0)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (hash-ref *heph-stats* key 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (heph:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (heph:stats-ref key))))
    (hash-set! *heph-stats* key n)
    n))

(define (heph:stats-set! key val)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* key val)
  val)

(define (heph:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "kernels_run" (heph:stats-ref "kernels_run"))
        (cons "ops_total" (heph:stats-ref "ops_total"))
        (cons "correctness_ok" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_ok"))
        (cons "correctness_fail" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_fail"))
        (cons "escapes" (heph:stats-ref "escapes"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" (heph:stats-ref "last_elapsed_s"))
        (cons "last_ops" (heph:stats-ref "last_ops"))
        (cons "last_result" (heph:stats-ref "last_result"))))

(define (heph:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let loop ((ys lst))
    (cond ((null? ys) default)
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
          (else (loop (cdr ys))))))

; Run thunk once; record wall seconds (host resolution: 1s).
; ops: logical operation count for this run (caller-defined).
; Returns alist: :result :elapsed_s :ops :ops_per_s
(define (heph:time-call thunk ops)
  (let* ((t0 (current-time))
         (result (thunk))
         (t1 (current-time))
         (elapsed (if (and (number? t0) (number? t1)) (- t1 t0) 0))
         (elapsed (if (and (number? elapsed) (>= elapsed 0)) elapsed 0))
         (ops-n (if (number? ops) ops 0))
         (ops-s (heph:ops-per-sec ops-n elapsed)))
    (heph:stats-bump! "kernels_run")
    (heph:stats-set! "ops_total" (+ (heph:stats-ref "ops_total") ops-n))
    (heph:stats-set! "last_elapsed_s" elapsed)
    (heph:stats-set! "last_ops" ops-n)
    (heph:stats-set! "last_result" (if (number? result) result 0))
    (list (cons ":result" result)
          (cons ":elapsed_s" elapsed)
          (cons ":ops" ops-n)
          (cons ":ops_per_s" ops-s))))

(define (heph:ops-per-sec ops elapsed)
  (if (and (number? ops) (number? elapsed) (> elapsed 0))
    (/ ops elapsed)
    0))

input.source:
; lib/hephaestus-measure.aura — Axis F: metrology for denseness probes
;
; (require "hephaestus-measure" all:)
;
; Wall clock is host (current-time) in whole seconds — coarse but pure-Aura.
; Prefer large enough loads so elapsed_s >= 1 when reporting ops/s.
;
; Host residual H6: FlatHashTable effectively holds ~8 keys; multi-entry
; hash literals and large tables drop keys. Metrology uses an **alist**
; cell instead of a process-wide hash.

(export heph:stats
        heph:stats-reset!
        heph:stats-ref
        heph:stats-bump!
        heph:stats-set!
        heph:stats-alist
        heph:alist-ref
        heph:time-call
        heph:ops-per-sec)

(define (heph:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let loop ((ys lst))
    (cond ((null? ys) default)
          ((not (pair? (car ys))) (loop (cdr ys)))
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
          (else (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (heph:alist-set key val lst)
  (let loop ((ys lst) (acc '()))
    (cond ((null? ys) (cons (cons key val) (reverse acc)))
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key)
           (append (reverse acc) (cons (cons key val) (cdr ys))))
          (else (loop (cdr ys) (cons (car ys) acc))))))

(define (heph:make-stats-alist)
  (list (cons "kernels_run" 0)
        (cons "ops_total" 0)
        (cons "correctness_ok" 0)
        (cons "correctness_fail" 0)
        (cons "ownership_ok" 0)
        (cons "ownership_fail" 0)
        (cons "escapes" 0)
        (cons "last_escape_reason" 0)
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" 0)
        (cons "last_ops" 0)
        (cons "last_result" 0)))

(define *heph-stats* (heph:make-stats-alist))

(define (heph:stats)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-reset!)
  (set! *heph-stats* (heph:make-stats-alist))
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (heph:alist-ref key *heph-stats* 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (heph:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (heph:stats-ref key))))
    (set! *heph-stats* (heph:alist-set key n *heph-stats*))
    n))

(define (heph:stats-set! key val)
  (set! *heph-stats* (heph:alist-set key val *heph-stats*))
  val)

(define (heph:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "kernels_run" (heph:stats-ref "kernels_run"))
        (cons "ops_total" (heph:stats-ref "ops_total"))
        (cons "correctness_ok" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_ok"))
        (cons "correctness_fail" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_fail"))
        (cons "ownership_ok" (heph:stats-ref "ownership_ok"))
        (cons "ownership_fail" (heph:stats-ref "ownership_fail"))
        (cons "escapes" (heph:stats-ref "escapes"))
        (cons "last_escape_reason" (heph:stats-ref "last_escape_reason"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" (heph:stats-ref "last_elapsed_s"))
        (cons "last_ops" (heph:stats-ref "last_ops"))
        (cons "last_result" (heph:stats-ref "last_result"))))

; Run thunk once; record wall seconds (host resolution: 1s).
; ops: logical operation count for this run (caller-defined).
; Returns alist: :result :elapsed_s :ops :ops_per_s
(define (heph:time-call thunk ops)
  (let ((t0 (current-time)))
    (let ((result (thunk)))
      (let ((t1 (current-time)))
        (let ((elapsed
                (if (and (number? t0) (number? t1) (>= (- t1 t0) 0))
                  (- t1 t0)
                  0)))
          (let ((ops-n (if (number? ops) ops 0)))
            (let ((ops-s (heph:ops-per-sec ops-n elapsed)))
              (heph:stats-bump! "kernels_run")
              (heph:stats-set! "ops_total" (+ (heph:stats-ref "ops_total") ops-n))
              (heph:stats-set! "last_elapsed_s" elapsed)
              (heph:stats-set! "last_ops" ops-n)
              (heph:stats-set! "last_result" (if (number? result) result 0))
              (list (cons ":result" result)
                    (cons ":elapsed_s" elapsed)
                    (cons ":ops" ops-n)
                    (cons ":ops_per_s" ops-s)))))))))

(define (heph:ops-per-sec ops elapsed)
  (if (and (number? ops) (number? elapsed) (> elapsed 0))
    (/ ops elapsed)
    0))

; lib/hephaestus-measure.aura — Axis F: metrology for denseness probes
;
; (require "hephaestus-measure" all:)
;
; Wall clock is host (current-time) in whole seconds — coarse but pure-Aura.
; Prefer large enough loads so elapsed_s >= 1 when reporting ops/s.
;
; Stats storage: process hash (#2654 grow past 8 keys). Alist helpers remain
; for probe result alists (heph:alist-ref) and heph:stats-alist export.

(export heph:stats
        heph:stats-reset!
        heph:stats-ref
        heph:stats-bump!
        heph:stats-set!
        heph:stats-alist
        heph:alist-ref
        heph:time-call
        heph:ops-per-sec)

(define (heph:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let loop ((ys lst))
    (cond ((null? ys) default)
          ((not (pair? (car ys))) (loop (cdr ys)))
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
          (else (loop (cdr ys))))))

; Process-wide stats hash (grows under #2654).
(define (heph:make-stats-hash)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "kernels_run" 0)
    (hash-set! h "ops_total" 0)
    (hash-set! h "correctness_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "correctness_fail" 0)
    (hash-set! h "ownership_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "ownership_fail" 0)
    (hash-set! h "escapes" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_escape_reason" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_elapsed_s" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_ops" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_result" 0)
    (hash-set! h "fiber_spawns" 0)
    (hash-set! h "fiber_joins" 0)
    h))

(define *heph-stats* (heph:make-stats-hash))

(define (heph:stats)
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-reset!)
  (set! *heph-stats* (heph:make-stats-hash))
  *heph-stats*)

(define (heph:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (hash-ref *heph-stats* key 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (heph:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (heph:stats-ref key))))
    (hash-set! *heph-stats* key n)
    n))

(define (heph:stats-set! key val)
  (hash-set! *heph-stats* key val)
  val)

(define (heph:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "kernels_run" (heph:stats-ref "kernels_run"))
        (cons "ops_total" (heph:stats-ref "ops_total"))
        (cons "correctness_ok" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_ok"))
        (cons "correctness_fail" (heph:stats-ref "correctness_fail"))
        (cons "ownership_ok" (heph:stats-ref "ownership_ok"))
        (cons "ownership_fail" (heph:stats-ref "ownership_fail"))
        (cons "escapes" (heph:stats-ref "escapes"))
        (cons "last_escape_reason" (heph:stats-ref "last_escape_reason"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" (heph:stats-ref "last_elapsed_s"))
        (cons "last_ops" (heph:stats-ref "last_ops"))
        (cons "last_result" (heph:stats-ref "last_result"))
        (cons "fiber_spawns" (heph:stats-ref "fiber_spawns"))
        (cons "fiber_joins" (heph:stats-ref "fiber_joins"))))

; Run thunk once; record wall seconds (host resolution: 1s).
; ops: logical operation count for this run (caller-defined).
; Returns alist: :result :elapsed_s :ops :ops_per_s
(define (heph:time-call thunk ops)
  (let ((t0 (current-time)))
    (let ((result (thunk)))
      (let ((t1 (current-time)))
        (let ((elapsed
                (if (and (number? t0) (number? t1) (>= (- t1 t0) 0))
                  (- t1 t0)
                  0)))
          (let ((ops-n (if (number? ops) ops 0)))
            (let ((ops-s (heph:ops-per-sec ops-n elapsed)))
              (heph:stats-bump! "kernels_run")
              (heph:stats-set! "ops_total" (+ (heph:stats-ref "ops_total") ops-n))
              (heph:stats-set! "last_elapsed_s" elapsed)
              (heph:stats-set! "last_ops" ops-n)
              (heph:stats-set! "last_result" (if (number? result) result 0))
              (list (cons ":result" result)
                    (cons ":elapsed_s" elapsed)
                    (cons ":ops" ops-n)
                    (cons ":ops_per_s" ops-s)))))))))

(define (heph:ops-per-sec ops elapsed)
  (if (and (number? ops) (number? elapsed) (> elapsed 0))
    (/ ops elapsed)
    0))

target.body:
(lambda (ops elapsed-ms) (if (and (number? ops) (number? elapsed-ms) (> elapsed-ms 0))
    (quotient (* ops 1000) elapsed-ms)
    0))

input.source:
; lib/prometheus-llm.aura — Axis D/E: propose edge (schema / wire / stub / live)
;
; (require "prometheus-llm" all:)
;
; Proposal is a 5-list:
;   (kind name body summary source)
;   kind   ∈ {"mutate","skip"}
;   name   must be "subject" (only continuous-edit target)
;   body   lambda source string for mutate:rebind
;   source ∈ {"rule","llm-stub","wire","llm-live",...}
;
; Denseness posture:
;   - rule / pure schema path: core E=0
;   - stub / wire-sim / live: edge E ≥ 1 (metered); schema still gates before rebind
;   - Live HTTPS is OPT-IN via PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE=live + LLM_API_KEY;
;     offline denseness suite never requires a live API.

(export prom:llm-version
        prom:propose-mode
        prom:proposal-kind
        prom:proposal-name
        prom:proposal-body
        prom:proposal-summary
        prom:proposal-source
        prom:proposal-errors
        prom:proposal-valid?
        prom:body-double
        prom:body-triple
        prom:body-quint
        prom:body-sept
        prom:body-poison
        prom:propose-rule
        prom:propose-stub
        prom:propose
        prom:parse-proposal-text
        prom:proposal-prompt
        prom:execute-proposal
        prom:note-edge-escape!)

(require "prometheus-measure" all:)
(require "prometheus-mutate" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)

(define prom:llm-version 1)

(define prom:body-double "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
(define prom:body-triple "(lambda (x) (* x 3))")
(define prom:body-quint "(lambda (x) (* x 5))")
(define prom:body-sept "(lambda (x) (* x 7))")
(define prom:body-poison "(lambda (x) (* x 99))")

(define (prom:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (prom:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (prom:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (prom:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (prom:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

; ── Mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

(define (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (prom:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (prom:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" 1)
  (prom:stats-ref "escapes"))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Allowed mutate bodies for Phase 4 denseness (whitelist + structural).
(define (prom:body-allowed? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 10)
       (< (string-length body) 80)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body "*")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (string-contains? body "define"))
       (not (string-contains? body "set!"))
       (not (string-contains? body "require"))
       (not (string-contains? body "eval"))
       (not (string-contains? body "gate"))
       (not (string-contains? body "subject"))
       (or (equal? body prom:body-double)
           (equal? body prom:body-triple)
           (equal? body prom:body-quint)
           (equal? body prom:body-sept)
           (equal? body prom:body-poison))))

(define (prom:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (name (car (cdr p)))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p))))
            (summary (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
            (errs (quote ())))
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (and (string? name) (equal? name "subject")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (prom:body-allowed? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (prom:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (prom:proposal-errors p)))

; Closed-form want for sample-arg given a known body string.
(define (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? body prom:body-double) (* sample-arg 2))
    ((equal? body prom:body-triple) (* sample-arg 3))
    ((equal? body prom:body-quint) (* sample-arg 5))
    ((equal? body prom:body-sept) (* sample-arg 7))
    ((equal? body prom:body-poison) (* sample-arg 99))
    (else -1)))

; ── Wire parse ───────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)
  (string-append
    "Return ONLY one line: "
    "MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. "
    "N in {2,3,5,7}. sample-arg="
    (if (number? sample-arg) (number->string sample-arg) "7")
    " current-got="
    (if (number? current-got) (number->string current-got) "?")
    ". Prefer triple when current is double. No markdown."))

(define (prom:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

; ── Propose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

; mode: "triple" | "quint" | "double" | "noop" | "auto" | "poison"
; current-got: last (subject sample-arg) observation for auto policy
(define (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "triple")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-triple" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "quint")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-quint "rule-quint" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "double")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-double "rule-double" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "poison")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-poison "rule-poison" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "auto")
     (if (and (number? current-got) (number? sample-arg)
              (= current-got (* sample-arg 2)))
       (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-auto-triple" "rule")
       (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule")))
    (else
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-default-noop" "rule"))))

(define (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((p (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Live path: opt-in only. Without key or on failure, fall back to rule body
; but still mark edge escape (attempted live edge).
(define (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((fallback (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey" "llm-live")
      (begin
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((sys
                "Reply with EXACTLY one line: MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. N in {2,3,5,7}. No markdown.")
              (usr (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)))
          (let ((resp (try (llm:chat sys usr) (catch (e) #f))))
            (let ((text
                    (if (string? resp)
                      resp
                      (if (hash? resp)
                        (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
                          (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
                            (if (string? c) c ""))
                          "")
                        ""))))
              (let ((parsed (prom:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
                (if (and (pair? parsed) (prom:proposal-valid? parsed))
                  parsed
                  (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                        (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                        "llm-parse-fallback" "llm-live"))))))))))

(define (prom:propose mode current-got sample-arg)
  (let ((pm (prom:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
        (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))))

; ── Execute (schema-gated rebind) ────────────────────────────

; Returns alist:
;   :ok :decision (commit|skip|refuse|rollback) :reason :snap :got :want :source
; sample-arg used for closed-form verify after mutate.
; n-leaves for leaf integrity check.
(define (prom:execute-proposal proposal sample-arg n-leaves)
  (if (not (prom:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (prom:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        (let* ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
               (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
               (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
               (r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg))
               (got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
               (leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
               (applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
               (good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
          (if good
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                    (cons ":reason" "verified")
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                    (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))))))))

target.body:
